reviews.author: smartjanki
reviews.title: Khyber in all it's glory
reviews.text:
The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa is truly an experience that stays with you long after you leave.Qe booked this resort  to celebrate our anniversary and the hotel took my soul to beautiful fairy land.From the very first moment, the warmth and generosity of the staff stood out—they were courteous, attentive, and always ready to help with genuine smiles, making us feel completely at home. (Nazma was welcoming staff from the front desk)The food was another highlight: delicious, thoughtfully prepared, and offering an impressive variety of spreads that catered to every taste, making each meal a delight.Junaid and Firsous left no stone unturned to pamper us with yummy food and service.Junaid a very polite and professional restaurant manager offered a memorable cake cutting experience by the lobby side with love rabab music .
Housekeeping was impeccable, with well-maintained rooms and excellent amenities that reflected luxury and comfort in every detail.
 The spa experience(shwa facial and body spa) was deeply relaxing and rejuvenating,Mary offered an amazing spa therapy ,and the heated pool was pure bliss—floating there surrounded by snow felt like one of life’s best experiences. Adding to this magic was the breathtaking snowfall and the stunning natural beauty all around, turning every moment into a picture-perfect memory.
The room itself was nothing short of spectacular, with snow-clad views right outside the glass windows and plush, elegant interiors inside. Waking up to that view felt surreal. Overall, The Khyber is not just a stay but a complete luxury escape—where comfort, nature, and exceptional hospitality come together beautifully.

reviews.author: VishalDugar
reviews.title: Khyber You Gave Kashmir A Bad Name.     WISH THERE WAS AN OPTION TO GIVE A MINUS RATING.
reviews.text:
I would like to narrate the Horrifying Travel Experience i had with The Khyber (Gulmarg) with the timeline, so that all of you who are Reading the said review are able to Take an informed Decision on spending a lot of your hard earned money for which the arrogance of the Khyber Management  has no Value.  

Its me today who went through this Insinuation But It Could be You Tomorrow. 

Every Luxury  Property has to understand the importance of being Super Diligent and Not Negligent, its in the Hospitality, Service orientation is and should be the untold law and most basic factor expected  unlike treating their Paying Patrons as Guinea Pigs, and to make you understand that such Negligence is the last thing that was expected which resulted in the catastrophe for me, a ruined vacation on a special occasion, a permanent loss of business for the Property, due to such Bad vibes that i would probably never visit or if consulted would never recommend any informed Traveller   to visit the Khyber Ever  

The reason for the late review though my travel dates were 28th September 2025 to 1st October 2025 is that i was immediately taken unwell in Gulmarg after check in itself, the reason  was due to the extremely potent varnish used on the wood all through the property,  and it got lot worse later and i was  diagnosed for sever Macula Edema in the eye all due to the Chemical varnish that was applied to wood all through the property, the same led me to administer Heavy Oral Steroids along with an injection of steroid called Ozurdex in the eye and i sill haven’t completely recovered yet.  And the shame is that when i brought it to the  Management's notice, they accepted and said that it was a planned renovation, and  though i made the booking directly with the Property i was never informed about the same.  Its a mandate that if there is any planned renovation happening in the property all who are making a booking are duly informed and if the said renovation bothers the guest he or she can back out if its an inconvenience to them.   Which was not the case here at all.    

Time Line:

The One experience that had been on my bucket list as an Avid traveller who has experienced almost every Continent was  to visit (The Khyber at Gulmarg)since the day it came to existence, the lure of the location, the property, the  thought of Kashmiri Hospitality was much higher then visiting any European destination even and in a way WAS proud to think so. 

Our whole Visit was completely Khyber Centric and neither we had any plans nor did we venture out to any other place it was Airport to Khyber and Vice Versa, unfortunately my excitement was short lived.  

First the Positives:

Location:		Gulmarg and Khyber are Un Separable and no visitor ever visiting Gulmarg would not want to glimpse the Khyber if He or She isnt  staying there would and infact  Wish to be staying sometime in their lifespan as a Bucket list, such is the Aura of the property which offers Style, Brio, its Monolithic and Magnificent at the same time like no other property in Kashmir, wins your heart immediately.   Surrounded by the  The Imposing mountains of the Pir Panjal Range in the Himalayas, and nestled right in between  coniferous fir-laden forests, the Magical  property looks right out of a fairy tail book, much like a quaint Austrian or Swiss village Abit even better.  

Property: As mentioned place looks like a Fantasy, everything is superbly well laid out from the temperature controlled Swimming Pool, the well spread and amazingly well curated gardens, thoughtfully placed swings (facing the forests), seating areas, everything is perfect if the intent is to relax, detox and destress.

The Human Factor:	A little bit of a mixed bag but the people who were good need to be appreciated for the salvage they could try to do with the Broken Trip and the unwanted mess created during the stay:

Mr. Mohammed Rafi (who acted diligently and was humble all through my stay)
Mr. Owais (front desk, who tried to be as calm and welcoming he could be)
Mr. Arif (who on noticing the fiasco that happened the first night at dinner tried to make sure the breakfast was spot on, and its the only meal we had at the property, only breakfast for 2 nights)
Mr. Abdul (Our Driver for pick up and drop was actually the person who needs to be most appraised and appreciated  if i didn’t go by the hierarchy) he was a true saviour during the trip, mild mannered gentlemen to the core, who made sure that we could understand Kashmir through a very different lens, from a locals perspective)  

Everthing was down hill apart from the postives that i have mentioned above:

1.	Reservations:  I was coordinating with Mr. Goofran who asured me that sir the occupancy on the days of your  travel are really low and that if i booked the mid category room directly with the Hotel, the next  higher balcony category would be made available and that i cannot document this on email as others are in cc but rest be assured it will be done, i went on his word and transferred the said advance as asked by him directly to the Hotel and not through any online portal (who were offering a substantial discount of @ 7000 further more to what i paid the hotel directly, but i still chose to make the reservation directly with the property).  A few  days post making the reservations i called the property again and asked if i could make the balance payments at the hotel, Goofran  rudely told me No and instead asked me Why hasn’t the balance payments been made by yourself”, i reminded him that it was his duty to tell me when the balance payments need to be made and that too by text or call and not just email as emails tend to go to junk box, which was the case with me.  Post making the payments i called the hotel a couple of times to speak to him i was only told that he has gone to the property and that he would call me back, but the truth was he had left the organization, the whole experience was very bizarre. 

2.	  No Point of time was i told there is NO AIR CONDITIONING by anyone including their  website, Khyber may be a ski resort (which i presume is but you have a good 6 months of warm weather and being on a higher altitude as cool as it gets in winters the sun rays come as hard and temperature of 24 degrees could easily feel like 30 plus  degrees (and im sure you guys dont shut down during summers right ??).  Which is what we experienced while check in, when our room was allocated, its only while in the Room Owais told us Sir there is no air conditioning and also the windows don’t open. We were getting baked in the room at @ 4.00 pm when we checked in.

3.	Brazen and Arrogant Attitude in The Human Factor:  Apart from the people i mentioned and appreciated above, people seemed cold and disinterested even, which in-fact should be Opposite to Kashmir as the hospitality here is legendary, this became most evident when alteast 4 different staff members whom i was interacted with, told me something that was shocking and each tried to be very obvious when they said “Sir what we are charging you for your stay is actually our per night rate” HOW DARE anyone say this to a Paying Guest?Patron, thats the most embarrassing thing i have heard in my years of travel experience India and Abroad and its Insinuating , i would rank this as the worst thing ever told to any guest and Kyber  should be embarrassed to the core, any business is about Demand and Supply and the economics of the price are based on that.   Its you who is offering the said price right and you are advertising the same with the intent to have guest back (and Rs 69000 for 3 nights is still not cheap), Today when a guest comes to Kashmir there is a sense of risk He or She associates and when they brave it given the innumerable options available in India even for hills (from Himachal Pradesh to Uttrakhand to the Beauty of North East) its the travelers way of saying to every one is Kashmir “We are with you as one and here to explain to the world that its Safe and the valley of Beauty, Wisdom is Open for all to experience with NO FEAR ….

4.	Something as simple as a Tax Invoice had to be followed for,  Its supposed to be a default thing right ? Its only when i wrote the email i was given the same (that too after more then a month) 

5.	Food is an Absolute Disaster barring Breakfast and more so if you are a Vegetarian:   The one paid meal we had was dinner on 28th September 2025 post which me and my wife  didn’t have a single meal in the Hotel cause of the bad  experience, cause the food was such a disaster, we were super exited for-the meal the first night presuming that atleast  the food wouldn’t go wrong in Kyber, we being vegetarians went on the staff recommendation and ordered Kashmiri Dum Aloo as a vegetable what was served was like piece of stone with gravy, Arif who was around understood the same and immediately acted and said sir leave it and he did take good care of us during breakfast the next 2 days. But just imagine this that a in-house guest did not have a single meal cause of the bad experience, the food was still billed to me and i still paid it.   

6.	NO Proper Information:  since check in no one would administer any information about what the property has to offer unless asked, this is a Resort and a Spa right ??  isn’t it as basic that when a guest is staying for 3 nights be informed about the property and more so when the guest has expressed a desire to host 20 couples later in the year and that this trip was more like a Recee (the same was mentioned in the email to the property and Goofran before i arrived), wouldn’t that be incentive enough for future business. I eventually landed up signing up another Luxury property in Himachal Pradesh the said Gm of the property  not only hosted me for 2 nights but also was Courteous enough to help me understand in person how the event could be held along with with Options such as a Picnic, Hike, special meals in different venues  and How the guests could be made to feel Special, thats what true Hospitality and leadership is all bout, understanding and valuing the Business of a guest.  Khyber has miles to go in that regards.  You could still proclaim to be the best but in my eyes and with my experience it would be sheer Arrogance.   Cause Khyber doest care and thats arrogance

6.	Treating your Paying Customers LIke Guinea Pigs:   If you have your property under renovation of any sort  its a mandate and your duty to inform the guest and more so if you are using any kind of a potent chemical like a varnish which can create major Pulmonary issues for your guests, i dont even know if thats legally permitted to so when you have resident guests, i had immediately documented the same the very next morning  as i had taken ill, and it got a lot worse to a point its only almost after a month that im recovering, and shuffling from mumbai to Chennai (multiple visits)  to see my Dr and get my self treated.

I Had  never asked for any Refund (which given my situation was my right to do so) and more so it would have been dignified from the properties end to do so, but instead i  am offered to come back to the same  place (at my cost of Airlines,cab etc) all at a special rate to a self proclaimed  “heaven on earth”

reviews.author: PrithviRaj
reviews.title: Vinit (GM),  Bilal (F&B Head) and The entire Khyber team were brilliant
reviews.text:
We visited The Khyber Gulmarg last evening for dinner at their Italian restaurant and had a truly wonderful experience—made exceptional by the hospitality of the team.

A special mention to Bilal, the F&B Head, who ensured that our experience was incredibly warm and welcoming from the moment we arrived. He was impeccably well-groomed, gracious, and genuinely kind—especially noteworthy since we were not staying at the hotel and had simply walked in for dinner. His hospitality reflected true class and set the tone for the evening.

We were also warmly greeted by Vinit Chhabra, the General Manager of The Khyber, who was the first to welcome us upon arrival. His humility, kindness, and personal attention were immediately evident. He ensured that all our needs were taken care of and made it clear that his team was completely at our disposal. It’s easy to see that The Khyber is run with remarkable efficiency under his leadership, and we are certainly looking forward to staying at the property with him on our next visit.

Junaid and Muneena were equally supportive and attentive, helping ensure everything ran smoothly and that we felt comfortable throughout our visit.

At the restaurant, Varun, the restaurant manager, along with Saba, were extremely adaptable and helpful. They took the time to understand our preferences, made excellent recommendations, and elevated the dining experience with their thoughtful approach.

And finally, Arif, who served us—consistently attentive and caring. He made sure we were always well-hydrated, well-fed, and looked after without ever being intrusive.

Overall, the experience was a perfect example of refined hospitality—warm, respectful, and effortless. Even as non-hotel guests, we were treated with the utmost care and professionalism.
Highly recommended for both the food and the people behind it.

reviews.author: Road19342335503
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text:
Every time I visit The Khyber, it feels like coming back to a second home. We were here to celebrate my friend’s birthday, and the entire experience was unforgettable.

A special mention to Mohammad Rafi, who has been incredibly helpful throughout our stay. His kindness, attention to detail, and willingness to assist with anything truly made our visit smoother and more comfortable. People like him are the reason this place feels so warm and welcoming.

The staff at Café Coffee also deserve appreciation super friendly, quick, and always making sure we were taken care of. Whether it was a quick snack or just a warm cup to beat the Gulmarg cold, they were always on point.

I often visit this property, and each time it reminds me why it’s one of my favourite destinations.

reviews.author: Mudit Miranka
reviews.title: Impecable
reviews.text:
During our stay at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa, Kashmir, we had the pleasure of experiencing exceptional client servicing from Mr. Irfan Hassan, whose dedication and professionalism truly elevated our trip. From the moment we arrived, Mr. Irfan ensured that every aspect of our stay was handled with utmost care, offering prompt assistance, thoughtful guidance, and a warm, welcoming attitude that made us feel genuinely valued. His attention to detail, proactive approach, and willingness to go the extra mile in addressing our needs reflected a remarkable commitment to guest satisfaction. Whether it was coordinating our requests, ensuring comfort, or sharing helpful local insights, his support added immense convenience and comfort to our experience. We sincerely appreciate his outstanding hospitality and commend him for setting such a high standard of service at The Khyber.
If you are willing to Stay any time in future at The Khyber , Kashmir  do not forget to connect with Mr. Irfan Hassan

reviews.author: Prateek J
reviews.title: One of the best resorts in the world!
reviews.text: Khyber is one of the most beautiful resort overlooking the Himalayas and one of the best in the world, when we say this we believe we’ve stayed at a lot of good hotels. The reason I rate it 5/5 is their wonderful Kashmiri and Indian hospitality. They have the nicest staff. Hammad at reception was wonderful and courteous. Muzammil helped us with our reservations issues. Gufran at the reservation was very proactive in making sure Makemytrip gave us refund for our one night cancellation because of flight issues due to super unpredictable weather, which is super off for Srinagar. Aman and other staff at the restaurant were friendly and they insisted we try out the dessert from the buffet, even when we were opting for Ala-Carte. Varun the manager, made sure we put on 1-2 kgs while staying in Khyber. I would highly recommend for the staff and how nice they are, while it is one of the most beautiful places I have stayed for a vacation.

reviews.author: Divya Kapoor
reviews.title: The best place to stay, if you intend to have a relaxing holiday with the best hospitality.
reviews.text:
Stayed at Khyber for the 2nd time this September, 2024 as we wanted a different experience after the 1st visit during the snowy season in 2018, which was magical. But the end of monsoon season is as beautiful! Greenery and ofcourse the clean fresh air is all we want for a break atleast from the concrete cities we live in. 
The rooms, the restaurants are all nice and comfortable. No complaints (except that it would be nice to be served coffee/tea in the restaurant even late evenings). 
What makes Khyber the best place to stay in Gulmarg, or the entire Kashmir region, is definitely it's location (you don't need to go out of the resort really, to enjoy the most picturesque views). Second, and as important almost, is the hospitality. The staff are very efficient, polite and pro-active. They take all the effort in making it a memorable stay for you. 
I wanted to celebrate my husband's birthday (in advance while we were there), so they arranged for a small cake that evening as a surprise (as I'd requested for one), and even decorated the place with birthday balloons and flowers. It was really special indeed. 
Big shoutout to Arif, for best service, his friendliness and warmth. Zahid gave us great knowledge about the place and motivated us to be back soon for skiing too! Chef Gupta (can't recall full name) was too sweet; all our requests were met with immediately (hot hot mooli parathas, yummy french toasts, sweeeet lassi). The fresh apple juice was the best ever and we gulped down so many glasses! I asked for a certain tweak in the Kahwa, and that was also done to my satisfaction. 
Truly grateful for such a memorable experience that now we certainly will be back for a 3rd time. :)

reviews.author: Vidhi Mehta
reviews.title: Stunning hotel and even beautiful hospitality.
reviews.text: We loved our stay at the hotel. The staff is absolutely humble and quite helpful. Every staff member would always greet with a big smile. We want to specially mention this gentleman Mr.Junaid from the food and beverages team for his hospitality. He made sure we were comfortable within the restaurant and also outside. Absolutely prompt, humble and helpful he deserves appreciation.

reviews.author: sheilamalhotra1962
reviews.title: Our delightful stay at Khyber Himalayan resort
reviews.text:
My husband and I have completed our Kashmir adventure with a night’s stay at Khyber which we were advised to do as a must . 
From the moment we arrived at the property, the warmth and hospitality were evident to see and experience. 

All the staff were attentive but not intrusive . 
The professionalism of Muzamil who checked us in was noted .

The property is beautifully nestled amongst the pine trees in Gulmarg ( meadow of flowers) and looking out from our room this morning the sunrise was spectacular. In fact so much so I had the urge to go down to the lawns to do the Surya Namaskar.

Our evening meal and breakfast was at a different level in every way . 
Arif and Sofia treated us with great warmth and regard from start to finish as did all the staff . 
The variety of food was amazing and the taste was exquisite. 
We relished the unique kashmiri flavours in the cuisine. 
I highly recommend the lehsuni fish tikka it melted in your mouth . 

At breakfast we tried something different which was the baked yoghurt , it was yummy . 
Hats off to the Chefs  Rajesh Gupta and Manish who came and introduced themselves and engaged with us.

Our whole experience at Khyber was one we will remember and cherish forever . Having travelled around the world Khyber has set its own elevated standard for us . 
We will surely return perhaps in the winter and experience Khyber in the snow. 
A very enjoyable experience . 

Best regards 
Mr Anil and Mrs Sheila Malhotra

reviews.author: Nilesh G
reviews.title: Great Place,,, the manager is a thief but..
reviews.text:
All great about this place, no doubts! Choose balcony rooms, it’s really a no brainer. Don’t look to save money by not choosing the same, as That is the very experience of this place. DONT book through the hotel directly, go through the agent!! Mr. Ishaq is a theif, the manager. Lied to me on my face for the upgrade and the cost he coaxed me into paying and my agent got it through in 50% price. DM me for my agent. He had no regret or remorse and even had a sly smile in ripping me of on higher charges when a lower price was available by simply lying. Made it feel like a negotiation that the horse riders in Kashmir do at tourist spots!!

Restaurant is excellent . Cloves. Veg Wazwan top hit! Waiter courteousness awesome
High Tea is overrated, I have had better in many places.

reviews.author: Shalini Bhasin
reviews.title: Khyber Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Not trying to burst anyone's bubble, but stayed at Khyber for 3 nights, and felt that it is quite overhyped.
The rooms are similar to standard hotel rooms ( our room's safety box & TV remote was not working) The resort itself does not have any activities. The staff, though courteous, lacked the basic information about their own property and not that hospitable (  not because they were not service oriented but more likely coz they have not been properly trained)
My take- visit the place maybe for a meal, but skip paying the exorbitant pricing  for the rooms.
PS- You let the cabbies and the guides know that you are putting up at Khyber, and they quote much higher, thinking that if you can afford Khyber- you can afford their over priced services too:)

reviews.author: Aditi M
reviews.title: Beautiful property, fantastic hospitality!
reviews.text:
Khyber is the most breathtakingly beautiful property I have stayed at! The rooms are well equipped and modern and at the same time have a Kashmiri feel to it. The heated indoor pool was the highlight! 

Driver Khurshid - a warm and friendly guy who doubles up as a fantastic guide and photographer picked us up from the Airport and took us around Gulmarg! His hospitality and attention to every detail is definitely something we will remember and would look forward in our future trip! 😃

The food at the property is amazing! The Kashmiri wazwan, biriyani and rajma chawal were my top favourites!! I would highly recommend them 😃 (Rajma chawal especially is the best I have ever had) 

While I don’t remember the names of all the staff members who took care of us during our stay - it’s worth noting that it is the best we have experienced compared to any other 5 star property we have stayed at! 

Also the hookah at Calabash is really good! Must try 😊

reviews.author: Amit Singh
reviews.title: Four seasons resort
reviews.text:
4 seasons resort 

We talk of Gulmarg, we talk of Khyber. We clubbed it with Tulip season and a period which is in between seasons . which turned out pretty well as depending on the weather , which oscillates every hour , we had a taste of winter and summer both.
Glad the resort is centrally heated . 

Property - Excellent location ,stones throw from the Gondola and a kilometre from the market . Kudos to the architect for the beautifully planned and executed property .
Almost all rooms have a gorgeous view of the snow capped himalayas , and there are numerous exits at all levels  if you would want to venture out. open spaces could have been more .. though it may be a geographic limitation. There was snow all around at this time of the year, a photographer's delight . 

Rooms- Spacious, well lighted and heated . We got a south facing one, sunlight streamed in on a day or two. 

Food- Seven Star chef ...All meals have a very go od variety and superb preparation. Chicken Dosa in breakfast is a must.
Never miss the evening tea at Nauf, don't miss the Kahwa and Brownie . Wazwan is a must in dinner .Coffee is excellent, strong and hot . Alcohol is not served,but you can carry your own and sit in a well designed and luxurious space just next to the reception . smoking areas are designated. 

Activities- The heated pool is superb . well maintained,  plush interiors , huge glass windows , perfect water ,open 9 to 9, and attached with a Jacuzzi, steam and sauna- complimentary for guests . I was very happy with the maintainance. I didn't get a Chance to avail the Spa.Try trekking to nearby mountains,  it's very very scenic ,with multiple routes, but it's outsourced, so carefully negotiate the prices , inclusions and exclusions . local taxis are very pricey but negotiable. Gulmarg is full of ice related activities, so you can be as busy as you want to be . 

Staff- Very hospitable and polite  . Dominated by handsome young Kashmiri fellas with a smile ...Varun was one who was very very forthcoming and a sweet laden accent. 

Logistics - Check in and check out is smooth, baggage transfer streamlined  , good parking area , and you can almost ask for anything you need. Live instrumental music is notable and adds to the authentic feel . Room service is very quick . 

Caution- never leave property without a jacket and an umbrella.  Always negotiate with outsourced facilities. 

have a great holiday

reviews.author: Lokamitra
reviews.title: Fancy hotel, fancy pricing poor culinary hygiene.
reviews.text:
The place is very high brow with an astronomic pricing so it was full of well-heeled guests. The architecture is beautiful and the service very responsive. 

Food:  We only ordered two ala carte  items. It took some time to come but the food was well prepared. The mutton and rotis were excellent.  They brought us some sweet items complimentary but we found them unappealing.

Ambience: It was pleasant with a local musician playing the famous Kashmiri instrument the Rabab.  The traditional music was nice but it didn’t last and one of the staff wanted the artist to pluck out some filmy songs to sing too.  it was sad to hear such a fine instrument plucking out Bollywood songs for the entertainment of the employees who obviously didn’t care for their own traditional music.  The overall effect was that the place was attempting “classy” without the staff having a real understanding of what entails.

The only thing that kind of clashed with the ambience was the serving of water in plastic bottles.  Glass decanters would have been more aesthetic.

Disaster:  The sad thing is both of us fell ill after the meal.  Neither of us had eaten early in the day since breakfast and we ate the same dishes at this hotel.  The difference was that I ate much more of the lotus stem starter my partner had very little.  Within two hours I was vomiting and having loose motions.  Violently sick.  The whole night I had to continuously go to the bathroom for 10 times until in the morning the only thing returning was the water I was drinking in-between the bouts.  I am pretty sure that the lotus stem dish was the culprit though it could have been the side salad of carrot,radish and tomatoes or  even the complimentary sweet items.

I had heard such great things about the hotel and the food was very tasty and well presented.  Something went wrong with the food hygiene.

reviews.author: Indraneil t
reviews.title: Disappointing Experience at Khyber Hotels and Resorts, Gulmarg: Beware!
reviews.text:
My recent visit to Khyber Hotels and Resorts in Gulmarg left me utterly disappointed and questioning the hype surrounding this place. Despite the exorbitant tariffs, my wife and I decided to give it a try for lunch. Little did we know that we were about to experience a series of letdowns.

Right from the start, we were discouraged by the bell desk, claiming that the restaurant, "Clove," was exclusively reserved for in-house guests. However, upon entering, we discovered a nearly empty restaurant, with only three occupied tables, none of which were occupied by in-house guests as we were led to believe. It became evident that they were simply trying to deter walk-in customers like ourselves.

To add insult to injury, my camera bag was confiscated due to their strict policy against professional photography. While I understand the need for regulations, it felt unwelcoming and intrusive.

Our request for a tour of the property was met with a dismissive response from the receptionist, stating that it would take an hour to complete. We suggested doing the tour after lunch, but it seemed they were more interested in rushing us through our experience.

As for the food itself, it was a major letdown. The Mutton Seekh Kebab, a dish I had enjoyed in various places across the country, was shockingly mediocre. The taste lacked any uniqueness or memorable flavours, leaving me longing for the authentic versions available at a fraction of the cost in Delhi.

The real disappointment came with the Kashmiri Dum Aloo, a dish we were eager to try for the first time in Kashmir. The potatoes served were rock hard, almost inedible. When I inquired about this, the server seemed unaware and uninterested in addressing the issue. They later brought a fresh portion when we were almost done with our meal, rendering it redundant and offering no remedy for our unpleasant experience.

The lacklustre service continued during the property tour. An intern, with minimal knowledge about the hotel, was assigned to guide us. Her inability to answer basic questions about the amenities and evasiveness regarding room availability raised serious doubts about the competence of the staff.

Throughout our visit, it became evident that the hotel staff had little interest in accommodating walk-in guests. They seemed more focused on catering exclusively to their in-house guests, despite the absence of any in-house guests in the restaurant or utilising the amenities.

I cannot help but compare my experience at Khyber Hotels and Resorts with a roadside restaurant in Pahalgam. The stark contrast in taste, quality, and hospitality left me deeply disappointed.

In conclusion, I must warn fellow travellers to approach Khyber Hotels and Resorts with caution. The lack of warmth, subpar food quality, and unprofessional conduct of the staff do not justify the exorbitant prices they charge. Save your hard-earned money and explore alternative options in Gulmarg that offer better value and genuine hospitality.

Rating: 5.5 out of 10.

reviews.author: Sreekanth S S
reviews.title: A good Hotel
reviews.text:
The good things

(1) Lovely property done with beautiful interiors - Kashmiri artwork and pictures. 
(2) Rooms have similar rich finish with lot of wood on floors and walls and carpets.
(3) Central Heating
(4) Good food
(5) All staff are happy to serve you .
(6) Availability of agents outside the porch of the hotel who help you with the gondola rides , local trips and snow activities. Please note the activities mentioned in the website of the hotel like ATV rides are actually outsourced through these agents.
(7) The Himalayan view rooms offer a fantastic  view of the mountains.
(8) Proximity to the Gondola though I would advise visitors not to walk up the steep hill back to the hotel. The low oxygen levels and the cold could literally take the wind out of you. You can get a hotel cab to pick and drop you.

The area for improvement:

(1) I feel owing to lack of competition this property is a tad overpriced 

(2) Though the website mentions activities when we reach the hotel the staff wash their hands off citing it is outsourced. This is unlike Oberoi or Taj where their concierge takes responsibility to coordinate with the outsourced agents. Not a big issue but the customer trusts the Hotel and the Hotel taking no stake is uncomforting for the tourist

(3) Breakfast starts at 8 AM . We had a early flight and wanted breakfast at 7:30 AM. The live counters where not ready at that time and you had only minimal menu.  Most 5 star Hotels offers full breakfast earlier

The hotel ambience, decor, service, food, everything was amazing.  The hotel staff are very polite,  friendly and helpful.  The highlight of the hotel is the views one can see from the hotel itself.  We we lucky to have sunshine,  snow fall,  rain in a  span of three days. It was wonderful to watch the change of weather sitting in the comfort of the hotel room/balcony.

Best time to visit the Khyber Resort Gulmarg is end of March when weather is not harsh, but snowfall is there.  I will definitely stay at this hotel again.

reviews.title: A Total Value for Money! Had an Amazing Stay for our Anniversary!
reviews.text:
We visited the Khyber on the 12th of March for our 5th Wedding Anniversary in Gulmarg.
Mr Waseem Sultan whose assigned at the Front Desk Manager, helped us with early check-in and upon request even upgraded us from the Gulmarg Balcony View Room to the Himalayan Balcony View since it was our 5th Wedding Anniversary fortunately that was the last available room, which was very thoughtful and quite considerate of the front office team.

The swimming pool is temperature-controlled and has all the state-of-the-art steam and sauna as well. Don't forget to take your swimming costume, but you can still buy it from the property at an additional expense. The Sheesha lounge served us amazing Sheesha with complimentary Kahwa and Non-Alcoholic Kahwa.

We eventually ended the day with dinner at the Italian Restaurant as the normal Indian Restaurant was jam-packed. The hotel also offers games like Billiards, Carrom and TT as well to play.

But overall a completely romantic and wonderful stay, the staff at the restaurant even for the restaurant buffet were really helpful and always very accommodating. A MUST TRY but try to book the Himalayan View for the best room view!

reviews.title: I would love to stay here again.. worth the hype :)
reviews.text:
If u think Gulmarg is heaven on earth, then Khyber was the icing on the cake. Yes it was an expensive 2 nights and I was apprehensive when I booked it but after staying there I thought it was pretty much worth it :) the room was excellent and quite massive. It was my husband’s birthday and I had asked for a surprise cake which was sent to the room and it was fantastic and really truly fresh and delicious. Between the two of us we finished the 1/2 kilo cake without any problem, and we call ourselves light eaters! So u know how good it was :) the hotel has an Italian restaurant hidden away from prying eyes called Brava where we had dinner twice coz we liked it so much. That is where we met Varun (the manager). I cannot praise him enough! On the first night he got us a little treat for my husband birthday and on the second night he recommended a mushroom soup (gucci) which was delicious and something we would have never ordered on our own. He also made us some brilliant coffee and mocha at breakfast the next morning. Basically he went out of his way to make us comfortable and happy and I can’t thank him enough.  Kudos to him! I would also like to thank the chef at the Italian restaurant deshraj whose cooking was out of this world and he too made us feel very at home while we were dining there. The rest of the hotel was also beautiful and well maintained. The lounge is a nice place to sit and watch the view outside and relax but the service there wasn’t that great unfortunately.  There is a great heated pool as well to use. One other staff I would like to mention specifically would be Waseem at the check in check out desk. He was very professional and quick and efficient which I totally appreciate. 
The one thing I would like to point out is that the hotel has a steep climb from the gondola station.. the gondola station is actually quite close so that is another advantage of staying here. So coming back to the steep climb, it would be nice if the hotel had a buggy kind of service for that. If they do have one, it was not mentioned to us. If my parents were with me, they would not have been able to walk up that road to the hotel. 
All in all, I would give it a 5 star. We loved it and we thank everyone who made out stay memorable

reviews.text: Hotel has a magical view . The property is at a different level . The staff at the property is soo very warm. I haven’t seen this good and warm staff anywhere . Special shout out to firdous. He really made our dinners special . Thanks .

reviews.author: SNATH
reviews.title: Overrated paradise!
reviews.text:
Location - 5/5 
Mesmerizing view of the valley 

Food- 3.5/5 
Flavourful kasimiri wazwan served cold. 
Breakfast spread was good but most dishes served at the buffet were again cold.

Service & Hospitality-2/5 - 
Check in & check out experience below average. The staff their seem to have a very casual attitude. 

Cleanliness- 1/5
we booked a Himalayan view luxury room for 2 nights.
We found a bunch of hair in our bathroom at the time of check in. Bathroom was flooded on both days due plumbing issues. 

Swimming Pool -2/5
 The swimming pool is supposed to be their USP. The view from the pool area is spectacular and perfect for creating a great photo album. The hotel claims the water is heated but the water was not even luke warm. With snowfall and minus temperatures outside we were expecting to enjoy a swim in the heated pool. BIG DISAPPOINTMENT!!!

Overall, the property is great to stay at for just 1 night. Enjoy the views and multiple  photo ops. The hotel felt like a prison on day 2 as there is not too much to do at the property itself. The hotel has no in house activities or music night planned for their guests for entertainment. There is no alcohol served at the hotel. They have no contract with vendors for guests to enjoy ATV rides or other activities. Even an evening with bonfire and heaters at their Cafe is on chargeable basis which is to be booked in advance. Rooms are extremely noisy, we could hear people talking in the room opposite to ours. 

This group of hotels has a lot to learn in terms of  hospitality, customer service and satisfaction from its contemporaries like Taj and Oberoi.

reviews.author: charuratra
reviews.title: Awful Stay Experience!!
reviews.text:
Apparently wanted to write to GM. But you guys have not even put his email address on the site.

Started with a bad check-in experience where an hour before coming when I called the lady who answered, confirmed there is a hi-tea being served and will be there till 6pm. We reached at 5.40, asked where can we go for the hi-tea, the guy said there is no hi-tea and we must be mistaken, when told him that the female on the phone confirmed they said we can go and check the hi-tea area if we don’t believe. Kind of shocking how you guys talk to guests. Rather than apologising or arranging something you are saying go and check.

Next blunder was going for the Steam and Sauna. Area was not even clean and for the first time I couldn’t even take a shower and came to the room to take a shower as it was so dirty and wet everywhere. Steam was not even working even though temperature was 99 but it wasn’t effective at all. When told the lady she went inside the steam with her footwear’s. 

there were not even towels or bathrobes. The lady on the reception of Steam Sauna didn’t even bother to check or arrange. After asking for it she arranged it. 

Next was from the live pasta counter asked for a white sauce pasta and it came all cold, probably chef didn’t had enough time to cook it well. 

All in all doesn’t seems like this is one of the highest rated hotels in India. Probably just the location is the reason.

After staying with the best of the hotels in India, came with very high expectations but this is definitely not the place where customer service and quality of service exist.

Room No - 5004

reviews.author: Vikash
reviews.title: Winter abode in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
One of the best time in Kashmir was spent at Khyber,truly a Himalayan delight.we were greeted exceptionally well by the team and a welcome Kashmir Kawa was offered.Checkin Formalities we’re completed in 5 minutes for us though the hotel was super busy with incoming guest.Kudos to the front office guy Taher.

Our stay and room were super.We came to celebrate our 10th wedding anniversary and this Himalayan delight lived up to its expectations.Our room was beautifully decorated by the House keeping team and a complimentary cake was kept in our room to make us feel special.

Views of snow kept mountains from the room are mesmerising and you don’t feel like going away.

They have a excellent swimming pool and one must not miss taking a dip in it ,it’s the best tho g you can have in a freezing cold there.Heated pool will make you very comfortable and the view from pool is outstanding.

Food is excellent and they have a wide variety to choose from.though Iam not a foodie so didn’t try much.

One must try their coffee shop ,they have wide variety to choose from one and make amazing coffees.

Overall it was a great experience for us at Khyber and we look forward to come back soon to this winter delight.

reviews.author: Suchita heda
reviews.title: Restaurant review
reviews.text: I recently stayed at the Khyber Himalayan Resort and I was impressed with the exceptional hospitality. The staff, particularly Firdous Parray, went above and beyond to make sure my stay was comfortable and enjoyable. The resort itself is beautiful, with spacious rooms, stunning views of the Himalayas, and excellent amenities. I highly recommend this resort for anyone looking for a luxurious and relaxing getaway, be sure to mention Firdous Parray for his exceptional service.

reviews.author: motwani_manish
reviews.title: There is a reason for the ‘THE’ afore Khyber
reviews.text:
Awesome Hospitality, awesome location, awesome food (a tad expensive though). Wont harm to adapt some new-age technological advancements in hospitality. 
But right from the moment you land into the airport their teams take over as if you have landed into their home. The real Kashmiri Hospitality to the fore, beautiful people.

reviews.author: docamybaba
reviews.title: terrible service, worst 5 star experience. rooms and location are perfect. i wont visit again
reviews.text: hotel carrying on with old legacy, now rotting away with bad service and worse food. fabulous property, great location. amazing rooms. great infrastructure. very very good room housekeeping team. some people at reception are good. it ends here. we faced shockingly bad service and no body has the will to make things right for us. sadly this is the worst 5 star experience i have seen. whenever i had a issue ,someone would come to us to solve it. here nothing. its as if nobody cares. at the tea lounge, we got served a cold burger. we asked the server to check , he admonished us, saying this is how it is. and nobody else is complaining and that sometimes guest feel that things get cold too fast. shocking. he had zero remorse or even had zero inclination to correct it. he only  reheated on requesting again. at breakfast we are told by the server, that he is night duty person, its not his job to serve water and the morning team has not come, and that they are very busy. with reluctance he served water to my wife, and ignored my glass . 5 minutes later, he walks up to a European / American, i dont know, but foreigner, to ask if he can get anything for them . racism???  we kept asking for fresh tea, nothing happened for 30 mts. fruits were cut at night, and had a skin of dryness on them,  please be careful when you eat fruits that are cut all night. we have been having loosies since morning. i try to tell the Front desk manager. he is on his system , saying he will check, what ?? fruits which are eaten, the staff that has left. in the steam, sauna area, not a single staff. at 10 am, i had to swtch on jacuzzi myself. the only person in the room was a guard. Khyber will be run by security guards now. not a single staff. the steam room was cold, the sauna room was room temp. why are u amking fools of us. why are we paying so much to you. please look at the system. trust me it is rotting away

reviews.author: sahul
reviews.title: AMAZING VIEW AND SPLENDID SERVICE!
reviews.text: We had the best imaginable service provided at the Khyber Resort. The view was amazing, with the balcony overlooking the snow-clad mountains and the valley! The restaurant offered multi-cuisine menu and each day there was something different to look forward to. Special mention to one of the staff, Firdous, whom took extra care of us at the restaurant and even recommended different food menu and made us feel really special! He also went to extra lengths to ensure we are fed well and enjoyed our meal times! A lot more can be mentioned about this resort but staying here physically will do more justice to its beauty and five star experience!

reviews.title: Our first long trip post lockdown

We had been planning to come to Khyber for 2 years now but then lockdown hit and life came in the way! 
This year for my birthday month, we finally decided to make our trip to Kashmir happen & the first place that came to my mind was Khyber- & rightly so! 
As soon as we set foot in this place, we felt like we were in heaven! 
Mr. Mubashir was guiding us since our first minute at Khyber. He even upgraded our room to the Luxury Suite which we felt was an extremely kind gesture. 
At every point, he ensured we were comfortable and had access to anything that we may need. 
Our stay was planned for a night but I cannot wait to be back here again!

reviews.author: foodieklix
reviews.title: Excellent Property with Bad Food
reviews.text:
The Hotel is one of the finest properties we have stayed in. The room furniture & finishing is par excellence. The toiletries & each & everything in the room is high standards. The room service was efficient. The lawns & indoor pool really added to our stay experience.
We had lunch at their  Multi cuisine Restaurant Cloves. We ordered Indian, kashmiri & Asian food. The Indian & Kashmiri food was completely bland & lacked proper cooking & spices, when we complained, the chef & exec chef came & just listened & we werent even offered to get the meal redone/replaced. The meal prices are so exhorbitant that one expects atleast some decent meal & staff attitude. We were told by the chef that on next visit we will provide you best meal. What????? Is this a response to such a pathetic meal & that too coming from the exec chefs of such an amazing property. Only the Asian food was nice. Really our worst meal ever for Rs.17,000/- ( not even worth a rupee ). Later that night we called in food from Bakshi dhaba & trust us the meal was delicious with perfect spices & flavours & we paid 1900/- for a wholseome & delicious meal.

reviews.author: J J
reviews.title: Incredibly special
reviews.text:
Very good hotel with amazing signature Kashmiri hospitality.

Food and service were impeccable and the room was newly renovated and comfortable. The balcony was perfect and we felt lucky to be perched atop this incredible destination.

Unfortunately two things can be improved:

Two cockroaches were in our bathroom one evening. A staff member came immediately to remove them and we did not see them again.

The surfaces surrounding the buffet (walls, counters, etc) should be cleaned after each service. I could see dust and grime behind each pot of food. The ladles should be replaced after some time and the general area should be cleaned on a regular basis.

Highly recommend the L’Occitane Spa at Khyber if you’re staying here.

I'm gonna definitely go back to them for another session while I'm still massaging. 
Also, Gaurai did a great job of recommending the appropriate massage for both me and my husband. 
Loved every bit of our hour masaage.

Please definitely try this if you visit this amazing property.

reviews.title: “Heavenly Khyber” makes you fall in love with Gulmarg, Kashmir, and it’s people

It is a resort bound by breathtaking views, exclusive service, and commendable staff who are the best at their job. You are sure to experience immense bliss as you enter the resort’s courtyard that has a palatial undertone and stretches down to their cafe lined by huge glass windows with panoramic views. We stayed at their Himalayan view room which is of their best and most recommended rooms with a balcony facing the great Himalayas (it is the room you see in most of their online pics). The restaurant is finely done with good food offerings. Do not miss taking a dip in their heated pool, again offering exquisite views from 3 sides. From their staff, IDREES at the front desk was very professional, welcoming, and helpful - he got our room upgraded at a reasonable price. HILAL was another of their staff at the very best of service. SHAFEEQA at the pool and recreation area reception was v knowledge and kind to help us. Cannot wait to visit Khyber again!

reviews.author: Madhuri S
reviews.title: Luxury with an extra touch of love and care
reviews.text:
We booked the Himalayan view deluxe rooms that come with a balcony sitout with brilliant views of the snow capped Apharwat peak and other ranges around. It's difficult to even imagine a better located property. It's a couple of mins walk from the prime attraction - the Gondola (cable car ropeway) that takes one close to the top of the Apharwat peak - and then a short snowy trek to get to the top. The Khilanmarg horse riding point surrounded by the characteristic conifers of Kashmir is a few mins walk too.

Rooms and bathrooms are well appointed and decently sized, though not lavish. But what caught my attention most is the level of attention to detail in service. When we asked to be shifted to the upper floor from the originally assigned room on the lower floor corner - the request was accomodated with a smile with no hassle. I'm more used to dark, dirty looks from even the best of properties - when asking for anything they haven't offered upfront. The attitude of "yes, with pleasure", was apparent across all service staff from the very helpful concierge, restaurant staff, housekeeping and even the security guards. Rare to find an uniformly friendly, helpful band of staff - especially when they were very clearly running full house. 

The local kashmiri fare served a la care at their main restaurant Clove deserves a special mention, along with the excellent deli and bakery Chaikash. Their selection of bakery surprisingly rivaled some of the best I've sampled in Europe, and hardly ever if at all anywhere in India. Compliments to the chef Hira Singh (insta @chefhira). His fruit gateaux and butter croissants were particularly amazing.

The rest of their Indian food leaves much to desire though. And the dinner buffet is a total disaster - or at least it was on the only evening we opted for it. The breakfast buffet is excellent though. Rest of the meals for us were all a la carte.

A special call out to Firdaus at Cloves who took care of us during most of our meals both a la carte and buffet. And to Rahul who served us at Chaikash.

But even perfect isn't ever perfectly perfect. Here are somethings that I thought could be better.

- A travel desk even if it were outsourced to help with the rides, sightseeing etc. They do actually have a bevy of cab drivers, atv and horseride hire folks almost always present within the premises. A chat with the security person gets you what you need. But it's puzzling why it isn't better organized with a desk
- Chaikash shuts by 6.30-7 PM. It's by far the best located with views of the peaks as well as beautifully set with lounge seats. While their sheesha lounge at the other end of the lobby opens when Chaikash shuts. It seems like converting Chaikash to accommodate the same services may have been a superior experience. I'm sure they have good reasons to do what they do. But it's not apparent.
- Room cleaning is the only service that was surprisingly shoddy. Under the toilet and on tables were a hurried job with stains and streaks still visible post cleaning.

reviews.author: Yaduvendra Mathur
reviews.title: A Dream come true !
reviews.text: Holidaying at Gulmarg and staying at Khyber was on our to-do list for years. It's a dream come true. The entire experience was top class - from making our reservations to our stay, checkout and even some refunds - Mansoor of Front Office was most helpful especially in also supporting a cancellation of my friend's booking....the staff was very very helpful for making our stay truly a dream holiday.The Khyber management gave us a room on the first floor that had an amazing view off the Apharwat snowclad range and top... We had dinner in our room as the balcony is wide and spacious - room' service is prompt... bed linen is world class 600 count linen even better than luxury seven star hotels......bath tub in room has a great view too ..well planned for a resort experience......the breakfast is international standards and well spread out though the dining room you'll find is always packed with guests as this property is mostly 100 percent booked.....the Khyber spa and pool are extremely beautiful and tops of the tops ...  a warm sanctuary. Suggest staying in a room on the first floor as it comes with balconies facing the snow side view.... they're a bit expensive but totally worth it. There's no lift to the first floor but it's not a problem as the stairs is easy to negotiate. All wooden alpine style construction smells and feels very nice.....The property is right in the centre of Gulmarg so it's easy to walk down to the gondola ski lifts and for taking a horse ride to the golf course and the temple in the meadows or take a stroll through the small town to the stream.....we wished we could've stayed another day for exploring the place. The GM is a cordial person and is managing the property well. Khyber without double is a dream place and with definitely the finest hotel view.

reviews.author: Abhishek C
reviews.title: Horrible service
reviews.text:
My husband and I went for our anniversary. After much trying we got a reservation at the hotel and we were very excited to stay. The hotel indeed is beautiful but we were disappointed with our stay. Probably the hotel is overbooked but hospitality, cleanliness was horrid. 

1. The room heating was adjusted at 31 degrees. After feeling suffocated I called the reception and the man came after 3 hours to adjust it after repeatedly calling. We literally had to freeze to death as we were suffocated in our room. 

2. I came back after ski-ing and our room was apparently done but dirty wine glasses remained. Creamer was spilled and the bathroom was dirty. 

3. We booked a spa and they cancelled our reservation without informing us! This was ridiculous as we rushed back for the appointment from skiing. 

4. We requested for a private hot fire dinner and they kept diverting us from one person to the other.the dining restaurant get like a dorm mess during dinner with too many people and no COVID protocols. Food is over priced and takes long to come. I also waited for 30 mins for my dosa at breakfast, which ultimately didn’t come.

5. Next e come to the Shisha lounge and they tell us that Shisha’s are all over when again we had messaged and requested for it ! Again another one.. 

I kept trying to get kn touch with the manager but they kept diverting us from one perosn to the other. 

Why is the hotel overbooked if they can’t accommodate guests? If I’m paying this amount I would like the hotel to accommodate us on experiences. Otherwise I would have just stayed at Highland Park ! The hotel is overhyped and is monopolising being the only 5 star here. 

The best part of our Gulmarg experience was the 2 day skiing and the gondola. The local instructors and the tour guides are very sweet and click a lot of pictures for you. Yes amaing ones ! And there is Yaseen bhai who has a shop outside highland park hotel - he is an awesome tour guide. Do yourself a favour, save 35K a night and stay at Highland Park.

reviews.author: sarojpatni2
reviews.title: Outstanding stay
reviews.text:
In last 50 years of our married life we have traveled extensively throughout India and at least 40 other countries. This gave us a chance to stay at  several superb hotels. But in our opinion this hotel should rank at top three out of them if not at number 1. We are so pleased by our selection of this superb property for our 50th anniversary celebrations. From very smooth and dignified check in to emotional check out everything was perfect. 

One of the most beautiful  large room we have stayed,classy furniture, superb Mountain View, big clean beautiful bathroom, extremely clean linen and towels, noise free sound sleep on very very comfortable bed were few of the things we would like to mention.

Apart from these delicious food, fast room service, very polite knowledgeable ever eager ready to serve staff added much more pleasure to our memorable stay.

Well spread buffet breakfast with outstanding service despite jam packed morning is another thing we must add in our list.

Overall we can safely say that in our entire stay we could not find a single thing to complain which was very disappointing for us senior citizens who always try to find faults in high end properties 😉

As my wife and I both are above 70 we were assuming this will be our last visit to beautiful, lovely,charming Kashmir but 
this hotel has made us to rethink about our plans. Just for this gem of a hotel we will try to visit again sometime in near future during winter to enjoy the beautiful moments.

Definitely a full 10 out of 10 to this lovely lovely hotel. Will recommend our friends and family members to stay in The Khyber for long lasting beautiful memories .

Would again like to thank the entire management team and staff for their outstanding services and thoughtfulness. God bless them all. Please keep it up!!

reviews.author: Shiksha
reviews.title: Disappointing Honeymoon Stay
reviews.text:
When you think of luxury stays in India, The Khyber Himalayan Resort tops the list. We went their on our honeymoon for 3 days and were heavily disappointed with the hospitality and food served there. We had all our meals at the hotel itself thanks to the lockdown, and to my surprise the staff behavior wasn’t warm at all. However, I would definitely like to give a special mention to the chef who after listening to our food reviews did curate a special dinner for us which wasn’t great either but we appreciate the effort.
When call yourself the only luxury five star in Gulmarg its not just the property and the view but what stands out for me is the hospitality, which was completely missing during our stay along with the food.

For my husband and I khyber really needs to up its game when they charge a bomb!!!

reviews.author: Mr Wajid
reviews.title: Amazing stay
reviews.text:
Location - nestled amongst the gorgeous meadows of Gulmarg, 

Rooms - modern, well appointed with an attention to small details, done up in luscious dark wood. Spotlessly clean and good quality toiletries was the icing on the cake. The housekeeping was meticulous and ensured fresh linen, bedsheets etc for each day during our 5 day stay at the hotel.

Food - the food at khyber was one of the highlights of our stay. Whether it was the breakfast or the tandoori dishes at dinner, the food certainly exceeded our expectations.
While food was splendid, what made it better was the way the restaurant staff understood our taste preferences, would recommend dishes and even make things that were not on the menu on request. 

Service - The one thing that sets this hotel apart is the impeccable service, attention to detail and the courteous attitude of all the staff, from front desk, housekeeping and restaurant. Always eager to please, they ensured that every small request was attended to.

All in all, a delightful stay in a good hotel with warm, personalised, impeccable service. Highly recommended.

Special thanks to Mr Irfan +919797777555 who made all this possible and personally assure us about everthing he booked for us.Much better the expectation.
