reviews.author: Rupal Maru
reviews.title: Scenic beauty!!
reviews.text:
We  stayed in Khyber and it was an amazing experience. 
The resort is beautifully nestled between snow clad mountains. The restaurant staff were also hospitable and courteous. Mr. Vaibhav and Shyam used to ask whether their service is perfect. Its literally heaven on earth. Gulmarg is a treasure to India. The Resort has l'occitane spa, living upto its standards. This type of awe inspiring views we will not get anywhere.

reviews.author: Rishab
reviews.title: Experience of a lifetime
reviews.text: We stayed for a night in the Himalayan view room and the views were breathtaking. Loved the whole vibe of the place. The staffs are extremely courteous and helpful. I got to know Danish and Adil who took us around the property and clicked some gorgeous pictures of us. The whole experience topped off as it was snowing while we stayed there. Me and my wife had a memorable time and we look forward to stay there again.

reviews.author: Akshata Patil
reviews.title: Worst experience!!!
reviews.text:
My husband and I had the misfortune of staying here on our honeymoon. During our stay, we encountered a number of unsatisfactory service.

First, it took more than an hour to check us in even though we had a confirmed reservation. Also, my friend sent an email to the hotel for timely checkin and we received confirmation for the same.
We waited from 2 PM to 3PM to get a room but we were just ignored.
There was no changing room available and we had to literally change in the lobby as we had to attend the skiing session.
Our luggage was simply thrown in the corner.
Second, after our tiring snow activity when we returned to the hotel, we went to the hot water pool.
We were informed that there was no swim wear available and that they were not sure if it will be available the next day too.
The changing room adjacent to the pool was all wet and messy.
No one available to clean the place.
We informed about the unsatisfactory service during checkout and the person attending us simply ignored it.

reviews.author: Deepthi S
reviews.title: A wonderful place to stay!
reviews.text:
I and my husband stayed here in Feb 2021. The resort is beautifully nestled between mountains. One can see the opulence upon entering the hotel's main entrance. The reception staff aren't very active in receiving guests as would be expected in a 5 star. That being said, the restaurant staff are one of the most hospitable and courteous that you can find. Special mention to Mr.Govind and Mr.Iqbal for their great service and ever smiling and pleasant behaviour. Also the manager, a tall, lean, bespectacled person (I don't recollect his name), was also very courteous, sometimes even removing our plates after we were done. They always asked us about our day and if we were enjoying the food. They are a true representation of customer service and hospitality.

The rooms are very cozy and the heating system is top notch. Even when the temperature outside is sub zero, you will feel very normal inside the room. 

One small thing that can be improved is the shower. It had temperature control but did not have flow control. Or maybe it was just with our room. So every time you want hot water, the flow will be at the maximum. This is a waste of water and can be worked upon. 

We had all our meals there itself. The buffet spread was average, nothing special to write about. However the ala carte food is delicious. You should definitely try their mutton biriyani, for that matter any of their mutton dishes. They should really concentrate on improving their buffet spread. Both taste and variety need to be worked upon.

Overall it's the best place to stay in Gulmarg. There are few improvements that are needed but this is an experience not to be missed.

reviews.author: Nikk
reviews.title: One of the best experiences ever had in Gulmarg !
reviews.text:
Well , at the first place I would like to rate the hotel on different attributes 

Room : 5/5
Cleanliness : 5/5
Food : 5/5
Services : 5/5 
Hospitality : 5/5 

Every thing was so so perfect right from the moment we entered the premises till we checked out.

Special thanks to Mr Muzammil from the front desk team who made our stay special ,who met us first while we checked in and helped for all of our requests and helping us all the time by always carrying a smile on his face ! 

I had barely heard for a No for anything we have asked from him and that’s what I call the best hospitality.

Last but not the Least , 
Highly impressed with the hospitality of this property !

reviews.author: Alekya
reviews.title: Gulmarg has our heart
reviews.text: Me and my husband went in the month of January. We stayed at Khyber Himalayan Resort and Spa. The resort offers breath taking views of snow filled Himalayas.Its literally heaven on earth. Gulmarg is a treasure to India. The Resort has l'occitane spa, living up to its standards as always. Hotel staff were very informative and welcoming. Especially Mr Arif has made our stay very comfortable by booking our services and guiding in exploring Gulmarg in the best possible way.

reviews.author: Sumit_Sarawgi
reviews.title: Mixed Emotions
reviews.text:
This review can be little long.

Khyber is a beautiful dream which you will always like to come true. The same thing happened with me. I got lucky to get a room here during my anniversary.

But, the starting of my trip was little upsetting. A small issue happened which could had been handled more professionally and in a more sincere manner which is expected from a star hotel like Khyber. But I think sometimes, you take it lightly and think you can get away with it. But I had to let it go and compromise as I didn't want to spoily 4 nights stay here. I had asked the reception that I wanted to meet the General Manager just to share my feelings but that never happened. I don't know what it was, ego or miscommunication

Secondly, for two consecutive nights, the hotel has blocked their restaurant "Calabash" for VIPs. This was the place where you can relax and have a great evening time when you have nothing to do in Gulmarg. Just think, guests who had come to stay here for 2 nights had no options to relax anywhere else except the lobby which was packed to the brim. Sorry but it felt like a marketplace there with no service as all the help was busy with the VIPs. This feels wrong when your other restaurant "Nouf" and other facilities like the swimming pool is closed due to covid.

Now the good part. The rooms are excellent and brilliant. The people helping you out in the restaurant and other places always have a smile. Special mention to Mr Raees and Mr Firdos who were commendable. The food here is amazing.

I think I will have to come back to experience the real Khyber which I have heard and dreamt of. Hopefully things change for the better..

reviews.author: Ravi Vashi Melwani
reviews.title: The most beautiful resort in INDIA
reviews.text: The Khyber resort Gulmarg  is the most beautiful resort in INDIA. Located in Gulmarg, Kashmir it is lead by  the most dynamic GM Vinit Chhabra accompanied by Front Officer Manager Manzoor, and the team who are  so inspired and motivated, making Khyber Himalayan Spa Resort, among the most amazing resorts that i have visited in  India

reviews.author: Ankit Govil
reviews.title: Beyond word ( Feeling like in Heaven)
reviews.text: Really a great place for couples.Had a wonderful time. Excellent service, cooperative staff, nice rooms. Place well built to add in the beauty of kashmir !! A perfect destination for spending time with your closed ones. Good food. Scenic beauty to the best !! Thanks to Mr Waseem Sultan for excellent service .

reviews.author: Komal
reviews.title: Heavenly Stay
reviews.text:
We stayed in Gulmarg for 2 days. The Khyber is located on the 🔝of mountain 🗻. The view (The Himalyan Range) covered by resort is beyond the expression. 'Barf ki safed chadar aur parvato prr aati hui suraj ki kirane' -awesome. It was a wonderful stay. 
The services and food at re-sort are excellent.

reviews.author: Ayishwaryaya Mukherjee
reviews.title: Visit at Gulmarg
reviews.text: Reached Khyber Resorts at the evening of 18th. Wonderful place in the lap of mountains and trees with snow everywhere. Was warmly welcomed by Mr. Wasim. Offered us kahwa and guided us to our two bedroom cottage. He showed and explained us everything and all necessary intercom extension numbers. I promptly got his service, whenever I needed anything. It was a wonderful stay. The view, room heaters,hot water facility, the staff, food were all mind-blowing. We stayed there for 4days. Must stay, if you visit Gulmarg

reviews.author: Ayishwarya
reviews.title: Staying at Khyber Himalayan Resort and Spa at Gulmarg.
reviews.text:
Visited Gulmarg for 4days in December 2020. The Khyber is just superb.Heavenly stay.The ambience,food,staff, place...everything & everyone was too good to elaborate in words. Agar kahin jannat hain, toh yehin hain, yehin hain, yehin hain
Ayishwarya Mukherjee

reviews.author: Komal Jain
reviews.title: Winter land
reviews.text: Nestled in the most beautiful place of kashmir, Khyber has an amazing interior and view. The hospitality and service was very quick.Mr. Wasim on the front desk was very helpful and Mr.Bilal served us with most amazing food at the restaurant. Although I would suggest them to separate the Veg. and Non- veg section as that would be more comfortable for us. Overall it was a beautiful experience. Would like to visit this property in summer as well 😍🌞

reviews.author: Rishabh
reviews.title: Had the time of our lives!
reviews.text: We went for our honeymoon to Khyber, and the moment we set our foot in the property, we knew we had made the right decision. Mr. Owais greeted us with a smile and kehwas(Kashmiri tea). We were bumped up from the Gulmarg view room to Himalayan view room, and from that moment on, the resort people did everything possible to make our stay memorable, and it sure was. Thank you Khyber, and Mr. Owais for a wonderful stay! Will definitely recommend this place to our friends and family.

reviews.author: Sahil Brahmbhatt
reviews.title: Must visit during winters
reviews.text: Khyber is very good property. Would recommend atleast a 3 night stay during winters. Gulmarg view with balcony would be a very good choice for stay. Mr. Owais & Mr. Firdaus were very helpful & made our stay comfortable. Their hospitality is upto the mark 🙂

reviews.author: ruch69
reviews.title: Luxury in Jannat
reviews.text:
Just back from Gulmarg and The Khyber was the crowning glory of our trip.
The property is par excellence.. It's totally worth it to pay extra to get the Himalayan view room. The majesty of the Himalayas literally seeps into the room. Luxury at its finest.
We had the all inclusive package and though the buffet was awesome in terms of taste, my one complaint was th jiat there was very little local food. I really don't want to be in Kashmir and eat idli for breakfast and hakka noodles for lunch ( though I get it that a lot if people appreciate their own comfort food.)
This is where the awesome staff comes! A  resort is truly made by their staff and nowhere us this more true than the Khyber.
Just mentioning that I really missed having Kashmiri food had Sameer getting the head chef and both of them promising Kashmiri food for all our meals. Bilal who just heard me mentioning that I was craving for Girdha ( a local flatbread) and had it buttered and steaming hot for me at the breakfast table .. and last but not the least , Firdous..at the restaurant, who took such good care of us, that literally..by the time we thought of it, it was in front of us. Kashmiriyat at its best. 
Not to forget Nazir at the resort entrance who ensured that all our excursions were the best.
It was all these people that made The Khyber , the experience that it was.
Apart from the fact that the weather Gods looked kindly upon us and we had awesome weather all throughout the trip.
The Khyber Himalayan Resort and Spa is a fablous property that I would highly recommend .
Please do note that some facilities are not available due to Covid restrictions.

We didn't want to leave....and we definitely will be back 💖

reviews.author: Ayush
reviews.title: Absolutely outstanding
reviews.text:
One of my best experience. Loved the service , food infact everything which this resort is providing. Muzammil has properly guided us and have given us the best service. 
The hotel was very clean throughout, and our room was spacious with everything that we needed

reviews.author: Shaleen A
reviews.title: Superb!
reviews.text: Insane place! superb climate. great hospitality. thanks to junaid, mohd irfaq, mukesh,  chef satya, chef aashish, irfan and firdous. Winter's,  the time to be here. Surprised that hadn't come here before...

reviews.author: Tushar Shah
reviews.title: Anniversary
reviews.text: Awesome!!!! Superb climate! very polite and efficient staff. great property!!! Food quality was also very good. We have been given candlelight dinner to celebrate our anniversary which force a great surprise.

reviews.author: Lali sandhu
reviews.title: Beautiful Khyber
reviews.text: Had an excellent stay at khyber gulmarg.excellnt property with amazing views .very courteous staff.special mention of arif hussain,who ensured our comfort.mr.manzoor who was always there,smiling and ready to help

reviews.author: Meet Jain
reviews.title: Khyber - Heaven on Earth ❤️
reviews.text:
Khyber is the best place for stay at Gulmarg where you will encounter mersmerizing views with every corner designed intricately. It’s abode to premium rooms and first class hospitality. We had an amazing experience at Khyber and cannot forget to mention Mr Arif who did not leave any stone unturned to keep upto the mark and be there for our help when needed. He was very kind to us and made sure we cherish our stay at Khyber

Cheers to the wonderful time spent!♥️

reviews.author: Arshad K
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: The hospitality was great, cleanliness was good, food was nice, menu selection was great, the staff is very prompt and helpful especially mr. Bilal. The property is very nice, overall a wonderful stay

reviews.author: Bharat Premani
reviews.title: The Khyber Himalayan resort & spa
reviews.text:
OMG😍never expected that it could be so beautiful. View from balcony/room or it’s from coffee shop, it’s was like heaven from everywhere.
full value for money. 
Challenge for all switzerland lovers.they will think twice to go anywhere if they once stay in this resort. 
Hospitality at its BEST, in all aspects.
Specially the front office manager Rafi Bhat. very humble & cooperative. 
will come again......sooooonnnnn

reviews.author: Ankita
reviews.title: Gem of kashmir
reviews.text:
Pros
Great service (special mentions to Junaid, Arif and the dosa counter chef). 
Rooms are spacious 
Excellent interiors 
Views are great

Cons
The buffers can have better variety.
The prices can be slighted lowered.

reviews.author: Bo & Bu
reviews.title: Excellent hotel and service
reviews.text: Absolutely loved my stay at Khyber! The hotel is all things magnificent. Situated at a beautiful location, even of not stepping outside hotel, it's totally worth the view from each angle. Felt incredibly special by restaurant staff - FIRDOUS who made each meal special by attending with about passion. He gave us a 5 star dining experience. Would go back anyday for such service.

reviews.author: Ritha
reviews.title: Winter Wonderland
reviews.text:
We visited Khyber for 5 days and stayed in the Himalayan View Rooms. While enough and more has been said about the breathtaking and stunning views around, I’m particularly happy with the service. Firdous and Muzammil were extremely helpful and polite. The rest of the staff were extremely attentive and quick to help as well. The people that really caught my attention was the people clearing the snow out, every morning. Each morning about 5-6 people step out and manually shovel out large amounts of snow to clear the path, for vehicular movement. Despite that, there is a good 300 metres at least that needs to get cleared out, each morning. Those guys were super friendly and at ease, even as the temperature was at -4 for most parts. A huge shoutout to those guys! Suggestion would be to get a guide, it makes life so much easier. Manzoor was our guide there and he made life super easy for us, from getting us to the right places to getting us vehicles with excellent drivers!

The sheer amount of work that goes into ensuring that customers have a good and comfortable time at the property is endearing. Definitely recommend the property, we had a fantastic time!

reviews.author: Jiju
reviews.title: A Paradise Among the snowy mountains
reviews.text:
The khyber Himalayan is a perfect blend of luxury and nature if there ever was one. Its perfect for couples and family. The highlight are the staffs. Mr Firdous(restaurant help), Mr Arif(From Front desk) where particularly praise worthy. They made our stay more than just memorable. Trust me they will take care of your every need even before you feel like.

The food was the next big take away. Prepared by Head Chef sathya was delicious and the best thing was that the dish was not repetitive. You would always be delighted to see something fresh and new to taste.

From the driver Mr Ajaas to our tour guide Mr Manzoor every one will make your experience in khyber worth while.

If all this was not enough the view from literally any part of the resort including the rooms will leave you breathless. You can just spend a whole day sitting in your balcony and admiring the nature around you. 

A must visit place at least once in your lifetime!

reviews.author: jaswinder s
reviews.title: Not worth
reviews.text:
Worst experience in ever had in any hotel. 
Gulmarg is a beautiful place and if u want to book a hotel book any hotel other than Khyber. Don't go for the scenic beauty around the hotel. It's every where in Gulmarg. i would request to book any hotel for 2-3K instead of wasting ur 17K just for the scenic beauty because the food tastes very bad. Seriously guys worst food I have ever tasted. I stayed in Khyber for 3 days and I would like to mention the menu
1. Noodles ( breakfast, lunch and dinner)
2. Dosa ( breakfast, everyday)
3. Pasta( breakfast, lunch and dinner) 
4. Idly (breakfast, everyday)
Worst food and worst services.
I requested the staff to clear the path which was blocked due to heavy snow fall however even after 45 mins the path was not cleared and then I went to the parking lot myself and tried  to clear the snow but failed since it was too much. Then I had to request the manager.
When I checked into the hotel I was told that hot swimming pool and the pool table r open but when u went to use the services I was told they r not.
I wanted to rate the hotel ZERO but I have to give atleast a star.It's the most pethetic hotel I have ever been to.

reviews.author: Nadeem
reviews.title: Amazing and wonderful stay at khyber with warm welcome from arif hussain front office guy.
reviews.text: I had wonder stay  at gulmarg Khyber resort with my wife .....amazing service and staff was wonderful specially arif hussain. We stayed there for one night ...food was amzing and we have wonder view from our room ..must visit place

reviews.author: Manav A
reviews.title: Fabulous Hospitality
reviews.text:
Great property, superb hospitality by front desk specially Arif , musharaf and the whole khyber team.. splendid views of Gulmarg and a property to remember. The food was 5 on 5 and spread was good. 
Staff was very polite and sweet.

reviews.author: Piyush Jain
reviews.title: Appreciation
reviews.text: Amazing view, amazing service, amazing ambience, calm staff, best guide Arif from front office who made our over all trip memorable great humanity! We would wish to be there soon with same guide and the best hotel...Thank you.

reviews.author: Ashish goyal
reviews.title: Muzamil @khyber
reviews.text: It's an amazing experience with khyber. Staff is very competitive Specially Muzamil. We are here for our honeymoon i must say it is the most beautiful property through out my trip. And food is great too.. must visit🙂

reviews.author: Prem
reviews.title: Absolutely appalling customer service
reviews.text:
I’d book a stay for 3 nights in JAN and due to excess snow we had to cancel our trip since the flights were cancelled to Srinagar. 
I requested for a refund and it’s been two months to date the hotel staff including the accounting team has been giving vague reasons for not refunding the amount. The latest one being, they’re short of cash as they had to pay other vendors. It’s been two months+ and am still chasing them.

reviews.author: Jaydeepshah
reviews.title: Heaven in Gulmarg only at Khyber
reviews.text:
This was my 2nd visit to khyber . Last visit was in march 2015 and this was feb 2020 . Khyber is one of the most luxurious holiday resort in india - kashmir gulmarg. Starting from welcome at reception to stay at rooms ( gulmarg view with balcony ) meals , temperature controlled swimming pool etc . . Mr.Ameer receptionist was very helpful.  
Scope of improvements : Time to change matters in room ,  as it is made of spring and it is very bouncy . I suggest that Hotel should give detailed suggestions abt the things to do in gulmarg , like sledge ride , gondola ride , ski , snow biking,  tube sledge. ATV ride etc . When ever we asked we didn't  got the detailed answer and end of the trip we missed on to ATV ride and tube sledge ( must do ) . 

During winter gulmarg view room or Himalayan view room ( premium ) both are same .

reviews.author: Jimit Kothari
reviews.title: Super Resort, Super Service
reviews.text:
Visited Khyber resort and spa for celebrating first year anniversary. Great welcome and amazing service from the staff.

Special mention to Mr Firdous and Mr Raees for going out of their way to ensure our stay at the resort was worth the while.

The staff has been amazingly trained and groomed and you will feel very homely and welcomed in Kashmir.

Definitely recommended. You will not regret.

reviews.author: Ram1975
reviews.title: White KASHMIR!!!
reviews.text:
It snowed heavily during our short stay and the green turned into white overnight... just amazing

Do take a room with balcony to enjoy the views and the rooms are large and perfect

Hotel is definitely the best in whole Gulmarg and just a walk away from Gondola ride where you can do various snow activities

Food is also fresh and their Italian preparations are too good

Hotel was almost full but the staff takes good care of you!!

Will be back next winters!!!

reviews.author: Nikhil Javeri
reviews.title: Magical Fairytale - The Khyber Himalayan Resort
reviews.text:
We were completely overwhelmed and mesmerised with the beautiful resort. It is truly located at the best place in Gulmarg amidst the pine trees. We were also taken aback by their warm hospitality extended by the courteous staff . The rooms were exceptionally clean with the best
 view one can get, house keeping was done on a timely basis, the swimming pools location is excellent, the restaurant has a great variety of food with extremely tasty delicacies. All our special requests were taken good care of.

Special mention to Basharat, Mohd Rafi, Kader and Firdous for their excellent services and always taking good care of us.

A visit to Gulmarg is incomplete without 
a stay in Magical Khyber resort.

reviews.author: Ankit_divine
reviews.title: Amazing. This is how Jannat will be.
reviews.text:
We have just spent 3 wonderful days here and were sorry to leave. Me and my friend celebrated our wedding anniversary at this beautiful place.

 Our stay at Khyber resort was the highlight of our vacation in Jammu n Kashmir. The resort is located in the most spectacular part of Gulmarg with great views from the resort. And is near to all the major attractions like golf course and gondola.

This is a centrally heated resort which was a boon during the winter as we visited with sub zero temperatures. The rooms are amazing in size, tastefully furnished with state of art bathroom and heavenly views!! Our view outside was straight out of a fairytale!!

Built passionately and tastefully by Mr. Umer Tramboo. Who is such a gem of a person. We were fortunate enough to meet him personally. He even invited us for the dinner. Such a down to earth person. 

To mention Mr Hamid helped us out during over stay. He took care of all our needs no matter what. (Dont rem his department as he helped in every matter).

The hotel doesn’t serve/sell alcohol but you’re welcome to bring your own booze and sit in the sisha lounge and drink. This worked out quite comfortably. There is service there and you get everything you need. A SHOUTOUT to Firdous, at the Shisha lounge. His service was exemplary.

The property has heated pool which has breathtaking views of snow clad mountains no words can explain beauty of this place..

We would certainly return to this hotel as its locatiom is perfect, the staff are friendly and obviously well trained and the facilities are excellent.

reviews.author: Amruta Shirodkar
reviews.title: Mesmerising!
reviews.text:
Me and my husband celebrated our wedding anniversary at this beautiful place. The hotel is simply superb. A perfect winter destination!! The rooms offer excellent views of the snow covered mountains. The rooms are centrally heated and very comfortable even at - 10 outside ❄!! The food is simply superb. All the staff are extremely polite and co operative. The spa is very good. We visited it twice. Swimming pool is heated and there's excellent jacuzzi, steam and sauna. The gondola is walking distance and we went upto phase one for sking.
They have some excellent hookah. Breakfast spread at cloves was excellent.
Keep it up khyber!! We look forward to visiting you again.

reviews.author: Aman-Tekriwal
reviews.title: Indeed heaven on earth !
reviews.text: Have been fortunate to visit 24 countries across Asia, Europe, America, Africa & Australia, can say with 100% confidence that nothing beats the experience we had at Khyber at Gulmarg ! Beautifully surrounded by picturesque snow clad landscape. Tastefully furnished in line with the local culture and yet equipped with all modern amenities one can think of. Spa, pool, health club and much more. Junaid at the restaurant, Hamid at the front desk and Asif at airport went out of their way to ensure that we had a great experience. Will definitely return and send friends and family as well

reviews.author: Mohit B
reviews.title: Ignorant, rude and disrespectful Mr......!!
reviews.text:
We contacted khyber Himalayan resort for a two day visit on 27 and 28 dec 2019 for 6 pax , 3 rooms and asked if they can offer us some discounts on their base online price! We were shocked with the rude behavior of the sales manager who rudely refused any discounts and rather hung up the phone saying # I have something more productive than talking to you at the moment#!! 

The hotel industry runs on the courtesy extended to their guests or prospective guests and they should treat all of them equally! But this man representing khyber is making everyone hate this place! This attitude shall shatter the business of the hotel completely slowly and steadily! 

Such individuals should be demoted of their jobs because their attitude is highly unprofessional demeaning attitude!

reviews.author: Chaitya
reviews.title: Amazing service and a beautiful place to be
reviews.text:
The view is amazing.The service was exceptional.food was also amazing.
The staff is very friendly. At front desk Sakib was great. In restaurant Firdos parray was great exceptional service by him. In Calabash great service was given by Danish he was great with Sheesha

reviews.author: Bob A
reviews.title: Not 5 Star
reviews.text:
The vista from this hotel is exceptional with snow covered peaks from our balcony. And the food at the hotel restaurant during dinner (night) is very good.
But the place is quite dark and dingy and the hot water in the shower in the room wasn’t hot enough. The insulation between rooms is poor as we were annoyed by the constant screaming of a young child next door. The bainne maree food at breakfast times is like many other hotels in India in that it is not served hot and the choices are poor unless you like Indian breads - to make matters worse breakfast is not served until 8.00 am in the morning which is too late for those travelling to new destinations. All in all disappointing for such a lovely and pristine area

reviews.author: Sunil Bhavnani
reviews.title: Heavenly Khyber
reviews.text: One place in India which comes closer to a dream come true is The Khyber Gulmarg. Located at the peak of Gulmarg, covered with white snow bed, is a must visit property. Has a royal and rich interiors. The Himalayan view room category is the icing on the cake. This one is for the bucket list.

reviews.author: Shobhika G
reviews.title: Superb hospitality
reviews.text:
It was really one of best experience...Khyber having very nice ambience , very well staff.they have a warm pool you can swim with a snow view..
The jacuzzi service in the spa was outstanding and staff ‘ Ruqaya’ done brilliant job ...her service was excellent in jacuzzi and Sona bath places... we really delighted by her comfortable services in ladies bath area..

reviews.author: Monish A
reviews.title: Fantastic property, excellent staff and hospitality
reviews.text:
From the moment you step into the property till the time you leave, all you experience is world class hospitality and smiling faces by the staff. 
The entire team is courteous and willing to help guests no matter what time of the day it is. 
There was never a dull moment while we were at the hotel. The location is amazing especially if you have the Himalayan view by your balcony. 
The food is good with loads of variety catering to both vegetarian and meat eaters. 
Every corner of hotel is clean and well maintained. 
You will be greeted by helpful Jehangir at front office who will be more than willing to guide you with everything. 
Even the security staff is amazing and would always greet you and help you sort out with ski gear. 
Special shout out to both Amir and shayista at the pool area who went out of the way to help guests and us, enjoy the facilities available. They were more than happy to click amazing pictures of us without any sign of unhappiness considering they were working long shifts and were always on their toes to take good care of guests. 
Must visit property.

reviews.author: Ro P
reviews.title: Unreasonable
reviews.text:
We had booked this hotel when we were visiting India.  About 4 days before we were suppose to visit - there was a terrorist attack in the area where 40+ people died.  With this place being on the no visit list - we tried to cancel our reservations.  The hotel was so unreasonable that they used the no-refund policy on us at that point.  I understand if we were trying to cancel a reservation for personal reasons but this is something that was out of our control.  The hotel won’t acknowledge that there is a curfew there with 350,000 active troops there.  What kind of social self awareness is this?? They want us to still come to the war zone and stay at their hotel?? 

The ridiculousness of this is that when we were calling their employees weren’t in at work at times due to the curfew and military in town!! I just had high expections from a hotel like this.

I don’t think I would ever stay here again!

reviews.author: Nikhil Kanungo
reviews.title: Excellent property & Hospitality
reviews.text:
Excellent views with luxurious services.
Great swimming pool & great food 👍🏻
Good time to chill & stay in hotel especially during winters & snowfalls..

Evening you can spend time @ Sheesha lounge (Known as Calabash lounge)
The manager Of Calabash lounge is so good he can provide you any kind of demands in food.. As we are pure vegetarian he gave us exactly what we want even if the item is not in the menu.. This was the best of all experience..

Also a very bad service of Khyber was during check out when there was snow fall & the road to Khyber was jammed by snow, none of the car’s were able to come up to Khyber to pick us (as the resort is located 300mts of sloppy drive). Khyber did not provide any of the facilities to the customers to drop them till the end of the Resort enterance even after requesting so much as this slope was only & only made to operate the Khyber resorts. So we hired snow mobiles (which were available at hotel lobby itself) & paid 3000/- just for 300mts for 2 person.
This was the worst experience of Khyber .

reviews.author: marmik m
reviews.title: Brilliant Stay , surreal experience
reviews.text: A lovely property to stay at the staff is extremely warm and friendly and will be at your service for all your needs ( a special shout out to Shahid ( 07006575092) get in touch with him to truly experience gulmarg he is the true meaning of Kashmiriyat )

reviews.author: Jassani
reviews.title: Amazing Resort!!
reviews.text:
A stay in Khyber Himalyan Resort & Spa, Gulmarg is indeed an enlightening experience with its beautiful surroundings and surreal beauty. Our group of 8 stay there for two nights. The people at Khyber are truly amazing with their warm hospitalities and eagerness to please and pamper you. If in Gulamrg Khyber is the one and only choice to experience true Kashmiri hospitality!
Kudos to the Khyber Team!!

reviews.author: as2722
reviews.title: Remarkably extraordinary! One of the most amazing stays I have ever had!
reviews.text:
If you are going to Kashmir on leisure, Khyber is an experience you must not miss! It's one of the most amazing properties I have ever stayed in. Proximity to the Gondola, beautiful location, well-maintained property, and extremely courteous and responsive staff are just a few of the qualities I can begin with. From their vast spread in dining to their amazing menu of pillows, it's all fabulous.
I took a package tour and was advised against staying at Khyber (reasons unknown to me), but I can tell you it was a complete value-for-money decision. 
If you can, you must - is all I would say.

reviews.author: Kanchan S
reviews.title: Grateful for hospitality!
reviews.text: Khyber can be truely defined as Paradise on the earth. Here I would like to highlight something beyong stay experience. We were in Khyber during New year 2019. On the day of our travel back to Delhi, got informed by Indigo airline about cancellation of flight due to weather concern and was scheduled for next day travel. Mr. Asif Hussain who represents Khyber and work at Srinagar airport turned out to be a saviour. He was their to guide us at airport in such tough time. He went extra miles to look into feasible options with all other airlines and finally got us boarded in the earliest available flight. He been kind, humble and cooperative. I can't thank him enough for the relentless effort he put forward to help us the best way. We highly recommend his services and Kashmir memories would always be cherished for people like them. Thank you Asif Bhai! God bless You.

reviews.author: 25capetown
reviews.title: Anniversary treat
reviews.text:
We stayed early January at the Khyber Gulmarg, what a treat !!!
The property is nestled amongst the Himalayan slopes and was surrounded by snow. The hotel is impeccably appointment in this rather off beat location. The service & food served was of international standard in Kashmir. We were spoilt by the kitchen for our 28th Wedding Anniversary, thank you, highly recommend this stunning retreat !!!

reviews.author: prachi2017
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text:
We stayed at khyber for 2 nights, loved the resort.
Rooms are cozy and warm, great food options, Sheeha(hukka), no bar but you can carry your own and they allow to drink in the dedicated cafe.
Hotel as a heated pool, this was one of the Best exp. to be in the pool and see snow covered mountains!
If you are planning gulmarg, plz make sure you stay at khyber it not for the whole trip, at least one night.
Staff is friendly and goes out of the way to make you feel at home!

reviews.author: Parinitha S
reviews.title: Truly a Five Star Experience
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed at Khyber for two nights from 22nd to 24th Dec. From the minute we entered till we checked out, everything was as perfect as it could be. The decor and architecture of the hotel truly depict Kashmir's heritage. The views are to kill for, food is delectable, and the heated pool is all you could ask for in the chilly winters.
The staff is courteous and super helpful. All you need to do is ask and it shall be taken care of.
Also, the Gulmarg Gondola is only a 5-minute walk from the hotel.
We will certainly return for a longer stay here.

reviews.author: Radha Thakershy
reviews.title: Best Anniversary stay at Khybar
reviews.text: Amazing location food and aminities...though need to improve on its housekeeping services ,it's pool ,steam and sauna facilities .....our room was blissful facing the Himalayas.... Special thanks to Khalida Lone for helping us in everything... Looking forward to visit again in summer

reviews.author: Apoorva Thakershy
reviews.title: Perfect destination for anniversary
reviews.text:
We were looking for best place in Kashmir to celebrate our 20th anniversary on 5th dec... we got booking in Khyber ... really best place as superb location, nice yummy food, excellent service. We booked premier rooms but at the time of check in we requested for upgrade.. we got superb response and warm welcome by Khalida Lone .. she managed himalian view room at good rate... because of her we also get cake .. thnx to Khalida for best hospitality... 
only improvement required is in swimming pool and sauna and steam rooms...

reviews.author: FarzanaKhanSA
reviews.title: Kashmir 2018
reviews.text:
Awesome hotel with first class service. Upon arrival we were welcomed by Mudasir, the attendant at reception. He gave us a tour of the property and seated us down to a hot cup of Kessar Kahwar (Saffron Kashmiri tea), while the staff took our luggage to the room. The rich and oppulent intricate carvings and Mughal Deco are warm and inviting against the icy and snowy mountains. Luxurious and tranquil environment making it the perfect hide away to escape daily stresses. The resort offers heated pools against glass walls facing the snowy mountains... breathe taking. Breakfast was an absolute treat with Bilal and his team meticulously attending to our every need. 
The perfect retreat where guests are Royalty!

reviews.author: SATISH
reviews.title: The KHYBER
reviews.text: Super property super location amazing whether.... 7 star hospitality good staff specially house keeping is jus too good mentioning the name (Mr Kaiser)... Food is jus amazing... World's most beautiful place is GULMARG that to in THE KHYBER

reviews.author: TheBeckhams421
reviews.title: Food absolutely delicious
reviews.text: We were driven up to Gulmarg from Srinagar, amongst the first to be able to reach the resort in a regular car after an unexpected heavy snowfall. A lot of men were standing around in town. We staggered along the road towards the hotel, nearly being knocked into a ditch by a convoy of army vehicles. So by the time we arrived at this haven we were more than a little distressed. We were served first class Kashmiri tea sat next to the important military personage (and family) whose arrival had just about caused our demise ... Followed by lunch. By far the best and most sophisticated food we'd had up to that point whilst staying In other first class hotels on this our fifth trip to the sub-continent. The waiter spoke perfect English and came from one of the villages. Really good to have a proper chat with someone. We shared Kashmiri lamb in a sublime tangy sauce and lotus roots in a different delicious sauce. This was a welcome interlude in a somewhat stressful day. For the standard of cuisine and the quality of service we actually thought it was good value. If you're going to splash out on fine dining somewhere then this is the place. We imagine it would be wonderful to stay there.

reviews.author: Sgm
reviews.title: Amazing staff ! It's the USP OF KHYBER
reviews.text:
The hotel is a beautiful property . This review is as honest as it gets. 
Well maintained rooms but nothing that will blow you out. The rooms are like any others luxury hotels . Infact the only thing that blows your mind is the view. So basically you are paying for the view. (Which in winters is totally worth it ) 
What I loved the most was the staff , irrespective of the general protocals these luxury hotel have , I found the staff extremely sweet and helpful ( More than the average ) specifically I found Miss Khalida lone super efficient and amazingly courteous . She knew her job really well and went an extra mile to make us feel welcomed .  Some people leave a great impression on your mind and she totally did that. 
Food is a little disappointment as compared to the rest of the good things. 
Spa Center is amazing .
Staff is beyond amazing and totally cooperative.
Ambience is beautiful
View from the room is to die for.

Only drawback are
Food and the less of wow factors in bedrooms( like mini Bar options , room snacks , good teas n coffee bar options , good toiletries are few things missing ) 

Rest it’s a worthwhile place

reviews.author: Mahendra Soni
reviews.title: Experience the Best Window view!
reviews.text:
I planned my trip just seven day in advance and after going through couple of articles I decided that Khyber seems to be the only luxury choice available in Kashmir. I did not know much about the property so had very limited expectations But as soon I checked in and entered my room I could not believe the view I saw from the Balcony. in onne word BREATHTAKING. Some important points
 - Always choose the Himalayn View room even if you have to pay a big premium. Trust me even a 500% premium is worth it.
- Bring your Alchohal yes Bring your Alchoal
- Bring your Swimming accessories or else you will miss the best swimming experience in all weatherbest indoor swimming pool (google Kyber swimming pool view)
- They serve good (not great) food and the menu is vast. The best thing is they serve many varieties of good tea which is a major plus for me. Their Kawa is not that great cause they add sugar.
- Their temperature control in the hotel is superb so you can travel anytime of the year.
- Their staff wont talk to you. Yes this is the only and biggest minus. They need to address this problem urgently if they want to meet global stanndard of hospitality. 

I could actully write 5000 words review of this property but just wanted to highlight some major poinnts.

reviews.author: sidra k
reviews.title: Best experience
reviews.text: It was my honeymoon trip to Kashmir and we had heard about this beautiful & luxurious hotel. We booked it and when we reached there, the property was huge and no words could compare the beauty surrounded it, the lady at the reception (Khalida), on hearing that my husband & I were on our honeymoon, gladly made arrangements and shifted us to the Himalayan view luxury room. The service was quick and food was very tasty. We spent some time in there heated pool, enjoying the view of himayas and beautiful huge Pine trees. In all our stay at Khyber was memorable and we still remember it beauty & serenity.

reviews.author: The Wanderer
reviews.title: 85 key resort is framed at every vantage point by nature at its most spectacular.
reviews.text:
A world away from the ordinary, this 85 key resort is framed at every vantage point by nature at its most spectacular. The world’s highest ski lift, the Gulmarg Gondola – which takes you to Kongdoori Mountain, is only a short walk away. Meadows and forests that have enchanted travellers for centuries wait to be explored by trekking enthusiasts and undying romantics. 
Clad in locally sourced pine and slate, the resort is built in a style true to the architectural heritage of Kashmir. In every way the indoors mirror the beauty of the outdoors. Speciality restaurants, a Sheesha lounge, a well-appointed spa and a heated swimming pool are amongst the necessary luxuries in place. Add to these other thoughtful additions like our children’s club, a mini theatre and a dedicated Activities Concierge and you will find The Khyber is a resort at par with the best in the world.

reviews.author: GoTravellerz India
reviews.title: Once in a lifetime experience
reviews.text:
It was once in life time experience for me and my wife.Its a must stay luxury resort in india. Snowfall added the fun to another level. Will surely love to visit again.Luxury & Nature are its best at Khyber.Heated Pool was the best part og the resort which gives you the opportunity to swim & relax with minus 10 degrees temperature outside the glass.

Rooms are well maintained.
View from the room is heavenly.
Resturant serves great food.

reviews.author: manjusampat
reviews.title: Beautiful property
reviews.text: Conveniently located near the picturesque, green main meadow in Gulmarg, the Khyber Himalayan Resort and spa, is a stunning property. It is set in the midst of majestic pine trees and Deodhars, and has some amazing views. The lobby is large and inviting and the hotel also has lovely restaurants. The rooms are comfortable and the hotel organises sightseeing tours for their guests

reviews.author: naushad97
reviews.title: best hotel in gulmarg
reviews.text: Khyber is the best place to stay in gulmurg ,very good service and nice food ,very nice and clean room,have a temperature pool ,must stay in this resort when visiting gulmarg we have a very good time there

reviews.author: Tejas J
reviews.title: The best in Gulmarg !!
reviews.text:
I had visited this property in first week of march for 3 nights. Let me be clear this is a no where close to 5 star property,unlike other grand 5 stars I have stayed at, they only have one restaurant and neither they have any activities for their guests, however this is the best luxury property Gulmarg has currently.(and only one with heated pool ) 

We had booked  Luxury room Gulmarg View but upgraded it to Himalayan view and the view was worth the extra bucks. Our check in was seamless , being offered to sit in lobby area while our formalities were being taken care of .At check in Mr Sakib from front desk was assisting us, and we requested him if there were any room with Himalayan view were available to which he promptly replied "yes there are and that will be additional".We requested him that we need to see his senior(to discuss the upgrade thing), he went inside was back in 30 seconds saying that his senior is busy in a meeting,to which we asked him to see us whenever he is available, and without any fuss we checked in our room.I was expecting his senior to call me or meet me during my 3 nights stay but not once did Sakib or his senior bothered to call or ask. Pretty arrogant  and very unprofessional attitude for front desk staff and not expected especially when you are being charged a bomb.
My room's remote wasn't working and neither was the telephone handset, even the indirect lighting weren't working,this didn't bothered me but this small things which always matters.

the positives
1) Majority of staff will sport sweet Kashmiri smile on their face.
   Special mention for Restaurant staff Aijaz, Iqbal, Irfan for their superb hospitality and       their senior Mr Mukesh, (F and B manager) .Trust me this team is only reason we had all meals in restaurant inspite of not booking all meals package.Front desk Ms Pakeeza is also very helpful and always available at your disposal, sadly our interaction happened only during check out.
2) we did not book for all meals package and I suggest don't, as their al Carta menu is extensive and the food is yummy.we had all 6 meals there, it costs us much lesser than  all meals package
3) Spa by locctaine is good and the rates are on par with other star hotels
4) heated pool 
Gulmarg itself is beautiful and you will be wowed by Gulmarg's beauty.
A must visit place to people to who want to have luxury at their disposal at remotest location and don't shelling out extra.

reviews.author: Vivek S
reviews.title: Winter paradise!
reviews.text: The Khyber Himalayan resort & Spa is undoubtedly one of the most luxurious resorts in India. Absolutely stunning property with the views of snow capped mountains all around. The best part of the hotel is the heated swimming pool which is a real delight after a long day. The food is very good however we did not find any Kashmiri Speciality dishes in the buffet hence we ordered the wazwan which was fantastic. The staff are very warm and friendly, they served us a lovely mug of hot chocolate on the upper deck in the evening. Overall a truly memorable stay. We got a lovely room with a large balcony.

reviews.author: Abhishekduta
reviews.title: Service is appaling
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Khyber for 2 nights. The property is beautiful especially the heated pool. Its get crowded at time but you can still enjoy. the location of the hotel is also good, only 5 minutes walk from the hotel is the Gandola. However everything is a let down due to the poor service offered by the staff (only at restaurant). They are extremely rude. 
The food is also average and overly priced.

reviews.author: MomTravels
reviews.title: Staff unpleasant
reviews.text:
Price: is way too much for the food offered. For 2 adult it came up to about ₹5000 

Staff: We were only getting used to the courteous nature of people in Kashmir and this came along and left a bitter taste for us. Hmmm 

The ambience is great. The view from Tea lounge is simply breathtaking. 

Overall, it’s a great climb from Gulmarg but not worth the trouble.

reviews.author: Dr.Mallika A
reviews.title: Luxury in paradise ❤️
reviews.text:
I visited this place during my birthday weekend I.e 23-26th feb 2018 with my husband..This place is pure luxury and just wowwwwww . We were greeted by khalida and were offered the most yum kahwa , with a stunning view 😍, after that we were escorted to our mountain view room, the room was spacious and had a lovely surprise organised by my hubby and khalida, with balloons and flowers. The hotel is centrally heated, so it's really comfortable inside . The best and most stunning part of the hotel is the heated swimming pool, the view is just wow and as compared to outside temperature, the pool is quiet warm which is really comfortable. The steam, sauna and jacuzzi is complimentary and it's really neat and clean. The staff roohie, beenish, yasir and bilal. All are really sweet and helping. This hotel has an amazing spa with a stunning view from the room. Me and my husband we both got spa done and it was really relaxing and perfect . Thank you Mhonyami and James for the amazing spa 😃. Tho alcohol is not served in the hotel but u can bring ur own and have it in ur room and also in the restaurant name sheesha which also serve sheesha 😍. Skiing area is very near by the resort which is a plus point! The breakfast has a lot of options and the food is amazing by the way . And it has this beautiful view .. actually the whole hotel has this stunning view and we were lucky to witness the snowfall and that too on my birthday 🎉🎂 which was amazing surprise ❤️ and after the snow it all looked liked a beautiful Narnia (from the movie)  . I would recommend this place to everyone . Come with friends or family bring ur kids along .. it's superb and has the best of everything ! I would love to thank specially khalida for the amazing and yum cake she made for me on my birthday. And to the whole staff of the resort . It's a must visit place and yes it's a luxury in paradise .. ❤️ will be coming soon again. 😃 
P.S - mountain view rooms have the best view and yes perfect time to visit is Dec- march (specially for snow and ski lovers )

reviews.author: miteshmanek
reviews.title: beautiful...serene..excellent PR...
reviews.text:
surperb is the word...in all aspects...courteous staff (special mention Mr. Mukesh Singhji)..very nice food spread..we checked in a little early ...welcome drink being the kahwa (kashmiri tea)..the staff courteously guided us to our room..and i must mention very well done interiors ...yes its close to the gondola so just walk down to it...we had a balcony room ..though facing the city side its was very peaceful...must mention the beauty of swimming in a heated pool surrounded by ice capped mountains...
thank you for excellent service and all the best...

reviews.author: pagarwalmumbai
reviews.title: Luxorious Hotel in Gulmarg
reviews.text: The hotel is perfect for stay in winter in Gulmarg, with centrally heating. The service is fantastic, the staff very friendly. Food is also very good. Rooms are comfortable. The hotels has a spa which is also very good.

reviews.author: Loes W
reviews.title: Swanky resort in walking distance to the slopes
reviews.text: We stayed at the Khyber at the recommendation of someone from Srinagar who said the hotel was the best in all of Kashmir. The hotel isn't cheap but a lot of fun to splurge on for a night. The service is impeccable and the rooms are wonderful. A highlight was the massive bath tub which overlooks the Himalaya (ask for a Himalaya view when you book). The restaurant is decent though the buffet didn't look like anything special (we went a la carte). The hotel doesn't serve any alcohol but you're welcome to bring your own if you want to savour a glass of red in the aforementioned tub. The old school grandeur as well as the location of this hotel made me want to bust out a tricycle and race over the carpet croaking 'Redrum'. A very fun experience all in all.

reviews.author: Rohini Leekha
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text:
The property is beautiful. Experience right from check in to the last date was amazing. Beautiful and serene surroundings. The view from our Himalayan view room was totally worth it. We were lucky to experience snowfall and admire the beauty right from the balcony of our room.

The service is excellent too. Qadir from housekeeping was very helpful and ensured our stay was comfortable. The staff at breakfast was also very nice. Basically the people there go out of their way to help you. 

Simply loved the overall experience. A must visit especially during winters. Will definitely visit in summers too for a totally different experience.

reviews.author: Punjabisanjay
reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text: We went for a 3 night stay to Gulmarg and stayed in this amazing resort . wonderful perfect weather . it was walking distance from the cable car ride and we had a blast on the snow Mobiles . It snowed on the 2nd day and we played in the snow . Amazing feeling to see the snow all around you . The hotel staff is very very polite and go out of their way to please you . Manzoor , Mukesh , khaleeda all of them are exceptional hosts . Super good food served in the restaurant though slightly on the expensive side . They are generous in serving yummy kavha  tea throughout our stay . It's a magical experience to play in the snow . Would love to go again . Truly the Switzerland of India .

reviews.author: jaanvi m
reviews.title: Great staff and amazing hospitality
reviews.text: Khyber indeed justifies being heaven on earth. The property is very well situated and offers breathtaking views from everywhere. The hotel staff makes an add on to make your stay the most memorable . They are so generous and warm and are available 24*7 to provide help. I would like to give a special thanks to chef manish sharma , mr vishal and miss khalida for providing such great hospitality that one would want to visit the hotel time and again. Thankyou to these people for making our stay worth the money.

reviews.author: Ruchika B
reviews.title: Anniversary getaway
reviews.text:
A truly magical property with beauty and grace. The Khyber is everything you are looking for in terms of luxury and hospitality. The experience of having  the local version of tea-khewa  by their scenic tea lounge Chaikash window is a true delight. The property promises to chill and thrill with its gorgeous views and heated indoor pool in the midst of snow claded mountains all around. 
The staff was warm and courteous. A great choice for our anniversary, a truly memorable experience!

reviews.author: Punit Gadhia
reviews.title: Good property!! Rooms with MOUSE
reviews.text:
Check in: Quick n easy. Were upgraded to a luxury himalayan view room 

Food: 
breakfast not as per 5 star standards. It was brief and similar to a 3 star offerings. We have been to Hyatt and Taj. And nothing compares to the spread that they offer. Surprisingly, Kashmir being a state offering abundant dry fruits, we didnt see any of the dry fruit being served during the breakfast. 

Lunch and dinner: overpriced as compared to the portions that were offered. 

Room ambience: 
Good view of the Himalayan range from the balcony. Decent ambience. 

Good toiletries. Spacious bathroom 

Now coming to the most horrifying and depressing part of our stay:

WE SPOTTED A MOUSE INSIDE OUR ROOM (2021). OH MY GOD!!!! Yes u read it right. A MOUSE.....

Does this sound familiar to anyone else... 

after spending a BOMB and hoping to receive the best of luxury services. Its indeed horrifying to have rodent infested rooms. On questioning we get a response that since its winter time, thats why maybe the rodent must have ventured in. 

Seriously!!!! 

Staff’s reaction on the MOUSE issue:
Housekeeping staff tried his best to assist but in vain

No Manager came inspite of us asking for one to come and meet us. I agree to one of the travellers review that the staff at Khyber are taking their guests for Granted. 

The Manager came to meet us only after we settled our bills. This was just Ridiculous on his part being a Manager. Shame on you Mr. Manzoor. By the look of it we understand that this was not taken seriously by any of the staff. 

Highly disappointed!!

reviews.author: abdullahs682
reviews.title: Totally not worth it 😔
reviews.text:
Overrated 
Overpriced 
Pathetic food
No value for money 
Thermostats were not synchronised 
The room didn’t have a proper view, it was mostly blocked wen asked for a change they didn’t cooperate and asked for more money lol..
Very disappointed

Won’t advise at all
