reviews.author: rs11234567
reviews.title: Huge, Heavenly Property in the Paradise
reviews.text: Everything was just fantastic. The management is awesome and the staff is very friendly and polite. The property is huge and beautiful. The location is just perfect and you dont want to leave the hotel. Whenever I visit Gulmarg again, I am sure Khyber will top the list of to-do's. Thank you Team Khyber for making our stay special

reviews.author: Vidushi G
reviews.title: Experience jannat in jannat
reviews.text:
What an experience it was to stay at Khyber resort in Gulmarg?! From the check in to our stay to meals to their service, everything was perfect.
The whole resort was covered in snow n the beauty surrounding it was unparalleled. The views were to die for that to from the comfort of your hotel room.
Their sheesha was amazing as we sat there in the night for few hours.
The staff was super courteous and the service was prompt.
Not to forgot, welcome with the hot kahwa drink when you checkin just sets the tone for an awesome time to come..

reviews.author: Kunal N
reviews.title: Luxury amidst Nature
reviews.text: We stayed here for 3 nights to celebrate our anniversary in this January, 2018. It is a beautiful property & very well maintained rooms & very warm staff who welcome you with some awesome Kahwa. Kashmir is a must visit for every Indian ! It is the most beautiful part of our country that we should be proud of. It has decent workout gym & a very good Spa too. Food was pretty good & we had a decent spread on alacart over 3 days. Highly recommend everyone for this

reviews.author: rishivij
reviews.title: A heavenly resort in the hills
reviews.text:
We came in a group of 7 couples , all from Nagpur and we stayed for 2 nights at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa, Gulmarg and the experience was wonderful. It is indeed one of the best Hill Resort, not only in India but in whole world . 

The overall ambience is amazing , the rooms are awesome and well maintained and the views from the rooms are very beautiful . The spa , steam , jacuzzi are just too good and the best part is the heated swimming pool having glass walls giving you full view of the snowy mountains. The staff is very polite and co operative  , the temperature is well maintained to keep you cozy in winters . I must say that if you want to enjoy a heavenly Hill Resort in india , just book Khyber Himalayan Resort of Gulmarg and You will have a great time 

On the flip side , the food is very expensive and there are no other alternate options available for dinner in winters

reviews.author: devojha1978
reviews.title: Best trip
reviews.text: Fun holiday in Gulmerg. The hotel was just lovely – it’s a boutique hotel. We loved the balconies and the views were stunning from our rooms. The food was great. Do try the spa you wll love it. They were kind enough to send us a cake for my birthday! We will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Amruta M
reviews.title: Stuff dreams are made of!
reviews.text:
Without a doubt the best property in and around Gulmarg! We visited The Khyber for two nights in mid december for our Anniversary and were lucky to have witnessed snowfall throughout our stay which made our stay even more special. The temperature control swimming pool is the usp of the hotel and the view from the pool is straight out of a fairytale. The hospitality is impressive and the staff leaves no opportunity to make their guests feel special. Special thanks to Ms. Khalida & Mr. Vinit Kumar Chhabra for taking efforts to make our special day a memorable one!
We are surely coming back for a perfect experience :)

reviews.author: Praneet
reviews.title: Not worth the price, not value for money
reviews.text:
Sure the property is beautiful, no doubt about that. We paid roughly INR 16000 per night for the premium deluxe room (lowest category) inclusive wifi, breakfast and taxes. We stayed at Khyber for 2 nights. In terms of the way it is made, the property is really good.

The view from the hotel from every angle is great. The cafe is a good place to hangout as they serve shisha (starting INR 600) and allow you to sit with your own bottle. The spa here costs about INR 3900+taxes which will go upto almost 5000 per person. Dinner buffet prices are INR 2500+taxes. The breakfast spread was good. We only ordered an appetizer once. Dishes generally cost INR 700-1000 per item + taxes.

What we did not like were 2 things, 1. the negligent service towards guests and 2. the differentiation between the room categories.

The heated indoor pool with the amazing view was not actually heated to the right temperature. We complained both the days at the pool reception and at the main reception. There were other guests also who we spoke to, who had the same issue. Both days, we changed, got in and immediately got out feeling cold. The water was not cold, but it was not even warm. It was just moderate and the outside temperature was rather cold so overall, it was not comfortable being there. It was supposed to be a heated pool. The person came and manually checked the temperature to be 29 degrees, but it was really not even lukewarm, honestly. Hence, this for us was a complete waste, both the days. It was practically the only amenity which we could have enjoyed free of cost.

Ours was a premium deluxe room. The other 2 upper category rooms are the Luxury Gulmarg view and Luxury Himalayan view. Both these upper categories have balconies. The differentiation we did not like was the interiors in the premium room, where we stayed. It was very blah and not really made up to the mark. It does not give you a feel of any luxury at all having spent INR 16000 per night on it. It's a very basic room which otherwise in 5 star hotels would cost around INR 6000-8000, very ordinary interiors. What we very much disliked was that, these premium rooms are in a separate wing which is not centrally heated. Both the upper category rooms are in the same wing (away from the premium rooms) and that wing is completely centrally heated. We complained about this as well to the front desk, but they did nothing for it, at least in our 2 day period.

Overall, we had a very dissatisfying experience at Khyber and understood and realised well that only if you opt for the higher category luxury rooms, will you really enjoy the property and feel worth for the money you paid. Cannot comment on the massages as we did not take them. Swimming pool for us was a disappointment with the temperature not being actually 'heated'.

reviews.author: Vaibhav S
reviews.title: Awesome property
reviews.text:
Located at a prime location(walking distance from Gandola ride). Rooms are beautiful with a scenic view and beautiful interiors. Washrooms are also clean. Hospitality was also very promising, especially Mr. Jahangir and Miss Khalida who took good care of us. Swimming pool is very beautiful. 
A little high on pocket but worth staying there.

reviews.author: SriramJSS
reviews.title: Amazing Resort with Mesmerizing views
reviews.text: This resort has been featuring in the best resorts to stay in India articles for a long time. We decided to go there once. First of all, the welcome we received is fantastic. Staff was very courteous, friendly and helpful. We have taken himalayan view room and view(s) from the room are mesmerizing. You can spend days looking at the hills and doing nothing else. Staff was very helpful. Food was very tasty and the menu is very elaborate given the remote location they are in. Property is very beautiful and aesthetically built. Overall, we had a fantastic stay here.

reviews.author: Neha R
reviews.title: Heaven!!!
reviews.text: I had booked Khyber for my anniversary.  As I reach Khyber and am in awe of the place, I get to know Agoda has messed up my booking. I was really upset trying to connect with Agoda, but painfully, I could not get through them initially. The manager and the staff at Khyber is so amazing, i am short of words. So, I had booked the Himalayan view room, but agoda has messed up and sent the details as Gulmarg view to the hotel, the manager here agreed to provide me the himalayan view at 50% less of the difference amount. As we checked in and stayed at the hotel, the manager ensured we are not charged for Agoda's mistake. The staff was so courteous and at your service all the time. The place is so tastefully done and the location is to die for.

reviews.author: doctrat
reviews.title: Real paradise on earth
reviews.text:
I with my family planning to visit Kashmir from last two years but due some political issue we cancelled twice our trip. Then one of our Kashmiri friend suggested us it's safe to travel. So then finally decided  to go Kashmir. Beleave me when I entered in valley it's beauty was breath taking and the people were so loving and deciplined. In that way I took the negatively of media what really they showing. It is totally safe to travel and there was no security issues which scared us.
Our first stay was with the Khyber Himalayan resort Gulmarg. The place was so green and pure and the location of the hotel is amazing with modern amenities. They offered us a welcome drink ( Kawa) it was so tasty and well made. The check-in process was so quick by the staff ( Ms. Khalida). The hotel staff has taken care of us so well and thier hospitality was out of world. The staff at restaurant was amazing and well trained special thanks to Mr. Shaukat who served us whole trip he was  so attentive, well mannered and helpful. Food at restaurant was good and their buffet breakfast was so lavish with lot of spread.

reviews.author: Hari Govind U
reviews.title: "Mesmerising Royal Retreat on the lap of Luxury Paradise on Earth "
reviews.text:
Gulmarg ( A Travellors paradise ) in November , we were blessed with the First snow fall of the season starting a day before we landed in Gulmarg 17th Nov .

We made our stay so special by staying in 'The Khyber Himalyian Resorts and Spa" ( The Khyber )  , The Khyber was so special to us to celeberate our 25th wedding Anniversary  . To describe "The Khyber"  in one word is really very difficult for me ,it is " Luxury Paradise on Earth " .

 As a Civil Engineer I admire the amazing Architecture of the property  and our special thanks to Mr , Umar Traboo  MD  khyber group and the Architect for creating this amazing Resort . I am sure they would have spent years of time in designing and executing this Marvel.

The warm great welcome experience given by Ms. Kalida Lone (  let me call her Ambassader of Khyber ) was splendid and so inviting to drink a hot local Kawa drink along with walk /introduction to the property and our room . She mentioned during her introduction that we will extend our stay for sure and  no doubt we were so immersed in the the splendid views, climate , hospitality and we extended our stay .

The rooms are with great view and very well furnished, right from paper napkin holder to  laundry delivery box to the false ceiling is finished with wood well polished , the joy was in eye for the detail of every item . Hats off of the team which has created this heaven in Gulmarg .

First two days we stayed in primier and the last day we were upgraded to the Himalayan view retreat which had the ultimate view with a Balcony to sit and enjoy the beauty of Nature with the Himalyian peaks as a back drop  Spell bound view . The corridors were decorated with Kashmiri arts , pictures kashmiri birds and animals .

 We enjoyed the stay and enjoyed every loaction of the resort ( the dining Hall , Coffee shop , Gym , indoor swimming pool , good library books , Spa ) . My favourite space was the coffee shop  and excellent service by Mr. Junaid Ahamed ( a chicken sandwich with a cup of hot coffee is an Aesome experience )  . 

Food was extardinary and were well taken care at the restaurant by Mr. Ishfaq Hussain , Mr.Hamid , Ms.Saifed Pakesza and Mr.Gulam Khadir friendly team of Khyber ,thier hospitality was at the best and interactions was so good for us understanding the Kashmir valley in full . 

Ms Kalida and Inhouse  Paramedical Mr Nazeer Ahmed went all the way out in attending to my wife's leg sprain that was very nice approch and a great support to us. A Highly effecient centeralised  heating and ventilation system was working very well and keeping us in comfort all through our stay  . 

The resort is very close to Gundola  and All purpose Vechile ( AVT ) station . 

A HIGHLY RECOMMENDED AND  MUST PLACE TO STAY AND ENJOY GULMARG THE KASHMIR VALLEY . 

We enjoyed our stay and wish the Khyber team all the best . Please visit Kashmir people are so good and Hard working,  very friendly  , arts and crafts are so extradinary , the valley is really beautiful .

Cheers ,
Hari GOVIND.U

reviews.author: Vanessa D
reviews.title: Perfect welcome to Gorgeous Kashmir that turned out to be magically romantic!
reviews.text: One of the most gorgeous locations we've stayed at. The views from our room were just stunning, staff were extremely warm and welcoming, definitely felt pampered and well looked after. Loved the attention we were given, from advice to suggestions, to helping us with our onward journey, this is what exceptional service is meant to be where every need was taken care of with a smile. Excellent facilities with a spa, sauna and a temperature controlled indoor pool - just wished we had more time to utilize all of it. Special shout out to Khalida who was just brilliant and an big asset to Khyber.

reviews.author: Nipul Raval
reviews.title: FULFILLING EXPECTATION
reviews.text: Me and my wife had wonderful 2 nights stay. Everything perfect. Location, Room, food, services & comfort Much More Than Expected. Warm & professional Hospitality by hotel staff from bottom to top. Thoroughly enjoyed staying here. Will love to visit again this property. I strongly recommend this property. Worth staying.

reviews.author: Sukhmani W
reviews.title: Love the place but faced a few issues this time
reviews.text:
My husband and I love Khyber. We came here for our first anniversary two years ago and thought it best to be back here for our third. However, this time we faced a few issues with the hotel. 

The AC in our room stopped working at 3am and while we could’ve called someone about it, the thought didn’t strike us at that time of the night. So we had to open the door and sleep to reduce the stuffiness in the room. 

The food was strictly average as well. In fact, something reacted with me and I had a tough time the whole day after the dinner. The food was much better on our first trip here. 

But not all was bad. They surprised us with a cake for our anniversary and made sure we got a room with a fantastic view. 

The facilities are still quite amazing in the hotel including the spa. 

Best visited when it snows.

reviews.author: rahul g
reviews.title: Great Experience at Khyber Himalyan Resort
reviews.text: I went for my Weekend at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa and it was just awesome , I never had an experience like this before and Team Members are fully motivated specially housekeeping Team I found great hospitality spirit in them, I met Their manager Mr Abhishek, He is a very Cheered Person with a great Hospitality Behavior and having a good smile. Thanks Abhishek and Team for your Hospitality!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Sheikh329
reviews.title: Really Heaven On Earth
reviews.text:
As being my first trip to Kashmir I am speechless and really got mesmerized by both of its beauty and the hospitality that we tasted in the middle  of Himalayas.It was stunning since we landed at Airport from there we started our Journey in heaven as mentioned by my friends,through the villages and the fir laden forests and the distinct beauty had truly made our one hour long journey tireless so the warm welcome from the front staff was impecable.The property is amazing from rooms to facilities they offer,indoor pool with sauna Jacuzzi had a nice treatment at the Spa food has great taste with variety along with high standard service that is what one expects.Surely recommend for the first stop in Kashmir. 
Truly Amazing will come to visit again in future.

reviews.author: Satendra N
reviews.title: "Absolutely Amezing"
reviews.text:
This hotel is honestly heaven in the chaos of gulmerg.the beauty of landscape nd gardens is so peaceful and relexing,that you really have to experience.
the staff is super friendly and the service is amazing.
the rooms are spacious and comfortable with all modern amenities.
Abhishek from  HK is very helpful during my stay.
I strongly recommend this Stunning establishment.

reviews.author: guptasanjeev49
reviews.title: mesmerizing
reviews.text: The location of the hotel is amazing with a lovely views, homely feel and very attentive staff great food and service.Must visit once in a lifetime.Basharat and Manzoor were great .great spa and love to be back soon .

reviews.author: NehaLikes
reviews.title: Luxury in the lap of nature
reviews.text:
5 star property, serene views, surrounded by huge mountains, impeccable service despite being not a tourist season. 
Their Kahwa was the yummiest that we had in our entire visit to Kashmir. 
Though we think that the beauty of this place will be a highlight in winters but even in this season we got to witness abundance of fresh air and greenery. Interiors are both traditional and modern- to keep the Kashmiri feel alive and also mantaining the comfort. Amazing walnut wooden carvings and baitakh.
We stayed there for one night and 2 days. Their spa services are also amazing, it is managed by L'occitane and the daily offers are something to grab for a complete relaxation!
All in all - a complete package of luxury, service and nature.

reviews.author: Isha_Anandpura
reviews.title: Into the Himalayas – The Khyber
reviews.text:
Surrounded with snow covered mountains and conifers, Gulmarg, situated in the western Himalayas, is described as the centre of winter sports in India. Due to its breath-taking panoramic beauty this place has been the shooting spot for many Hindi movies. Must mention the ‘Bobby Hut’ here, a scene from the famous Bollywood movie ‘Bobby’ was shot in a hut at this place which is now called as the ‘Bobby Hut’. Normally, people visit this beautiful place for enjoying the winter activities like Skiing, Tobogganing, Biking (Snow Scooters), etc.

Interesting Fact: Gulmarg Gondola is claimed to be the world’s second highest cable car service.

Gulmerg has got many hotels and family resorts. Our stay at The Khyber Himalayan Resort and Spa proved to be one of the best of its kind. Firstly they greet you introduce you to the Khawa, a regional tea. A cup of Khawa is enough to keep you warm throughout the day. They have maintained an impressive garden which is a nice place to sit and witness the charming atmosphere in night. Staff is quiet friendly and helpful, guides you to your reserved rooms and helps you transfer your luggage.

Eat & Drink

Eating at Cloves, multi cuisine resto at Khyber is an amazing experience. The arrangement and the lighting add up to the pleasing ambience of the hotel. The food offered according to one person is amazing and enough to fill your stomach.
Chaikash offers soothing and refreshing beverages while the Terrace Lounge is a nicely done al fresco dining with elegant views of surrounding area.
Their Sheesha lounge ‘Calabash’ having big glass windows out looking the landscaped hills and forests, and Nauf filled with sweet fragrance of pines, are a good place to sit and enjoy the visit with traditional delicious barbeque dishes.

Stay

The Luxury Balcony room was nicely done with all modern amenities. High Speed Wireless Internet is easily accessible and does not have any connectivity issues. A big LED was placed right in front of the King size bed. A tea/coffee maker, some Cold Drinks and high quality nuts and chocolates and some fresh fruits were also available in the room for free of cost.

The Bathroom had a sunken tub which was quite big, shower area and dressing room. It is equipped with high quality toiletries.
The best part was the beautiful view of the snow caped mountains that came from the balcony and the bathroom as well. At night the atmosphere got even more magical. Beautiful Lamps light up and the moonlight falling on the snow made it look even more scenic.

Play

Besides a pool they have a fairly updated gymnasium and a separate section IGLOO for children (which feature many indoor games to play and enjoy).
For Adults they had activities like skiing, trekking, RIDES.
You can spend time at the world’s highest golf court. They also had a snooker room.
Also for movie lovers they had THE DEN having the latest Bollywood and Hollywood releases.
In summers they host activities like ATV Rides, gondola rides, mountain biking, rock climbing, Pony- Horse riding and jeep safaris.

More Information

Hotel: The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa
Location: The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa, Gulmarg 193403, Kashmir (J&K), India
Phone: +91 1954254666
Accommodation: 5 Star

reviews.author: Roohi
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.text:
I have no regrets to come and stay in such a beautiful resort in Gulmarg., despite all the negative news coming every day or two. It's safe to travel Gulmarg and enjoy the vacations.. I have never expected such a luxurious hospitality in the valley of Himalayas. Especially the view from spa and balcony rooms, good food. It's a superb location to enjoy both romantic and adventurous stay, heart welcoming staff, fantablous views, and great hospitality.
It made my holidays so memorable.., definitely recommend this resort for great vacation.

reviews.author: singharj
reviews.title: A Jewel in the Himalayas
reviews.text: Despite the negative publicity about Kashmir we decided to go. No regrets and Khyber is the best game in town. Staff is well trained, facilities are superb. They take care of all your needs. We celebrated our anniversary at the hotel and they made a delicious cake for us. We enjoyed a nice party with the staff and management team. Thank you Khyber for making this an enjoyable stay and being a great ambassador for Kashmir.

reviews.author: Anupriya V
reviews.title: The best romantic get away
reviews.text: We have stayed at many luxury properties but this one clearly stands out. The warm and welcoming staff, exquisite food, beautiful pool in the perfect location,the spa well maintained property, nice view from the room - You get it all. I would strongly urge all to visit Kashmir and this property and don't be sacred with the unrest. People and place - both are beautiful and we must support them :)

reviews.author: Vijaikapoor
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text:
It was a fantastic property, well planned, excellent big rooms, breathtaking view, good AC, The Food was good and the gardens were well maintained. They boast of a temperature controlled swimming pool which I did not visit. 

Gardens were excellent, grass was cut and throughout well  maintained

reviews.author: Gauri K
reviews.title: The little extra is what you get here.
reviews.text:
Loved the hotel. There is great attention to detail given in designing this hotel and it is well maintained. The staff is great. 
The food is the best in Kashmir beyond doubt.
We forgot a few thing in the room and they were kind to send them to Srinagar.

reviews.author: This.and.That
reviews.title: Breathtaking property in dire need of overhauling their service
reviews.text:
The property is straight out of the gorgeous ad in the Conde' Nast magazine. The hospitality in terms of the warmth with which the staff interacts with you is also world- class. But that's also the probelm area- when one pays for a luxury vacation one does not anticipate calling up the helpdesk for fixing the basics like room heating, bedding etc.
Even though every call was met with promptness, we got tired of calling for essentials by the end!
And the biggest let down is not being allowed to order beverages, (let alone liquor) at their gorgeous poolside.

reviews.author: Siddhant R
reviews.title: Amazing property at Gulmarg
reviews.text:
We visited this property during winters when there was a snowfall. I would recommend to visit this property only during winters, has some breathtaking views especially from  Himalayan view room. Though this property do has some 'cons' as well:

Cons-
1. Free internet which hotel provide is like 2G speed internet. Its very slow in this 4G world. Although they do have option to upgrade the internet speed but you have to burn your pocket for that.
2. Hotel staff is uninformative. I would say not all but some staff is.
3. This is completely dry hotel. So make sure you carry alcohol along with you. Hotel does provide you space to sit for free but with chargeable sheesha service and snacks.
4. Though hotel location is fantastic and is near to everything you want to do in Gulmarg but still last 100m to reach hotel is like you are climbing a mountain. So whenever you want to go to hotel after completing any outdoor activity, you have to literally climb last 100m. (If you r willing to spend then private taxi can drop you to the hotel. They will charge Rs 200 for to drop literally for 15 seconds only)

And some Pros-
1. Food. Hotel serves you very delicious food. One of the best I have ever had in any hotel
2.  Interior. Almost entire hotel has wooden interior decoration which was quite a relief especially during winters. 
3. Recreation room, Swimming pool and Gym - They will charge you for swimming costume but the location where swimming pool is quite amazing. In winter its hot water swimming pool
4. Hotel itself - Its best in Gulmarg. So if you want to spend money put into this one.

In the end, hotel does provide airport pick-up and drop service from Srinagar. But its on a chargeable basis.

On the whole, we enjoyed our stay in Khyber and will recommend to everyone despite some cons in this property.

reviews.author: yatenderkumart
reviews.title: Gulmarg with Kyber Pass Resort
reviews.text: The property was built tastefully with very good architecture. The service is very good, the hospitality is very good. in the room all basic amenities are there. the food is good and you can take any item of your choice.

reviews.author: poojasharma921
reviews.title: Amazing Property with Surprise Elements.
reviews.text: I wish i could have stayed more we only had one night stay in khyber. Amazing resort with the world Beautiest view. Everthing was perfect like a 5 start resort. Excellent Hospitality Shown by Parveez who arranged a surprise cake for us and made our stay wonderful and memoral that was the best surprise we have ever recieved let me tell you. we will definetly come in winter and this time we will have a long stay. Thank you so much parveez.

reviews.author: Darshan B
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Stayed here first week of June and it was amazing. The service was impressive and Mr. Asrar gave us a free room upgrade too..  I would definitely recommend this hotel in gulmarg. The breakfast is extravagant and tasty...

reviews.author: INDIA_DEEPAK
reviews.title: Beautiful property but bad hospitality towards the guest
reviews.text:
After our 2 days stay @ Hotel Vintage we had booked other 2 days @ Hotel Khyber which is 1.5 Kms away from it.

Due to heavy snowfall we called Khyber to get us transfered from Vintage but the duty manager Mr. Sakibh refused saying that the cars had stucked up.  We managed to hire a cab with the help of Vintage staff. The cab driver refused to drive till reception of Khyber  due to steep slope.

We again called up at Khyber to help us but Mr. Sakibh again refused using harsh words, saying that the ATV was not working. We saw the ATV  making rounds to and fro from the hotel till the Gandola side which was just  150m away.

 After watching all this we had to use hard words.We had booking in their hotel and if some problem was arising to get upto there they should have helped  in that scenario.

Latter ATV person showing courtesy carried us alongwith the luggage. In all this more than half of our day was spoiled.

All that was not  expected from such a big resort.

All that behaviour of the duty Manager Mr. Sakibh on that day spoiled our holiday mood.

Overall the property is awesome and really beautiful. The other staff members  at dining, reception or housekeeping  were really nice and polite. Mr.  Manzoor   & Mr. Pervez at front desk were really very nice and helpful for rest of our stay. Tahir and  Mudasir @ Swimming pool were too nice & helpful.

The property is undoubtedly very beautiful,comfortable and awesome. The food is also fine.

reviews.author: RAKESH MEHTA
reviews.title: One of the best resort i have ever stayed
reviews.text:
Kashmir India's answer to world for Swiss. Awesome beauty just cant explain in words you need to be there to experience it. Everything is calm in Srinagar, Gulmarg & Phalgam it's the media being spoiled sport and spreading rumors issues are there but in rural areas of Srinagar where we never need to go. Local's are very nice sweet, helpful, genuine & Honest.

The Khyber is simply super take a Himalayan view room you get mesmerizing view of snow claded Himalayan mountains. 

Heated swimming pool, sauna, Jacuzzi & gym truly wonderful. Spa is expensive didn't try it but would be surely nice.

Food is simply superb taste is really great. Buffet is expensive but go for A La Carte that's better and economical. Chef Veer was really co-operative and help full gave us good Jain food. 

Duty manager was really co-operative she ensured best service for us.

Overall The Khyber i rate 10/10.

reviews.author: Megha S
reviews.title: birthday celebration
reviews.text:
The drive to gulmarg was itself a very very inspiring one. as soon as you stepin the property you are mesmerized by the scale and detailing of the property. was extremely impressed with the hotel staff and their concern as we were protected by a con driver by mr puneet kumar Singh  the front office manager at khyber. highly recommed !
seriously hats off to the hositality.
look forward to more visits.

reviews.author: Pradeep S
reviews.title: Getaway Destination
reviews.text: Our stay at the Khyber Resorts , Gulmarg was one of the best Holiday destinations we had .. there was everything you can imagine to be there at the Resort. Nestled amongst the Pine trees on the Himalayas .. we had a perfect Dream Holiday .. Rooms with scenic views.. Heated Indoor Pool .. La'Occitane Spa... the Gondola station a stone's throw away.. above all the ever courteous and smiling staff ready to lend ear to you. The Breakfast and Dinner spread was also sumptuous and full of variety off food for different palates. On the whole it was much more than we could think of .. we had a great Holiday .. would strongly recommend for any couple/family looking for a 2-3 day Holiday in Kashmir. Keep it up.

reviews.author: Darshan S
reviews.title: Heavenly Location & Amazing Staff
reviews.text:
We visited Khyber from 26 April to 29 April 2017 and had an absolutely amazing time. We booked our pick up from Srinagar through the hotel itself and it was a nice clean Innova. Our drivers name was Sajjad and he was quite well spoke. We stopped on our way to have lunch at Raja Dhaba which serves fantastic food. 

On reaching the hotel we checked into our room with the Himalayan view. I can tell you that photos do not do justice to the place. From leaving Bombay which is at 38 degrees C to be in Gulmarg at 5 degrees in less than 5 hours is something else. 

A piece of advice - please book room with Himalayan view (it is available with and without balcony) but is much better than the Gulmarg view. It could also be because of the season, I think the difference would be less if you went in Winter. 

A special mention to the staff - Enthusiastic and considerate about every request. Iqbal and Ashfaq at the reception were of great help. At the tea room and restaurant Junaid whipped up amazing Kahwa for us. Finally at the restaurant Sameer and Qadir were amazing and ever present. Ruhi was very helpful about answering any queries as well. 

The Spa was expensive but good. The pool is totally stunning and scenic. 

Book your Gondola tickets in advance and get a guide or someone or the other will keep pestering you. 

Go to this beautiful part of our country! I can't wait to go back. 

P.S: One small note - there were Monkeys in the balcony the day we checked out. It's a rare occurrence but don't leave stuff outside.

reviews.author: Unmisha
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel with snow peaked himalayan view
reviews.text: The hotel is the most luxurious hotel in Gulmarg and has a perfect location . Facing the snow peaked mountains , it makes a perfect backdrop for the hotel. They have a temperature controlled pool which was heated and great steam, sauna and jacuzzi facilities . The multi cuisine restaurant had the best dinner buffet spread . Loved the starters spread! The hospitality was awesome too and the front office upgraded us since the occupancy was low . Small initiatives like these make a great difference to guest satisfaction and make us feel special. Thankful to the staff for the kind hospitality extended to us during our stay . Loved the hotel however prices were extremely high for a 5 star !

reviews.author: 694devikas
reviews.title: Heaven on earth
reviews.text: My husband and I went to The Khyber to celebrate our first wedding anniversary. We had the Himalayan view room. It was nothing short of perfection. The room was amazing with a spectacular view of the mountains. The staff was extraordinary!! There was nothing that they couldn't cater to! Your every need or desire was taken care of. The staff is ever smiling, friendly and helpful. The food was fit for a king. Delicious food and well presented. The spa experience was extremely rejuvenating. The therapists were well trained. The pool overlooking the Himalayas was breathtaking. It was luxury unlimited. Overall it was a wonderful experience and I would most certainly recommend anyone going to Gulmarg to stay at The Khyber.

reviews.author: PGHG
reviews.title: Over-hyped!! Overall not bad, but left wondering why did we pay so much for this experience
reviews.text:
It is a nice place, but for a luxury hotel, we were truly left wanting more. 

We had gone there for a short break in search of peace and quiet. So we took a Mountain view room with a balcony, the best room possible. The room had broadly the things one would expect in a good hotel, but then the bed was two small for two of us, mattress too soft and the duvet just about adequate. We stayed there for 3 nights of bad sleep. Seating inside the room was not quite comfortable.

Rooms are on two sides of a long corridor, and the corridor appeared a bit dark. Rooms are not sound proof and one could hear loud voices all through the day, and that disturbed the afternoon siesta. Very little open spaces to roam around inside the hotel, especially given that there is nothing outside of the hotel in Gulmarg. The limited seating area was just too noisy with two large groups with children talking very loudly, littering here and there, and making too much of ruckus. Unfortunately none from the hotel requested them to conduct themselves otherwise.

Hotel allows two devices per room for free connectivity. That in itself is too little in today's connected world. But even allowing for that, you can't even disconnect a device and connect another. So it's not 'two devices at a time'. It's only 'the first two devices that you connect after checking in'. To be fair, they did allow me to connect another device free of charge, but that needed me to speak to the manager in charge.

Food is very good though and the service very courteous. Spa was another highlight. Really liked the message there.

On the whole, while we truly enjoyed the view, the food, and the spa, were left wondering did we make go for the best option for our 3 days short break, especially for the very high price we paid.

reviews.author: Vivekanand G
reviews.title: Luxury at its best
reviews.text:
I had stayed in Khyber for one night during my visit to Kashmir in March and this is without doubt the best stay of the trip. 

The interiors are nice. Rooms and linen are top notch.The best thing about the resort is the temperature controlled pool and the jacuzzi. 

The staff were nice and cordial. Restaurant was alright.

I couldn't visit the spa because of the lack of time. I wish I had stayed here longer.

reviews.author: Siddhartha Sharma
reviews.title: Relaxed with Pir Panjal Range
reviews.text:
Great Resort. Wooden Structure

Try Himalayan view Rooms.

Wonderful Restaurant team Led by Mr. Shyam

Restaurant Manager Mr. Abid was very professional, caring and helpful. His team of Amit Junaid Sandeep were spontaneous and proactive

House keeping is little slow. And food is very expensive . Quality of food should we improved as we had little bad stomach last afternoon.

If you want to gain peace of mind, stay at Khyber , and rejuvenate yourself with Pir Panjal hills , they are amazing.

reviews.author: KOT K
reviews.title: Almarzooqi
reviews.text: Very nice resort Hotel friendly and helpful staff the reception manager is very helpful and kind person cascading his good behavior to his staff the only problem in this area is the communication services specially the international most of are banned due to political reasons the area is one of the exiting sky resort area it good for 2 to 3 days I recommend it for families and it is better to plan your trip with a tour guid for translation and to manage your requirements for ski bookings

reviews.author: Shriram K
reviews.title: Mr shri kumar
reviews.text: Khyber hotel, remember this name as this gonna be one of best hotel n india, prices r excellent, i have stayed with my friend for a weekend and honestly i m so happy we found this place, i will start frm front office, gave us our room key! All with the help of very nice, friendly and professional manager frm delhi gave great at entrance, we felt special from the beginning to the end. reviews.author: deepalidas2015
reviews.title: Best place to dine in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Beautiful hotel with authentic interiors.
Went for lunch.
Ordered the Khyber Tarami which is a Kashmiri set meal comprising of the following-

Tabakmaaz-Chewy and tasteless.
Seekh Kebab-Well made but not excellent.
Rista-Huge kofta in a red gravy.
Mirchwangan Korma-Well made lamb curry.
Gustaba-Huge kofta in yakhni gravy.
Tamatar Tsaman-Paneer in tomato gravy.
Haaq-Kashmiri leafy vegetable.
(Both Koftas have room for improvement)
Rice.
Though we preferred to eat it with Naans.(Not part of the set meal).
Price Rs 1600/-More than enough for 2.
The set meal is not outstanding but good and a good value for money in a 5 star setting.
The service is impersonal and a tad condescending.
The GM was very courteous though.

reviews.author: VHymakar
reviews.title: Great Hotel, Location and Service
reviews.text:
We have been picked up from the Airport, the welcome party was courteous and helpful, Our check in process  was very smooth, rooms were superb, view from the room was awesome. Gym , swimming pool and other infra is amazing.

Two things they could look at improving :

1) Spa therapists seem to be still under training, but to give benefit of doubt having a spa in Gulmarg itself is something great.

2) Noise from the rooms can be heard in the corridor.

3) Balcony and bathroom glass are see through so we could see what people were doing in their rooms if they had their curtains open for a view. This is a big downside.

2) Quality of food definitely needs improvement - we found pasta very salty, paneer burnt on edges etc., Deserts and breakfast were great.

reviews.author: Vrinda G
reviews.title: It's a tourist trap. Avoid
reviews.text:
Value for money - not worth Rs 23,000 per night. This is what I paid in April 2017. This is a 5 star hotel but they do not operate by the ethos of a 5 star property. It would be better stay at a 2-3 star hotel and not expect any service than staying here and paying more than 5x and still not having your expectations met. The hotel operates 'by its rule book' which has no mention of giving a 'wow experience' and therefore the hotel staff is totally unaware of it. For everything else they will point to their website or other sources for not accommodating you.

Food - Most of it is pre-cooked stuff that they source from outside. So they can't customize a lot of things. A 5 star usually gets everything made in house. Second, I asked for a Kashmiri dish to be served in my room. They refused to do so because it was not in their in-room menu. Other 5 star hotels would routinely do this for you. However they did serve me a masala chai free of charge on the last morning. Thank u for that. 

Alcohol - only 1 hotel serves alcohol in gulmarg. The hotel did not inform me. I spoke to a person (Irshad Ahmad and his colleague Rasheed) to find out about setting up a private dinner for us few days before traveling to Kashmir. We spoke about wine etc, but he didn't mention this even once. Upon reaching when I found out that this hotel doesn't sell alcohol, I asked him that why didn't he inform me about this? His reply was that it's written on our website. I haven't been able to locate where on the website do they mention this. 

Customer service - at the time of check out, they pointed out that one of the towels has henna stains. I put herbal henna in my hair, which sometimes leaves stains. These stains are 100% removable. They charged me extra 1500 rupees for that towel. I paid it but my problem with this behavior is when they charge Rs 23,000 a night, wouldn't such wear and tear be built into their rates? Do they charge other guests when some one drops a glass or a plate? It's just as simple as looking for an opportunity to fleece another Rs 1500. I have stayed at many 5 star properties but no one ever in my life has done this. 

Mr Abhishek (the manager) hung up on me when I told him this. I accept that I was agitated with this entire episode. But hanging up on a customer shows that they don't care about what you have to say. The hotel is doing well and they don't need repeat customers. I wouldn't be surprised to see a defensive response to this review telling me how they did everything right and I was an over demanding customer.

I paid close Rs 100,000 for 3 days including food etc at this hotel. I deserved better treatment.

reviews.author: chang1505
reviews.title: amazing stay
reviews.text: the best hotel of gulmarg ,beautiful surroundings , beautiful view from the hotel, worth spending time in this place, rooms are great ,big fully decorated rooms ,great staff,very good food, , avery romantic hotel.

reviews.author: Umnada
reviews.title: Fantastic setting, great hotel
reviews.text:
This is one of the nicest hotels I ve been in and believe me I ve been in quite a lot of this type of hotels.
From the moment we arrived we were treated like maharajas. The manager and his staff came to greet us and welcome us. We were served with warm Kashmiri tea and ushered to our room, where someone came with us to check us in.
The room was very spacious and beautifully furnished in Kashmiri style. Bathroom is a little small but practical. The view from our window was like a picture postcard. I ve posted it below.
Amenities are excellent
Staff are very helpful and friendly and the waiters want to feed you more during mealtimes.
Breakfast is very basic , mostly indian cuisine which we were not familiar with, but we got one of the waiters to bring us something and it was worth trying it. Different but nice. Don't miss trying out the indian breakfast is quite different from the western style breakfast . Otherwise the usual international stuff of cereals and eggs with toast is available .
Dinner is almost similar to breakfast, a lot of indian cuisine. For the first night We had to order al carte for Kashmiri food which was nt being served on the buffet . I guess cuz most of their customers are Indians and so they cater for them mainly .
Their spa is very basic , but the masseur is very very good. I recommend a body massage after all the days activities on the snow.........
Don't miss out on the gondola ride which takes you up to 14,000 ft above sea level. We hired Wellington boots and a heavy snow coat which we really needed as it snowed quite heavily while we were up there. 
We only went up to 10,000 ft and enjoyed the rides. The snow  sledge ride pulled by men instead of dogs is fun , and the snow bike is exhilarating .
Be careful with the vendors there, they ll try and get as much as they can out of you, so bargaining is the word of the day .
I m sure you ll enjoy this trip and particularly this hotel as much as we did
Have fun

reviews.author: Nishant Agrawal
reviews.title: Amazing Stay
reviews.text:
Had an amazing stay at the Khyber. 
The good:-
Amazing views - view from your room of the snow clad mountain and also view from the hotel balcony is beautiful! Exactly similar to the photos shown. 
Nice cozy rooms with all amenities
Good food - unexpectedly the food including the breakfast was pretty good. Try the a la carte (buffet is pricey)
Good room service and a nice staff. They also gave a tour of the entire property
Spa - nice spy though a little pricey.

The not so good:-
The rooms didn't have an AC. It only has a heating system to keep you warm. So, in case the temperature sours in your rooms, it becomes a bit suffocating. The good part is that the hotel staff provided us with a table fan.

Overall, Khyber is a must place to stay if you are in Gulmarg.

reviews.author: Abhi
reviews.title: Supreme Luxury
reviews.text:
What a beautiful hotel!
When you step here, you realize the beauty of this place. Hats of to architect's who conceive such beauty and also to owner, Mr Tambroo to run the hotel with such challenges. 

I mean the hotel is expensive, but when you are there and speak with the staff, you do realize the hardships they go through to, to keep the property running in such extreme weather conditions and such extreme political conditions.

Every Rupee spent is worth it.
I suggest you take this hotel stay if it's winter time..
It was magnificent.

Beware of guides. Because you are from khyber they will doubly trouble you.( as they sense you have the moolah).

Do go with a clear idea of snow sports you will take part in and go and start bargaining aggressively with them. Do read my review on Gulmarg gondola for pricing details.
Winter sports that were on in March were, skiing, snow biking, sledging and snow cycle.

Hope you can make use of this review and get one up on guides and hustlers!

reviews.author: Ravi C
reviews.title: Gulmarg is God's Paradise
reviews.text: Gulmarg is just superb. Natural beauty is out of this world. Simply breathtaking views. And in this God's paradise is this beautiful hotel. Amazingly beautiful property. We took a luxury balcony room and it offered superb views. Luckily it was snowing when we checked in. Hotel provides excellent views of the natural beauty all around. The staff is attentive and very courteous. Took really good care of us. Food was good. Everything was really excellent in this hotel. Even when the temp outside was -12, we hardly felt it in hotel. Will again stay in this property. We just found couple of drawbacks. Nothing serious but deserves mention so they may take measures to correct it. The mattress is too soft and it gave me a back issue. The toiletries in bathroom were only for 1 person and not 2 especially when 2 ppl had checked in. The driver Aijaz which hotel had given us to drop us in Srinagar insisted that if we want to buy authentic Kashmiri stuff, we should stop at this particular shop some way before Srinagar. Since I was having a back pain issue because of mattress, I asked him to take us directly to Srinagar at our hotel Lalit. It seemed as if he did not liked us not stopping at this particular shop because after that he drove really fast and reckless and I had to ask him to slow down repeatedly. It was as if we had done something wrong by not listening to his advice for stopping mid way at his recommended shop. May be there was a commission involved or whatever. But next time when we visit this property, I am going to make sure that I don't get this driver again.

reviews.author: MuffinEats
reviews.title: A luxury ski getaway in the Himalayas
reviews.text:
Hidden in the snow-capped mountains, the Khyber Hotel was located 2 hours away from the Srinagar airport. We were picked up by the hotel transport,  passed through towns with some initial tripedation due to the ubiquitous armed forces scattered every 1-2km. However, once turning into Gulmarg, we could feel the warmth of the locals and that they warmly welcome foreigners (most visitors are from India). 

The hotel was impeccably decorated and the room was large, spacious and very clean. We stayed at Room 1014 and woke up to a wonderful view every morning. The room came with a walk-in wardrobe which led to a huge bathroom - comprising of a huge sunken bathtub and a separate shower area. 

Breakfast spread was extensive with both Asian and Western choices - including a live dosa and egg station. We had dinner at the restaurant for 5 nights and were spoiled for choices even with the ala carte menu. Food was delicious and the chef certainly took pride and efforts with his presentation. The vegetarian egg-fried rice was fantastic complete with the wok-hei.

What impressed us most was the awesome service of the hotel staff - definitely to name - Hotel Manager Basharat, Suhil, Sameer and the wonderful staff at the restaurant and concierge team (I am unable to make all their names). They truly took pride in delivering wonderful service, and made our stay a memorable one. Basharat for one was very quick in contacting the in-house medic to procure altitude sickness medicine for my husband when he saw him unwell. 

The house-keeping team was so efficient in managing our laundry - we got back our laundry every morning before 9am (without requesting for express service). 

Power trips (lasting 2-3 mins) at the hotel did go off once or twice per day but generally it did not cause much inconvenience to us. Complimentary Wi-Fi was only limited to 2 devices, any additional device will cost Rs 750 for 24 hours. 

The L'occintain spa and heated swimming pool were exactly what it was depicted in the pictures on the website. Full body massages prices were from Rs 3,900 and above. 

One thing to note - The hotel does not sell or serve any alcohol. Guests can bring in their own wines or liquor.

We were here primarily to ski (for 5 days) and was pleasantly surprised to find a ski room/locker located just at the hotel's driveway. We parked our ski gear with the security team at the ski room every day - nothing went amiss. In fact the security team at the ski room helped to get me into my ski boots every morning! 

Transport from the hotel to the Gulmarg Gondola Station took only 3 mins and costs Rs 200 one way. There were many cars parked outside the hotel which you could negotiate with the drivers. 

We hired a local ski guide Manzoo (about Rs 2,500/day) as the ski trails were not clearly marked, so a ski guide was essential to acclimate skiers to the terrain. Manzoo was very experienced (he is also a snow boarder), who took us off-piste to experience the powder snow. He was friendly, helpful and took some great videos and pictures. He was also able to ascertain our skill levels and recommended the appropriate trails. Manzoo's contact  +91 70065 81644.

As the first phase of the gondola started from 10,000 ft, we took a day to acclimatize to the altitude before we hit the slopes, with just rest and lots of water.

It was a most luxurious and comfortable stay in Gulmarg and we won't think of staying anywhere else the next time we are here. We will definitely be back here at the Khyber the next ski season!

reviews.author: 165ankurp
reviews.title: Very Good but can be Great
reviews.text:
I visit Khyber from Feb 9 to 12 2017. It was covered in Snow and was the most beautiful place i ever saw. A beautiful resort of Luxury covered under Snow. The view outside the pool and the room was just awesome. Gulmarg is known for Skiing and February was the perfect time for it. We learnt a little bit and had good fun. The resort as such is the best resort in Gulmarg the only one with all luxuries. Its centrally heated which is a must and then it has its Heated Pool, Jacuzzi, Steam and what not and all this is part of the money you pay for the room. So yes you could be under3 meters of snow and still enjoy all the luxuries on earth. The hospitality was at its best - A special thanks to Mr. Asrar or Azrar who took great care of us . They have split beds in room which i think should be changed for couple rooms plus the noise from neighbouring room TV does come into your room so they should look into it. Since your in a 5 star you would expect everything to be perfect and thus the 1 star goes off here. The food is indeed simply awesome except for Pasta's. Try their Indian food and you will be Amazed specially the Dum Biryani's. 

Overall its a great place nestled under Snow - i wonder how did they manage this kind of luxury so high and under snow. My recommendation if you don;t want to ski then don;t stay beyond 2-3 days . You could surely use all facilities at the resort.

Thanx

reviews.author: Timmisoni
reviews.title: " The Hotel "
reviews.text:
The experience of hospitality starts from the pick up at Srinagar Airport and also ends when you are dropped back. The Hotel is excellent beyond words but I believe dedicated staff takes it to a different level. The staff is very 
Courteous polite efficient and ever helping. 
The view of the mountains from the hotel leaves you awestruck.
Food is excellent and the buffet well laid.
Overall an unforgettable experience.
Guys keep up the good work

reviews.author: Vikram Devare
reviews.title: Beautiful and Luxurious
reviews.text:
Beautiful views of the Himalayas and Gulmarg, luxurious setting and excellent service. Need I say more?

My wife and I travelled in January 2017 in the middle of the winter and we were treated to a true snowy winter experience. The snow covered landscape is absolutely breathtaking and I recommend going in this weather to experience winter and snow in its full glory.

Pros:
1. Amazing views of the Himalayas
2. Location - In the heart of all the action, from the Gondola to the Ski slopes and the Gulmarg market
3. Service - Special mention to Bilal, Hamid, Iqbal for making our stay comfortable
4. The heated pool, gym and spa!

Cons:
Wish they made arrangements for snow boots, etc but this is a minor thing as boots and jackets are easily available around

We had a wonderful stay and if we could go back every year, we would.

reviews.author: Deepak A
reviews.title: Too good to be true
reviews.text: A wonderful place to experience a snow filled winter. The hotel premises, the rooms, the amenities, the location, the staff, the food, the hospitality everything is super super good... Totally out of the world experience... I would love to stay in khyber every winter. This hotel deserves a 7star rating. Everything is perfect.

reviews.author: Bavithra D
reviews.title: Second Honey Moon
reviews.text: Our family and friends were afraid of visit to gulmarg regarding the safety but we felt the very safe and enjoyed the whole visit. We were received by Nazir at airport with a warm welcome. Nazir was a good guy who served us,  as a guide, for the visit to skiing and shopping. We thank him a lot for the guidance. Khyber rooms were clean with good views of the Himalayas and Alpine trees. Restaurant was finger licking good. The hoocka was great, with the signature green apple flavor. Swimming pool with water sauna and steam is definitely worth the visit. The gym and swimming pool was almost empty so we spent hours in luxury. Spa massage was wonderful especially the lemon ... massage. We could be writing pages about the gulmarg and Khyber resort as the memory of the visit will stay with us as a delight.

reviews.author: BlueWinchester
reviews.title: Royal Stay
reviews.text: We stayed here for 3 nights and we had a great time. The Hotel has a beautiful wooden architecture,  perfect for honeymooners like us.  They have a very good breakfast spread. We opted for Ala carte for dinner and that was also good. Only one con i would say is wifi here is chargeable unlike Taj Vivanta Srinagar so four stars for that.

reviews.author: nkeswani
reviews.title: Scenic Gulmarg and the Beautiful Khyber!
reviews.text: Stayed here from the 26th until the 28th of Dec 2016. Firstly I would like to compliment the service that they provided, the front desk was always helpful at all times. The view from the rooms was beautiful and scenic although when I went, it had just snowed once. The food at the restaurant was delicious; specially the Masala dosa station they had during breakfast time and also Aloo Paratha was yummy. We had the biryani and fish tikka for dinner as well. It was delicious. The Kahwah tea that they provided during check in was amazing. The room itself was spacious and the bed was comfortable; the bathroom was clean and the hot water pressure was too good. Overall Khyber spa and resorts is a beautiful place to stay and spend holidays in. Truly a wonderful experience. Thank you Khyber Resort & Spa.

reviews.author: Esh G
reviews.title: Gorgeous view and surroundings
reviews.text:
In my opinion, hotel with the best view that we have ever stayed in.

Surrounded by the Snow capped Himalayas.

From the restaurant to the room balcony your views are like a postcard; picture perfect.

You feel transported to Hogwarts during winter.. with snows outside the hotel.

Great service too!

Wished i could have stayed longer.

reviews.author: Ananthi S
reviews.title: Mrs Ananthi Sharma
reviews.text: Excellent Resort with most amazing customer service. Every staff are always at their best courteous attitude. Especially Ashfaq from guest services and Aijaz from the restaurant. Thank you for making our stay comfortable. Will definitely be back again soon!

reviews.author: NTR
reviews.title: Brilliant Architect with Wonderful View!!!
reviews.text: Undoubtedly best place to stay in Gulmarg, Amazing food with efficient service... Snow fall on day-2 of our trip was icing on cake.. Spacious room with sunken bath and beautiful valley view. Thanks to the Khyber team to give amazing start to our 7 nights trip in Kashmir.

reviews.author: nrm77
reviews.title: AMAZING!
reviews.text: As part of my birthday gift to my husband, I had booked an entire holiday to Kashmir, with stays at the top hotels in Srinagar and Gulmarg. We only stayed at the Khyber for a day, but what a memorable stay it was! Gulmarg is truly heaven on earth. The peak of Mt Apharwat offers some of the best views ever! Loved it. The hotel itself is spectacular! The spa and the pool in particular are just incredible. The views are incredible too. We had kashmiri biryani/pulao for lunch at one of the restaurants (I think it was called Cloves), and it was amazing! The cheeses were incredible too. Rooms were really comfortable as well. Overall - Khyber is one of the best hotels I've stayed at in India, and I am so glad that we celebrated my husbands birthday here.

reviews.author: LifeandLeisure
reviews.title: A jewel of a hotel with one of the best spas in the country
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Khyber smack in the middle of winter (early March 2016) when Kashmir was snowed under. It was our first visit to Kashmir and we were so impressed with the hotel. What stays with us is the Kaava they served as a welcome drink (which we kept getting at their coffee shop because it was just so good) with lovely slivers of almonds and so, so flavourful. The food was wonderful, so was the atmosphere. Staff was very respectful and nice. Beware of touts hanging out outside the hotel who try to force you into a 'gondola' ride and ski trips. We had a reference from a friend who had recently been (Waseem, who acts as a local tour operator and ski guide - +91 8493961421 - safer to go with a known person who won't cheat you). Bought locally grown saffron, so fragrant. Loved this property and will surely visit for their luxurious L'Occitance Spa - one of the best spa treatments we've had in India yet and their heated indoor pool.

To counter altitude sickness, drink plenty of water and nibble on some chocolate: a tip we got from our ski guide in Switzerland and has helped me a lot (I very easily get altitude headaches).

reviews.author: VinanthiAnil
reviews.title: Awesome Location, Great Hospitality
reviews.text: Khyber is one of the best resorts we have been to in India. We liked its location and view from the balcony of Himalayan view rooms. Its very nearby to Gondola point. Very well maintained and great interiors. Amenities are also very nice. We would like to thank specially Saqib who is the manager over there for being so friendly and cooperative. Overall we enjoyed stay at Khyber.

reviews.author: MeenuKolkata
reviews.title: Must visit
reviews.text: We went to khyber. The reception , the rooms and dining services were superb. There was snowfall making the resort view beautiful . Spa and hot water swimming pool overlooking snow was a nice experience .

reviews.author: salahudin123
reviews.title: “Paradise”

reviews.author: Amit B
reviews.title: Hospitality is very poor
reviews.text: The hospitality is very poor, the room sofas are broken, Wi-Fi is not free which is available at every hotel today which was embarassing, door lock also not in the upright condition, playroom equipments are not working, Infact the pricing which they had kept when compared to the services are not up to the mark or not value for money. Vintage would be the best property at Gulmarg.

reviews.author: swati d
reviews.title: HEAVEN ON EARTH
reviews.text: If you are staying at Khyber, you will get to witness heaven on earth..truly amazing....you dont need to get out of the hotel to see the scenic beauty..it is all visible from the hotel too..wonderful location...excellent facilities...great staff...hospitality awesome..food divine....its just value for money....I would definitely stay at this hotel again and again.

reviews.author: anish1710
reviews.title: Great experience! Must visit in winters
reviews.text: I stayed at this property for 2 nights with my wife.I would like to thanks the reservation team (Mr. Irfan) for allowing us to defer our booking at no extra cost, even when our initial booking was non-refundable. It is an hour drive from Srinagar airport. Make sure you carry hard copy of your reservation confirmation as you have to show it at the check post. Check in was smooth, welcome kava drink was a nice touch. Rooms and property have that typical hill station look. The heated pool was nice. There is  jacuzzi and steam facility in locker rooms. It might be just the timing, the property was really full with mostly extended groups with kids. Breakfast & dinner buffet was limited and decent. I would recommend ala-carte options as the preparation was much better. There is a waiting to get seated in the restaurant, so make sure you plan accordingly. No hotels/restaurants in Gulmarg serve alcohol so make sure to carry some with you from Srinagar. Hotel does lack a good concierge who could help you would bookings. Wi-fi is paid. Over all a good experience., would love to come back in winters with snow all around.

reviews.author: lykenZ
reviews.title: Simply Wow
reviews.text: Wow just wow! A truly beautiful hotel. The breakfast was amazing with everything you could ask for. The service is what you would expect from one of the most exclusive hotels in Gulmarg. Not forgetting the great views of the mountains. Well worth a visit.

reviews.author: sharan1988
reviews.title: Complete let down
reviews.text: I spent 3 days (june 23-26 2016) at Kyber and for all its hype its a complete let down. The day we took our room the heaters wasn't working had to make couple of calls for them to rectify it , the paint from the bathroom ceiling was flaking off, cracked marble at many places,loose hand shower that kept falling and when my wife got here toe cut when she went for a swim there was a piece of glass in the swimming pool (took pictures for record) and the hotel staff nor the useless General Manager of the hotel had the courtesy to ask how she was. I had a word with the General Manager - Vinit Kumar Chhabra was not very helpful and was the most useless of the GM i have seen. After having been paid so much of money just to experience the hotel which has been by far the worst in hospitality. And i don't even want to start talking about the breakfast which was tasteless and insipid .

reviews.author: creativecircle80
reviews.title: Good but not best
reviews.text: Khmer in gulmarg is a good hotel with modern rooms and facilities but service and staff attitude is lacking as the management seems to be complacent and non receptive to complaints. During our stay almost all our small requests were ignored making you realise the hotel's management requires a course in hospitality. Small requests like fresh milk with chocolate for our child was not adhered to even after several reminders, we had pre ordered kichdi for dinner but it wasn't made as they told us the waiter who took that order is off duty now! Khyber is exorbitantly priced and such excuses at those prices are in acceptable.

reviews.author: arun p
reviews.title: Best Star class Category
reviews.text: I Visited Gulmarg in The month of may. One the best hotel In Kashmir is The Khyber Himalayan Resort. We stayed there for 2 nights, Had a wonderful time at the hotel and specially in the Warm Swimming pool which was just Amazing. If Anyone stayed a night am sure u will extend your stay at The Khyber resort. One thing Which is not expected is they charge so much for room and Charge extra if we want to use Wifi which is not

reviews.author: anugarg890
reviews.title: Best at all
reviews.text:
I was here for the vacation enjoyed the hospitality at the best with best services, the resort with most best view in Gulmarg high sunrise peak sunrise
 and best dining experience . To add awesome food which has taste for all which includes beautiful laid buffet for dinner and awesome tea experience in evening tea

reviews.author: medhavig4u
reviews.title: Different & royal interiors
reviews.text: This hotel has an altogether different interior and their rooms are spacious royal indeed. The location is the best. Food is good, staff friendly & smiling. Room service is fast. Just a tip: my husband found the front desk staff a bit rude. Else everything was just awesome!

reviews.author: prokon e
reviews.title: Mix response, read details ps
reviews.text:
It's a great property in terms of location and infrastructure and look and feel.
On most of the subjects , it comes out with distinction.

Very big negative - 
Hotel does not have licensed bar.
Expensive, considering land prices r dirt cheap.

Positives - 
Swimming pool is heated ,great.
Look and feel ,great.
Decor, great.
Check-in is apt and quick.
Concierge is helpful and good advice.

Restaurant, normal, nothing to be wow.
Restaurant, normal menu and normal taste.

Staff, reasonably fine and nice, not exceptional.

This is the best property in gulmarg, and it will be difficult for a new property to come up and steal the show, unless they bring in skill set of exceptional quality.

reviews.author: Fibonacci 7
reviews.title: Paradise in Kashmir
reviews.text:
Khyber Himalayan Resort and Spa is easily the best resort in Gulmarg.It is very popular with ski enthusiasts and is located very close to the Gondola
We celebrated our anniversary amidst the snow covered peaks and were blessed with a snowfall a day after we checked in
The Jacuzzi was very good and so was the heated pool
The Hotel lobby was done up very tastefully .The rooms are large in size and the decor is very pleasing to the eye
The buffet dinner was good though we expected to find kashmiri delicacies like Rista and Goshtaba which were missing from the menu

Winter is the best time to go as the snow capped mountains and the white valley looks very beautiful and picturesque .The hotel is always full so it is better to book in advance

reviews.author: sangeetakarwall
reviews.title: Arrogant staff
reviews.text: Khyber Gulmarg no doubt is a good new hotel in Gulmarg but what takes away the charm of the place is its arrogant staff. To start with the reception and dinning staff only care about large groups and totally neglect FIT customers, one has to wait in dinning till they serve large groups making you wonder as if you haven't paid to enough to get similar treatment. The house keeping staff is also not attentive and calous in their attitude. Don't expect this kind of service after paying through your nose.

reviews.author: Raman O
reviews.title: Gulmarg visit
reviews.text: Excellent property!! We stayed there for two nights last week. View from our balcony was out of the world! Very nice spa and pool area... Food quality at the resort was excellent but even better was superb service provided by Sajjad who took special care each time we visited the dining. We carried back very fond memories of Kashmiri hospitality.

reviews.author: Singh S
reviews.title: the best hotel visited in India!!
reviews.text:
this is the Best property visited so far in India!
If you ever want to visit Gulmarg,this is the place to be!
the place,the aura the décor,impeccable.Expensive but worth it!!

The palace gives you a perfect amalgamation of old world charms and modernity.
the swimming pool has a breathtaking glass view with mountains on one side and trees on the other.It is also very near to golkunda.

reviews.author: priti q
reviews.title: Khyber in Gulmarg
reviews.text: The Khyber is a strange alpine chalet that has evolved into a multilevel wood and stone series of buildings. It is close to the Gondola/ ski lift terminus so if you are a skier its a great location. The rooms were well appointed as were the bathrooms. The buffet was a strange mixture of Indian, Chinese with a pasta dish thrown in to make it continental. The tea shop in the lobby sells Kashmiri Kawa to die for and scones that are like flat biscuits. Very tasty indeed.

reviews.author: vanesa01
reviews.title: Absolutely Amazing
reviews.text: Great  hospitality and luxurious room with breathtaking views. Perfect location especially if you want to go tothe Gulmarg gondola. Loved the spa and the massage was really awesome. This hotel  overlooks the snow clad mountains  of Mount Affarwat with pine and fir trees below- pristine beauty. Would love to visit during winter.

reviews.author: Nikhil Shah
reviews.title: The Khyber @ Gulmarg Kashmir
reviews.text:
Its a fabulous property with breathtaking views. Excellent staff , service and very good spread of vegetarian food. The staff at the restaurant is extremely warm and very helpful and makes sure to make every meal of yours complete and fulfiling. Impeccable service by every person in the restaurant especially Bilal, Iqbal Bhat and Ganganesh. Even if you are travelling with children the meal options are very good. 
Excellent facilities, superb spa , heated swimming pool. It was really once in a life time experience when we were in the heated pool and we could see the snow falling outside.

reviews.author: Rumanaachwa
reviews.title: Excellent !!
reviews.text:
I stayed here for 2 nights with my husband. It's the best property at Gulmarg. It's very clean, comfortable and truly luxurious. The rooms and bathrooms are very well equipped and spacious. The staff is very polite, friendly and efficient . They have an excellent in house doctor, who lives on the property itself and his services are complimentary from the hotel. My husband fell ill during our stay from a kidney stone , and the doctor was extremely efficient not only in his diagnosis but also in his treatment, because of which our trip wasn't cut short in any way. Their premier indulgence room has breath taking views of the mountains in the distance and it was particularly magical during our stay because it had begun to snow. 
But on the downside, the food at the Kyber is terrible. We ordered a chicken quiche, from their pastry and savoury counter, and it was inedible. Even the food in their restaurant was poor. The mutton biryani , we ordered was more like mutton curry mixed with rice, while the quality of their buffet was way below par and shockingly over priced. All in all, Kyber is a wonderful luxurious resort and definitely worth a stay. But until they do not improve the quality of their food, you're better off eating else where.

reviews.author: Somnath S
reviews.title: Not a typical hill station hotel
reviews.text: Hotel khyber gulmarg us a new hotel in gulmarg, during our last visit we had stayed in hotel highlands park which has much better views and service. Khyber might be ok for skiers in winters but for tourists who want to enjoy huge lawns with landscape, typical cottage type rooms with local feel and service then I'm afraid khyber is not the place. We recommend highlands park in summers as we again went for lunch and were mesmerized with the beauty all around it.

reviews.author: holiday_lovers2011
reviews.title: Elegant place to stay at high price tag
reviews.text:
Paid for two night but stayed only fro 1 night due to personal reason. Excellent stay. Upon informing at desk reg our one night cut short, hotel op. manager was bit concerned thinkign that we are leaving due to hotel issue. We clarified that nothing like that and its unfortunate that we will not stay for 2 night. As per policy they couldn't refund for night which we didn't stay but made our lunch, dinner and internet free. Nice to see that atleast Hotel cares for their guest and willing to take that extra step to give comfort to their guests. Done relaxing SPA and is highly recommended.
Room we got was nice spacious room. Hotel is offering 4 start facility and very popular. 
However this come at very high price tag. Need to pay INR 200 for 30 min next access.
Breakfast opens at 8.00am which is bit late, sp when tourist rush for Gondola tkt in early morning.
Overall very satisfied and highly recommended.

reviews.author: RSB54
reviews.title: Super Resort and beautiful location
reviews.text:
It lives up to its reputation of being an excellent property ! The staff is also very courteous and helpful. Its professionally managed and we had a very good experience.
There was a minor issue of leakage in the bathroom which was efficiently sorted out.

reviews.author: Reviews-by-MT
reviews.title: Nice hotel but Sadly did not enjoy Gulmarg
reviews.text:
We stayed two nights at the hotel. It is actually one of the best hotels in the region. We enjoyed the warm welcome drink of Kawah in the cold weather. The Kawah is made up safron and almonds with cardamon and makes it a refreshing warm drink. 

We were allocated a room on 1st floor with a side view of the snow caped mountains. It was OK room. We were ugraded the room to a better room the next day . one of the drawbacks of the hotel was the actual contruction and layout . There are no lifts and the stair case and the coridors are very badly lit. 

The restaurant was OK and the food was not bad. The staff did actually see through to our special diet and needs. 

They have a nice indoor swiming pool with see through glassed walls where you can enjoy a good scenery whilst swimming. There pool is not managed too well. The local guests do actually behave so badly and are notoriously loud without giving any consideration the other guests. Sadly the Jacuzi and Sauna were out of use and were being renovated at that time.  

The Management of the hotel could however be improved. There was no proper guidance or information from the hotel about the sight seeing or about the operation of Gondolas and Guides . The hotel should organise the tours and tickets to the Gondalas and provide the excursion or at least have a fixed price policy controlling the touts /local guides who are such a menace, just there to loot you. 

We were set to go to the mountains on the Gondolas and a short ride of 500 metres from the hotel to the Gondola base cost us 500 rupees and the guide charged us 1200 rupees just to be with on teh Gondola . It was really not worth the trip to Gulmarg. The people of Gulmarg all appeared notorious and untrustworthy - just there to loot you. There is no management whatsoever by the Government . The place is litered despite the natural beautiful surrounding . 

The Gondola Management is also the worst one could expect. No system at all and there is no consideration given to the weak , old or people with small kids. Absolute chaos. 

When on the hills, the sledge touts are after you and are very forceful. Serious accidents can happen as the snow is turned into ice and is very slippery . We saw old people fall and yet there were many who were extremely cold and just wanted to get down the hills but yet could not get onto the gondolas because of the unmanaged crowds. 

Being the best hotel in the area , the managment should at least see to their guest comfortable stay.  The hotel is undoubtedly over hyped and over rated and the rates are unreasonably high. 

Despite the natural beauty of Gulmarg, I would not return back , firstly due to the people there and secondly because it is not maintained  and managed properly.

reviews.author: SherryMerchant
reviews.title: Nice hotel poor service
reviews.text:
Lovely location and views from the room, lovely rooms. Large and comfortable. Staff generally very nice and try to please but we found the service a bit sloppy: first night we reached the restaurant just before the last order time and by the time we were shown the table and given menus it was 4 minutes past. We were told the cook had left. Later we discovered that two staff wanted to leave so we were asked to eat the buffet I stared at a discount. After making some noise, we them were served dinner but a bit of a sour taste. Next day at breakfast we were refused brown toast because it was over. In a top class hotel? After noise was provided to us. This was random few staff, others generally good. Other thing is that in the room they are miserly with tea and sugar and mild, also I could not understand having cups and no saucers in the room.
The cost of two regular rooms gets you a two bedroom villa that has an extra maids room and kitchenette and extra loo, so actually five people can sleep comfortably. Just a tip.
On the down side, passages are chilly, not heated so that's not very comfortable. Service not as good as you expect for that kind of hotel. No free wifi at such a high room rate is unacceptable.

reviews.author: Prereeka S
reviews.title: Best property in Gulmarg
reviews.text: This hotel has the best view of the mountains. Has a proper Kashmiri decor and interior. View from room is spectacular. Service is good and the staff is also well managed. It's the best property in Gulmarg. Good service and view. As good as a five star!! Must visit. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: panks_41086
reviews.title: snowy resort
reviews.text: This the best resort in Gulmarg. We stayed there for 3 nights during winter. When we reached there was snow fall going on so It was fully covered with fresh snow & looking very beautiful. Very good ambiance with very good feeling. Staff was very courteous & helpful. Rooms were also good & spacious. Food was also good. Specially the Kehwa served here was very good.
