reviews.author: pawanlakhotia
reviews.title: Very nice location
reviews.text: The hotel is very nicely located in the centre of Gulmarg very close to Gandola may not be more than 300 mtrs. The food  in the restaurant was good but hotel rooms were just OK compared to its very high price.

reviews.author: Aptraveler10
reviews.title: Amazing place fantastic experience
reviews.text: We stayed for a week in March and were very impressed by the quality of service at this hotel. The hotel was completely packed with large families and it snowed continuously for 4 dayes but the service remained excellent . Rooms are very well maintained , hot water , heating services continued uninterrupted , the staff is very friendly and helpful. The spa, pool, facilities are great. Wonderful place .

reviews.author: Sagar vikas
reviews.title: EXCELLENT KHYBER WOOOW OWESEM
reviews.text: khyber is owesem i visit with my friends to gulmarg then we go to khyber resort for lunch it was like booom so sweet food so delicious food from my side ***** to khyber this place is owesem to enjoy entertainment .....i definitely visit again inshallah...

reviews.author: AV Shah
reviews.title: EXCELLENT HOTEL!!!
reviews.text:
The Hotel is very well made amidst the himalayas!! absolutely superb Interiors, Aminities, Views, Quality of Staff hospitality, Everything about this hotel is a treat to be in, not to forget the Best Views from the hotel rooms, lobby's or from anywhere you stand...
Amazing view while swimming..Food is very good too..!!
The GM Mr Sujith very warm and courteous.

reviews.author: Jayant_333
reviews.title: Must visit
reviews.text:
It is expensive.....It is an absolute must! It is beautiful and must include in your itinerary. 
If you can afford the stay ....go ahead! Splurge! The rooms are nice. The view is to die for! The indoor pool is good! The hospitality is great! The sit outs are awesome!
But, what do you do when you are on a budget?? Go there for an evening tea! Enjoy their delicious Khawa and biscuits! Enjoy their view! Behave nice and come back ;)

reviews.author: parsvakumar
reviews.title: Khyber , Gulmarg
reviews.text: Nice hotel , Brilliant ambience ,good facility for the children to play indoors, nice spa and heated indoor swimming pool ,useful in all seasons. Sad part is limited food variety , only one restaurant . Very nice facility to keep your extra clothes and footwear for snow in the security area without having to carry it to your room .

reviews.author: Gayathri P
reviews.title: Bliss
reviews.text: It was wonderful being there. Enjoyed the peace and tranquillity. I cannot forget the hospitality offered by the staffs. A good menu which is a treat to your appetite. We were lucky to witness the snow fall. The hotel facilities, swimming pool and spa were excellent. Looking forward to visiting the resort again.

reviews.author: JADE-NY0079
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel but NO BAR OR ALCOHOL!
reviews.text: The hotel setting is really idyllic and the rooms are very nice and spa excellent. The staff were friendly but seem more geared for domestic than international guests though and generally had only very rudimentary english language skills - with all due respect, as I have no Hindi or Urdu!  Notably, the hotel has NO BAR and NO ALCOHOL on the premises. It isn't a particularly festive or lively place, although the premises are lovely.  This came as a bit of shock.  The food was acceptable, especially given the very remote location. Wifi was reasonably reliable but not very fast - but that's not necessarily a bad thing in a place so remote and beautiful.  Very comfortable bed and room was warm when it was sub-zero outside!

reviews.author: Ami
reviews.title: lovely staff and hotel
reviews.text: We stayed here on a birthday were given a discount due to this and brought a surprise birthday cake. A really nice room and view, restaurant and extremely hospitable staff! Thankyou very much we had a great stay.

reviews.author: BombayNomad
reviews.title: Lot of potential. Major improvements needed.
reviews.text:
When you enter the hotel, you are in awe of the architecture, design and the views. Unparalleled, I should say. Rooms are brilliant. Swimming pool and spa area are astounding. 

But the hotel lacks Kashmiri hospitality and warmth. Food is average and overpriced. Breakfast, though, is really nice. In some ways, it lacks soul. Too 5 star-ish for my liking. 

Stayed there for 3 nights during honeymoon. Glad we chose it. With the corrections suggested, this could be among the best hotels in India.

reviews.author: Brijacob16
reviews.title: Worth the wait
reviews.text:
The wife and I have been planning a holiday here for a while. Their unavailability speaks of their popularity. Finally we managed to make it for our anniversary and boy were we glad we did.
The ambience, location, rooms, staff is all 5 star. It's warm (thanks to the central heating) friendly and homely. The spa is a must visit and so too is the heated pool.
Hat tip to Sujit, the GM who you will find all smiles, warm and welcoming at the lobby taking care and listening to everyone on everything.

However the only thing that needs drastic improvement is the food. The restaurant and the food is just passable. Breakfast is strictly nice but that's about it. 
Would recommend heading to (by car) Highlands Park for a meal and you will know what I mean.
Hence only a 4 Star rating :)

reviews.author: VishvVijaeS
reviews.title: The balcony was so beautiful!!
reviews.text: I visited this beautiful property in Nov 2015.  This resorts is beautiful and close to the Gandola lift. Our room had a beautiful balcony facing the khillan marg mountains  covered with  fresh snow, we spent our whole day sitting there watching that beautiful nature and breathing the fresh air. Interiors of property are very nicely done. the indoor heated pool was a charm. The only problem i faced was making a reservation with them as no one picks there reservation line tel. no's.  But that was all compensated with their service and hospitality. would love to visit here again.

reviews.author: Idris E
reviews.title: Not upto the expectation.
reviews.text:
I have nothing new to add as my experience was more or less same on the line of other reviews rating the experience terrible,poor or average. Just one heads up to all going for premier rooms. 
1. Avoid Odd no rooms.(View sucks, I had a nice car parking view. needless to say curtain remained shut all the time)
2 Avoid corner rooms near the staircase. you will be unwilling party to every conversation other guests walking past by are having(rooms are not sound proof)
3. Don't go for the non refundable payment option. keep your options open if you don't like the allotted room.

Positives.

1.Excellent room service.
2. Excellent Dining area with beautiful view.
3. Beautiful Beautiful Beautiful property.

I just wish that front office staff was less condescending, subtly rude. 
I did feel that had I gone for more expensive room, I would have been treated better.
but it is not that horrible either. Just stand up for yourself & don't get intimidated. 

Tips for other traverllers.

1. In house restaurant is expensive so go for  plan inclusive of breakfast & Dinner.
2. Don't go for non refundable payment option, you end up saving some money but you are left with no option if you do not like the allotted room.
3. If you have booked premier room, go for even numbered rooms. they have better view.
4. Incoming calls  in your rooms fixed line are allowed don't trust the front office guy who introduces & welcomes you to the property. and tells you otherwise.

reviews.author: Anuradha257
reviews.title: Heavenly abode in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
The wood finished hotel is in stark contrast to the cold of January in Gulmarg. The warmth of the decor is welcoming on stepping inside after the chilly wind. The attention paid to  view of the snow clad environs from the lobby, dining area and swimming pool is praiseworthy. The pool is one of its kind with glass walls on three sides showing only snow-clad Gulmarg as far as one can see. The artefacts and photos all round the hotel were beautiful.
I had a Deluxe room which could have had a better view from its glass wall if facing the opposite side but they were full when requested.
The services are very good. Pool comes with jacuzzi, steam & sauna. The L'Occitane spa is one of the few in India with very good ambience. We tried the Relaxing and Deep tissue massage, both very good. Staff is courteous and helpful.
Breakfast was good. Dinner could have been much better for such a nice hotel.

reviews.author: nikhilzaveri
reviews.title: Out of this world
reviews.text: Can't believe the hotel can match the heaven on earth...Kashmir is indeed heaven on earth nd this hotel matched it. We had gone for our anniversary in winter nd  the service ,ambiance nd view from the room was unparallel .the best part was we were swimming in the beautiful heated swimming pool nd it was 2degrees cold outside.. Really had a nice time. Hope they provide the transport to nd fro at their cost next time.

reviews.author: Vivek Sharma
reviews.title: Worth visiting, food and service can be better
reviews.text:
First up, I am a native of J&K and frankly I felt a lot of pride while staying in this property, that someone from my state had the courage and vision to invest in a property of this grandeur. A big thumbs up to the owners who have created one of the best properties I have ever stayed in. The resort is done beautifully, both on the outside and interiors. In fact, walking through the lobby area and the corridors, you actually get this feeling that someone has indeed built this property with a lot of passion. It is beautiful from both the inside and the outside, and the heated pool with glass walls and a view of snow-clad mountains from the outside is simply breathtaking.
The resort is indeed very expensive but at the end of the experience, you will feel that it is worth the money spent. However, there are three downsides:
1. The food was just okay. I gorge on Kashmiri food but not even a single thing I had could be called mouth watering (and it doesn't feel good when it is also outrageously expensive). Bored with the food, we started eating outside food for lunch and dinners over the next two days
2. Wifi is paid and ridiculously expensive. It will not cost a lot to offer a free Wifi service and on the other hand I'm not sure how much you earn through a paid Wifi service-take that measured call to make customers happier
3. Room service was pathetic-we had to wait for a good 45 minutes to get some basic crockery into our room and had to call up at least 4-5 times to finally get it. At another occasion, we had ordered chinese food and asked for Soy, Chilli and tomato sauce. We just got a bottle of tomato sauce after 30 minutes and the staff member told us that he will get us the rest soon, he never turned up!!
Apart from the minor irritants above which can be taken care of, it was definitely an unforgettable stay. Am likely to come back again.

reviews.author: Manuj
reviews.title: Luxury at super premium rates !!
reviews.text: I stayed at this hotel in the month of August. Hotel offers unparallel luxury in Gulmarg. I am a vegetarian and faced no issues with finding vegetarian food rather I loved their veg Biryani & Dum aloo kashmiri. Rooms are luxurious and toiletries match the class. All said stay at this hotel when you want to splurge but rest assured view from hotel coffee room is spectacular.

reviews.author: Sahiba B
reviews.title: Truly magical!
reviews.text:
We spent two nights at khyber and we were blown away by the beauty of the hotel and he hospitality! The views are magical from all the rooms, the food is exceptional and the hotel staff is warm, friendly and go out of their way to serve you. I informed the hotel that it was our anniversary trip and they sent a complimentary cake with a special note on the card, with the message that we had asked to be written on the cake. 

The kahwa served at chaikash was the best in all of Kashmir, the tabak maas was outstanding and our server-iqbal was at our beck and call. 

The spa experience is a must and so is a dip in the heated indoor pool. It's a different experience to swim overlooking the forest, trees dusted with snow. 

I would like to make a special mention of a few people who went an extra mile to serve us and make our stay memorable- Nazia and Iqbal. Asif at the chaikash counted was always smiling and also offered me a free kahwa :) 

Thank you everyone at Khyber. I strongly recommend this hotel to all travellers to Gulmarg. Gulmarg isn't the same if you haven't spent at least one night at Khyber!

reviews.author: hemant b
reviews.title: One of the Best Resorts in India During the Winters!
reviews.text:
The view and location of the Resort is just amazing! 
Starting from the Lobby to the restaurants to the hookah lounge to the chai bar to the rooms to the view! The food is really really good, love the chickens, kebabs and even Dal Makhani ( Yummmm ), the resort has a facility for spa as well, all must try it, its pretty good.

reviews.author: aparajita b
reviews.title: Luxurious & Indulgent
reviews.text:
Khyber is the kind of hotel you spoil yourself with. When its completely snowed out outside, you can sit in the centrally heated hotel, with decent food and areas to sit and sip your hot chocolate and watch the snow falling around you.

The rooms are luxurious and well appointed, but have small issues like the heating system, which has a mind of its own, a bathroom floor which floods a little while you're still in the shower, and the shower which is a little tricky to figure out. Nothing that cannot be ignored, when you realise the temperature outside is -12.

The staff is very pleasant, everybody from the guards at the gate (who deserve a medal for standing in that much snow), the serving staff at their restaurant, the reception, captains, house keeping staff, every individual is top notch and a its a pleasure to interact with them.

The food is super expensive, and considering there is no way you can venture out in the snow at dinner time to eat somewhere else, talk to the staff to give you a package deal. The food itself is good, with some stand outs like the mutton raan and the kadhi, though the temperature of the food is a bit of an issue.

reviews.author: PiyushJalandhara
reviews.title: Himalayan Retreat
reviews.text: This is best of all Kashmir in terms of hospitality and location. I am glad to have chosen to stay with Khyber on my first ever visit to Kashmir. I have been travelling for 10 years now covering various location, this one I would rate as my best stay ever and I am sure this would  be remain number 1 in my list. They are unmatched in terms of hospitality and quality across Kashmir. To view sunrise or sunset go to terrace Nouf and enjoy the peace and tranquility of sunrising/ sunsetting  over Himalayas. Pool / Jacuzzi was under maintenance, however visit to pool area is must to catcht the glimpse of himalayan reflection in the indoor pool. Right from reservation desk to Hotel manager to the chef ensured that every bit of our stay was enjoyable and making it more memorable. Breakfast buffet is scrumptious and grand. Special thanks to Mr. Aabid and Mr. Basharat. I am sure to visit again.

reviews.author: Rohit G
reviews.title: Expensive but worth trying
reviews.text:
Location - fantastic, luxury balcony room with himalyan view.we stayed at room 2015.
Food- average to good. Very expensive
Comfort - excellent
Facilities- although swimming pool was closed for renovation but i am sure once resumed overall the facilities would rate 5 star.
Room' very good, spacious.
Hospitality- excellent at its best.

Overall a great property to stay but at a high cost.
Lots of staff member to br thanked for their hospitality -Mr Ashar ( duty manager) Mr Irfan to name few. These were the names i could recall but trust the entire staff was extremly courteous.

reviews.author: Priyank K
reviews.title: Amazing Place
reviews.text: Best resort in Gulmarg. The locations and the scenic views are just perfect. Although the food prices are a little steep but the surroundings more than make up for it. Highly recomment to stay and have fun.

reviews.author: Pooja P
reviews.title: Heaven on earth
reviews.text: The scenery was reminiscent of Narnia and the hotel a luxury spa. It was a totally different world, warm and cozy on the inside and white blanket of snow outside..the hotel is all glass, high bay windows which make you feel that the snow is just a touch away. Our room overlooked the valley and getting up in the morning to snow in the balcony rated as one of the unforgettable moments. You could look at the valley from the bath tub as well and the swimming pool is to die for! Only that swimming after this will feel boring for the rest of your life! The hotel deserves 5 stars and more for the location and amenities. Bucket list variety

reviews.author: manan03
reviews.title: FIRST ANNIVERSARY
reviews.text: We stayed in Khyber for 2 nights..We had experienced both the views, himalayan as well as gulmarg view..both the views were mesmerizing..moreover gandola tickets were available at the walking distance of 5 min from the hotel..the staff was very cooperative..great hospitality shown by the staff and our special thanks to Mr. Zafar Malik for making our trip so memorable..we'll soon be planning a family trip..the warmth and hospitality shown by the staff will definitely make it to reach the greater heights..

reviews.author: Markus R
reviews.title: The best hotel you can get in Gulmarg
reviews.text: Wer nach Gulmarg geht, der weiß, auf was er sich einlässt. Das Khyber ist mit Abstand besser als alle anderen Hotels in Gulmarg, verdient im internationalen Vergleich aber die Sterne nicht wirklich. Das Essen ist gut, der Service auch und die Anlage ist auch schön. In den Details, die jedoch nach westlichen Standards Hotels dieser Klasse ausmachen, fehlt es aber. Aber wie gesagt - nachdem wir auch in anderen Hotels waren würden wir nur noch das Khyber buchen.

reviews.author: swetamodi
reviews.title: Paradise on Earth
reviews.text:
The best property in Gulmarg....amazing views from the Himalaya facing rooms....with a cozy balcony....
Food is excellent...breakfast is a well spread buffet....ala carte menu also is really nice...
Service is good...staff is hospitable and courteous...

though we had a bad experience while checking out...they kept calling from 10.30 to vacate room at 12...we informed them that we will do it by 1...but they kept insisting they were full and needed by 12...then we called them to check if extension was possible and they immediately said rooms are available and we can extend....then what was the hurry to vacate the room for check out? They are stuck up on checking out at 12 without any consideration...

reviews.author: kunalgarggalaxy
reviews.title: Anniversary
reviews.text:
Best location, best ambience, cooperative and well trained staff.
The best part of the resort is its location. I booked a normal room but when I reached there I was upgraded to a premium room due to our 1st wedding anniversary.
A large variety of delicious meals at this altitude is a wonderful thing.
Good luck and keep it up.

reviews.author: Akanksha02
reviews.title: Truly a paradise
reviews.text:
Gulmarg is insanely beautiful and to experience that one should definitely stay in this hotel in the balcony room with himalayan view.. Right from check in to the time of check out had such a memorable time.. Each and every staff member of this resort was so courteous and well mannered especially Mr Rouf at guest help desk and Mr Faizal in the managing team. Thanks for arranging the surprise for our anniversary and making it even more special. The room was very nice with an amazing view.. bathroom was also nice, neat and clean.. Buffet was not appealing but the food we had in ala carte was very tasty. coffee shop is lil overpriced.. Spa services were good and relaxing.. had an awesome time together and would definitely plan to come back with my family soon.. 
Suggestion - as prepaid connections don't work in J&K you should provide FREE Wi-Fi in the rooms

reviews.author: Krishna_joshi
reviews.title: Superbbbbbb
reviews.text:
Check in process is:  u r taken to cafe with a spectacular mountain view and offered traditional kashmiri tea, and then escorted with a staff who guides u for all the property and room. Truly great way to start .

I stayed in balcony room, which is huge in size with great bathroom and nice tub. View is just wonderful from balcony. All amenities are modern with kashmiri art touch. Property is pretty big. SPA is also great , and really enjoyed the couple spa. The corridors, facade, and all other areas have great colour combination, with music and makes a great ambience all together. 

Don't forget to try Sheesha at there Cabalash cafe. In such cold, a hookah really makes u feel great. Only issue their food prices are equal to TAJ hotels ;-) ... Breakfast spread is also nice. Wifi is paid but 3g connection is good for mobile users so u can use mobile data itself. Business desk is available free and can be used. 

Please note in Gulmarg only those people who have reservation in hotels near Gandola (very few hotels ) are allowed to carry their own car. Others who stay outside or near taxi stand, have to use horse for reaching Gandola ride. Luckily Khyber is just 2 min walk from Gandola so we can carry our car right upto hotel.

On a vacation with wife, i can say for sure , your better half will be just love your decision of staying here and will be impressed.

reviews.author: vishubhanu
reviews.title: KHYBER IS REALY THE PARADISE IN KASHMIR
reviews.text:
I stayed in this hotel for only one night on the occasion of my Marriage Anniversary, find the place EXCELLENT to stay.The rooms are modern , warm and comfortable, you have a good feeling staying there.This type of property was needed in Gulmarg. We had some good food at dinner which was fresh and tastes yummy,.I have taken services of the spa in the evening which were nice and the spa is equipped with all the mod facilities . The morning breakfast was also GOOD.The staff was nice.

BUT BUT BUT, My review is incomplete without praising a person, I met at the hotel, the name is MR. ANUPAM BHAN, he was i think a manager there in some dptt..A well educated and friendly man, moreover we were from same city. He make my day more wonderful by gifting us a cake in surprise, also offered us discounts in all amenities of the hotel. These type of persons helps improving the goodwill of the hotel and maintains healthy relations with the guests.

OVERALL This property is good but the prices are a bit on the higher side, but still Recommend This hotel to have a comfortable stay in Gulmarg.

Stayed 20th November 2015, travelled with my wife.

reviews.author: srldelhi
reviews.title: Views not as good as Highlands park
reviews.text: We stayed in mid june in khyber gulmarg. The hotel is quite new with good rooms and facilities but iam afaid the views from the hotel are not as good as highlands park where we had stayed during our last visit. khyber does not offer open views to gulmarg but i believe it would be much better in winters as it is close to gandola lifts.

reviews.author: Nazish A
reviews.title: Amazing !!
reviews.text:
Was travelling on a golf trip , we went for lunch at Khyber, it was simply awesome. Staff & Manager were too cordial. One person in particular was very polite & cordial, topping with most humble service was Mr. Sajjad. I had already read about his service on trip advisor and was surprised to see that he was our server. Great experience, ordered chinese food, was too good. 
Next time staying there for sure! Nazish &Amer

reviews.author: Bhavara
reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text:
Me and my wife really enjoyed the hospitality here , the service is very polite , food is out of the world 

I did my own booking, and though the prices were steep, but befits the luxury they offer you, this hotel beats any 5 or 6 star hotels in Srinagar 

The rooms are having great view though you need to take the pricey upper floor rooms which have clear and unrestricted view of snow crested peaks 

the beds, the bathrooms the balcony spell sheer luxury , pls ask hotel to arrange your airport pick up and drop as otherwise you may be left high and dry 

The hotel arranged all outdoor trips and staff is very attentive and they shall give you good idea of what ought to be done 

The breakfast has an amazing spread including locally made preservatives from fresh fruits , even the dinner which we had there many times was tastefully made and lovingly served , do try their signature dish Mutton Rogan Gosh which is best I ever had. 

Shall certainly recommend this property without any qualifications

reviews.author: Mairaj
reviews.title: Graaaannnddd !!!!
reviews.text: A beautiful property with charming staff.. Stayed here for two weeks nights and enjoyed to the fullest.fullest. Didn't  get the time to try the spa. Beautiful location and amazing views even from the base category. Breakfast and dinner was good with large spread.

reviews.author: ashisinghchd
reviews.title: Good hotel but highly overpriced
reviews.text: Khyber in gulmarg is good hotel in proximity with gandola. The rooms are nicely done up but the prices are very steep both for rooms and food. We almost paid close to 500$ per night with breakfast and dinner per couple. The hotel does not have a bar in spite of charging such steep rates therefore carry your own liquor. We went to see highlands park on our friends reccomendation and it has much better views as compared to khyber so yu can try that as it was resonably priced around 10k per night.

reviews.author: AnAustralianAngel
reviews.title: Simply Heaven !!
reviews.text:
This resort has the best location. The views are simply fantastic. The food is good. Service is polite n friendly. Management are very helpful. I loved everybit of my stay. Will reccommend anyday and will surely return. 

Great for couples, families or friends. 

Look at my pics and u will know this place is worth coming.

reviews.author: Nitu Jain
reviews.title: Nitu Jain
reviews.text: Excellent hospitality in every sense..The perfect view, the perfect atmosphere in the resort even though it was snowing outside. Every member in the resort makes it a point to make you extra comfortable. A must visit. Thank you Khyber for the memorable time we had there.

reviews.author: manisha91086
reviews.title: 5 star property  The most beautiful and luxurious hotel
reviews.text: Very good property  and good service  .Situated on a hilltop in Gulmarg. Travelling time by car is approximately 1.5 hours from Srinagar airport.  Was staying in 1001 room . Spacious luxury rooms.with pine tree and chinara trees view .

reviews.author: Sarbari G
reviews.title: The most desirable place to stay in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Khyber for one night in October 2015.  Tired  from all the adventure one had undertaken during the day, I just wanted to slump into a chair to never get up again.  However, the reception staff were very friendly and courteous and helped me by encouraging me to take rest, being nice and hospitable to me and even showing  multiple rooms so that I could choose one with a good view.  

I have forgotten the name of the lady from the reception who showed us to our room, but her service orientation was excellent.  She stayed around till I was happy with the room that was allocated to me.  

The room was very nice needless to say, like all other five star facilities.  lovely bathroom with separate cubicle for showers, WC and a great bathtub.  all other facilities of tea/coffee, TV etc like any other five star facilities were available in the room. 

I would like to write about what I liked about the hotel.  I liked their service orientation. I have already written about the lady from the reception who needs a special mention.  now about others -  I needed to get a pair of trousers laundered and they did that within three hours.  I also loved the restaurant staff, their attentiveness, the quality of the food and their friendly services.   

the hotel's location is fantastic, surrounded by the mountains and jungles, beautiful large french glass windows and lovely decor, the rooms are welcoming and warm. 

I did not use the spa so cant write about that.  They could have given free WiFi but that did not matter much.

It is certainly the most desirable place to stay in Gulmarg.  I came back as a happy guest.

reviews.author: Clonemole
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text:
We stayed for just a night in Sep'15. The service quality is very good, you are given a thorough welcome brief by a customer service lady which is rare nowadays . 
Food is good but not great. The massages very slightly expensive but worth the money. And the indoor heated pool is the cherry on top. 
Gulmarg as a place is very basic offering splendid scenic beauty. Making this hotel as a base for your Gulmarg more than makes sense as it is the best in the area.

reviews.author: gurinder o
reviews.title: good hotel
reviews.text: very good rooms excellent stay.front desk manager is so nice they upgrade my room free of coost.resturent bit expensive.sona steam gym swimming stunning.loction of balcoany rooms  perfect.definitely best hotel in gulmarg.

reviews.author: Pravinmainkar
reviews.title: 60 th birthday celebration
reviews.text:
Excellent We have been there on 25 th September 2015.
Great hospitality.
Nice location with good view from our balcony.
I have celebrated my 60 th birthday on that day.
Unforgettable experience.
Excellent & tasty food.
Thinking of visiting again with my son & daughter when they visit India.

reviews.author: Amitabh  Y
reviews.title: Khyber himalyan Resort and spa at gulmarg kashmir a heaven on earth by "My Family Escapes"
reviews.text: Khyber Himalayan Resort and spa is situated in town of Gulmarg. The capital of state of jammu and kashmir in India I would recommended the Himalayan view room it is spectacular worth every penny food was great there is a lovely sheesha cigar lounge I don't have words to describe the beauty of the place and the view of the hotel. Services are excellent.Loved enjoyed long hours at the balcony. Very cooperative and attentive staff. Extremely helpful.  recommended to me by My Family Escapes..

reviews.author: Bijoy M P
reviews.title: First anniversary at heaven
reviews.text: It was our first anniversary and we decided to spend the weekend at gulmarg and we have booked khyber for 3 nights. it was 3 hours drive from srinagar airport. excellent location. walkable distance from gondola station. checkin was smooth with a welcome drink the traditional kashmiri kahwa. we have booked premier room but we got an upgradation to luxury balcony room with himalayan view. no words for the view from the room.simply awesome...!!! overall excellent luxury hotel at 8825 ft above sea level.

reviews.author: Vineet_Gautam
reviews.title: Heaven on earth
reviews.text: We were here for 3 days and 2 nights . A very hurriedly planned trip but this place was in my mind for long  and it disappoint a bit. This is he best place to go .. The hotel is just beautiful with all modern amenities you can ask for . Though there was no snow but would love to go back when there is snow. Staff is good and food very very good though breakfast choices could be improved . We tried mutton biryani which undoubtedly was the best I ever had . Even dum aloo Kashmiri was very good ...

reviews.author: Soumava N
reviews.title: Amazing service
reviews.text: The idea of an indoor pool , sauna , steam, jacuzzi , spa ..in gulmarg itself is a thrill. Tried out the resort as gondola was not operational the day we reached gulmarg. Mutton sheekh kabab & hukka has to be tried .apart from the dip in the larger than life pool experience. Hotel staff ..pretty amazing ..helfpful & smiling .. there were some issues with internet during our stay yet they made the entire checkout experience very smooth .. will definitely stay again

reviews.author: Shutterbugger
reviews.title: Great location, interiors & service. Bit pricey, but highly recommended
reviews.text:
We stayed there as a couple in Sep 2015. We found the tariff a bit steep but would be willing to repeat our stay in the winters there. Its a beautifully done up property with lovely landscaped lawns and pool/spa area. There are lots of steps inside and outside the resort - might be tough for the elderly or those with physical challenges.

We stayed in #4003 which was a non-balcony room. was spacious and comfortable. the higher priced balcony rooms with mountain view would be great if you're willing to pay up extra for the awesome view. balcony rooms with Gulmarg view don't have a special view - imo not worth the extra charges.

+ LOCATION-situated within 7-10 mins walking distance from the Gulmarg Gondola (cable car to Apharwat peak). helps steer clear of hiring ponies. on the flip side, the walk back from Gondola to the hotel is a bit steep and tiring for unfit people
+ INTERIORS-very well done up. comfortable and clean. modern, clean bathrooms. however, maintenance could be better in some areas (more below)
+ FOOD-found it to be decent. breakfast spread is very extensive (eggs, multiple south indian options, north indian, fruits, breads, juices etc). traditional kashmiri cuisine was really tasty
+ SERVICE-calls to the front desk and housekeeping were promptly answered and requests fulfilled quickly. wait staff at the restaurant was also good and very friendly.

- BATHROOM MAINTENANCE-one of the tiles in the bathroom was broken. shower area water was getting clogged due to drainage issues. found the bathtub a bit dirty and had to ask for it to be re-cleaned before using it. For the tariff they charge (comparable to 5*), these issues should not be there at all!
- CHARGEABLE WIFI-given its remote location and tariff being charged, it should have been wi-fi with limits on the # of devices allowed
- CENTRAL A/C- it gets uncomfortably hot during the day. perhaps it needs to recalibrate for summer months since temps definitely need to be a bit cooler than they are set in Aug/Sep. in-room controls don't work in modulating temperature

SPA-we used the spa for a neck,shoulder,head massage session. It wasn't bad but we've had better massages elsewhere. Didn't think there was anything distinctive here owing to the L'Occitane tag.

reviews.author: neerajhardik
reviews.title: Good hotel limited views
reviews.text: Khyber resorts Gulmarg is a recently opened good hotel with modern facilities however the views from the hotels are very limited. The hotel does not open up to views of Gulmarg bowl. We went to highlands park and founds the views to be much better. Overall average because of limited views.

reviews.author: Smritipuri
reviews.title: Will be visiting AGAIN!!!!
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed at Khyber Jan 2015. I would recommend the Himalayan view room. It is spectacular worth every penny. :) food was great. Although since it's a spa resort no alcohol available. There is lovely sheesha/cigar lounge. I don't have words to describe the beauty of the place and the view from the hotel. Services are excellent. I fell ill because of cold cold weather thankfully they had a Dr available 24/7 special thanks to Aijaz to be readily helpful at all times and making our stay further more pleasant.

reviews.author: nitasha_communique
reviews.title: The best ski restort in India!
reviews.text: The food, the staff, the location, the indoor pool and the bar, make Khyber a place one must visit to get an athentic ski resort feel in India. The staff we thought were rude initially, however, later we realised the hotel is overbooked and they were overworked and were actually very sweet. Getting here was a problem as we were stuck in a snow storm, eventually we had to be pulled up on snowmobiles, luggage and all in town in the freezing cold and snow, but that made the entire thing memorable as i remember it till today! Kashmir is a beauty and Khyber makes it even more beautiful if possible. The heated indoor pool and the much needed spa spells luxury and while expensive, we suggest you go in for all 3 meals at the hotel as its not easy to roam around in colder months namely oct-march.

reviews.author: Meha1234
reviews.title: very relaxing and beautiful
reviews.text:
We had heard a lot about the property and thus booked this as a treat to both me and my husband after our 10 day trip in leh. Though the hotel is pretty, few points they could improve on:
1. Due to less occupancy, the hotel did not look fully operational. Ex - no Buffet ( which was a disappointment for meat lovers) Also for veg, there were limited options apart from few mains in Indian dishes. 
2. Lights were dim throughout the hotel etc. 
3.The wifi was very slow
4.The hotel could add more activities and maintain the existing ones like snooker table a little better
5. The AC in the rooms don't work on individual need basis as the hotel is centrally managed. Hence in Aug, the room gets a bit too warm while sleeping.

The pluses:
1.The staff however, was very polite and courteous and ensured we have a lovely stay. The manager too went out of the way to get us an upgrade so we could enjoy the mountain view with a balcony. That made us feel really on top of the world literally and not made us feel the pinch in the wallet due to the high prices of the rooms even in off season. 
2. Quiet and relaxing
3. Rooms were very comfortable with excellent bathrooms. 
.
Overall, nice experience but would be better in season time when the hotel really looks beautiful with snow.

reviews.author: Ruchira61
reviews.title: Khyber
reviews.text:
We were a group of 6 couples on a holiday. Gulmarg still has a wild natural beauty unparalleled. The pine slopes and meadows are paradise. Khyber is the only destination for Kashmir. The hotel is beautiful.  The mountain facing balcony rooms were the best. The bathrooms luxurious. The staff and the GM went out of their way to ensure a memorable stay
Do take the cable to stage 2 and ATV ride around the meadows

reviews.author: Rohitas
reviews.title: Second memorable visit in a year
reviews.text:
I Visited Khyber second time in a year. I would  definitely come back again. The experience was again top of the world. The property, the scenic views & the service score 10/10. However, the food layouts were not elaborate. The personal service offered  by the  staff members compensated for this lacuna.  
There was another small irritant. You have to pay for the additional sensor keys which was unbecoming of any 5 stars. 
I would definitely recommend Khyber to be the place to stay.

reviews.author: Rushman1
reviews.title: Great location and service
reviews.text: Visited the place in July 15. Sitting on top of Gulmarg the hotel has great views of the Himalayas. I would like to say a special thank you to the staff for all their help with my reservations and check in as well as great service. Hope to be there in the winters too

reviews.author: manishabinani
reviews.title: gulmargs crown
reviews.text: very courteous staff. awesome ambience. wonderful amenities comfort par excellence. food still brings water to my mouth.congrats chef n thanku for amazing samosa chaat n hot pakodas.convinient location

reviews.author: Puneeta_j
reviews.title: Luxury in the lap of nature!
reviews.text:
The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa is the most luxurious hotel in Gulmarg. They have a cordial staff. Room that I stayed in was of premium category. They are small but neat and tidy. Good, pro-active room service. Food I feel is overpriced. Hotels boasts of an interesting architecture, magnificent wooden decor with beautiful lobbies.

Over all it a peaceful place away from the stress of life!

reviews.author: greeengirl
reviews.title: Stunning... Stunning.... Stunning
reviews.text: What can one say about Khyber... it's a stunning hotel with a stunning backdrop against it.... the spa is nice for a massage, the pool lovely but we had a lot of kids making noise... but that's probably a one time thing... the food was good... a little spicy... but it's gorgeous.. a 2 min walk from the gondolas.... a must stay when in gulmarg.. .so much so, that please plan your visit to gulmarg according to the hotel's availability.

reviews.author: ML84
reviews.title: Royal, Gorgeous and Simply Superb
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful and a very memorable stay at the Khyber Gulmarg. What an awesome property so tastefully and well done. 

Right from the staff to the location to the room views. Please stay in the Himalayan view rooms they are breathtakingly beautiful and worth every penny.

Also the food at their restaurant is excellent. Very good buffet spread and excellent variety and superb taste.

We enjoyed every bit of our stay thanks to Jerin, Zaffar, Preet and Bikash you guys are awesome and can't thank you enough.

I totally recommend this property as a must stay and visit.

A special mention the Spa was excellent and worth the money. Thank you Bikash.

Can't wait to plan my next stay here.

reviews.author: VanessaMunYee
reviews.title: fantastic view
reviews.text:
This luxury resort located right at the hilltop from the Cable car station and we could just hike from the resort to some really nice alley

The lobby is huge however the staff took so long to check us in. We had to go for lunch first while waiting for the check in. 

Our room was huge and clean with a couch and a balcony with fantastic view. We had a comfortable bed. Bathroom was clean and big with enough amenities.

They have a restaurant with excellent mountain view.

Wifi is not free.

reviews.author: janetmac
reviews.title: Double Bath with Mountain View
reviews.text: We were very well received at this hotel. Although our stay was just for one night we had a very good room with great facilities and a good view of the mountains (when the clouds lifted).  The buffet dinner had great choices with fresh Naan cooked to order.  Restaurant staff very helpful and informative about the food on offer.  Gondola was a disappointment - we went up for the view but top station was in the cloud and then it started to snow.  Great for those who had never seen snow before but a downer for us.

reviews.author: Malini N
reviews.title: A gem on the snow capped peaks!
reviews.text: The Khyber Resort is truly a gem set in the beautiful Gulmarg. If you visit when Gulmarg is a beautiful breathtaking white magic carpet around you, and in the midst of it is set a beautifully crafted warm haven called the Khyber! Wood has been painstakingly crated throughout this hotel to give it warmth and natural ambiance of comfort. The warmth of the staff is another reason to stay here. The lobby is designed in traditional decor and the round, large heritage seating arrangements with cushions makes you want to curl up with a book and just relax. The hotel is a short walk away from the skiing centre and the famous cable car ride. The rooms are cosy yet royal and the balcony is a treat where you can watch the snowfall if you are lucky to have one, and take some amazing pictures. The authentic Kashmiri food and especially the meat preparations are a must try. Amazing indeed, served lovingly by the staff. A hotel  you will regret checking out of! If you are in Gulmarg Khyber is the place to stay.

reviews.author: Navneet Maheshwari
reviews.title: Very disappointed with the service.
reviews.text: We have been to many exotic destinations, they charge the price but make sure the service is unforgettable . But here at KHYBER , unfortunately there is no service. We order in the day, it comes by night. We have to keep calling them again and again . There is no concierge so they have no information about anything. It's an Absolutely overpriced hotel for the kind of treatment you get. There are No Room slippers, No dental kit , No utility stuff provided in the room after paying much, so you can imagine what service will we get here.

reviews.author: RekhaThaker
reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: We visited in April this year and the resort was covered in snow to our surprise. Most beautiful place this is. The food is also very nice. The buffet laid for breakfast and dinner is excellent. The service provided at the restaurant is great. Mr. Sajjad Lone really took care of us at the restaurant. The rooms to select should be himalayan view. We used the spa facility but were not very pleased. The heated indoor pool is great. My husband had a fall and the in house doctor  Nazir was of great help. Too good a place and given a chance I can go again and again. The draw back is no free internet. They charge you for it and that is not right after the rates what they charge you for the rooms.

reviews.author: debjani g
reviews.title: a piece of heaven on earth
reviews.text: Checked in today and I so don't wanna leave anytime soon... Gorgeous property, friendly staff and amazing food. I had booked a Himalaya view room and the view is to die for. And yes,  love the lot kahwah tea they serve at the lobby lounge. Already planning my next visit.

reviews.author: Sameer D
reviews.title: Excellent hotel and even better assistance
reviews.text:
We Went to Gulmarg in March 2015 and we stayed at his property which was awesome. The hotel is by far the best property there. The rooms were spacious although we got really lucky with an upgrade to the Himalyan views room the last one available at the property when we were there. The hotel had a heated swimming pool which was awesome given it was cold with snow all around us at that time. The food was good we had opted for the half board which included the breakfast and dinner which works our really well. 

The staff at the hotel were really helpful. the GM Mr. Sujit, the front office head Mr. Jerin and also Ms. Preet. There were many others who helped us make our stay very unforgettable but cant remember all names now. 

The last info I would like to give for all travellers to this place. If you like to have a drink please carry your own as the hotel does not serve. they allow you to drink in their common areas as well so just carry your own and then enjoy the other facilities offered by this great property.

reviews.author: Deepa kapadia
reviews.title: location superb
reviews.text: breathtaking location clean hotel rooms very spacious live life king size . food excellent staff very helpful very welcoming we had a lovely holiday were there for 2 days rooms are better on first floor as we get an arial view . lot of snow activities just outside near hotel .was surprised as wifi was not free this was the only bad point .

reviews.author: udayan28decmaroo
reviews.title: A most scenic property
reviews.text:
A classy architecture has been created at scenic hilly terrain. The various facilities offered are well thought out and managed.
Food at the restaurant offers delicious varieties for all the meals. The staff I found to be most hospitable and cultured befitting the hardware it offers. Sure to revisit!

reviews.author: Sundeep H
reviews.title: Great hotel in an awesome location
reviews.text: Wonderful hotel with all the good things you expect from a five-star rated property. Especially liked the hot pool with fantastic views, and the authentic Kashmiri food that's among the best I've had. However, there was one serious problem - the rooms have very poor sound proofing... one can clearly hear what's going on in the next room. That can be a deal-breaker for some..

reviews.author: A.k
reviews.title: Great property, but lacks personalised service.
reviews.text:
Brilliant property in a brilliant  location...has every comfort imaginable...and a fantastic spa. However, the hotel lacks personal touch that you find in most other five star hotels.

Sample this...  due to certain dietary restrictions we asked to speak with the chef (in the only restaurant that they have). We were told that he was too busy to even come out for 2 minutes. We asked again as the waiter could not understand our requirements. Again the same reply... 
I've made similar requests in most other hotels, and have never been refused! In fact, the chefs are usually really understanding and eager to cook something that I can eat. And of course, the waiters are better trained!

When I pay 18,000 for a hotel room, and upwards of 3000 per meal, I surely expect more personalised service, especially when it's related to dietary restrictions. 

May I add that the food in their only restaurant is fairly average and needs improvement and the dinner buffet is quite unpalatable.

reviews.author: Vimal B
reviews.title: pay for 5 star and get facility of 7 star
reviews.text:
Location on hill top , mind blowing.Services &   facilities, everything superb.Amazing Panoramic view.Hotel surrounded by snow all around. Best experience.

Heated swimming pool 35* with wonderful spa reasonable priced..

Food as you want it, very good display in buffet. Jain Food available. .

Exceptional treatment.

To sum up we have traveled to many good properties including some luxury ones Kyber experience the best *************

reviews.author: Niklesh M
reviews.title: Heaven on Earth
reviews.text:
Khyber Hotel stay was just like a dream. Perfect Location , Great Hospitality , The Best.

I would recommend this Hotel to one and all visiting Gulamrg. 

The staff was very Courteous and the best I have ever seen. Food was awesome, 

Wel done !,

reviews.author: Nupur R
reviews.title: Excellent Hospitality, Beautiful, Serene. A must Visit
reviews.text: We stayed in this beautiful resort for three nights from 24th till 26th February, and it was one of the most memorable holidays my husband and I ever had. The view from the hotel is  fantastic. The amenities available are excellent. The hotel staff Mr. Aman, Mr. Saptarshi and the entire team are wonderful and so helpful and friendly that any recommendations for them cannot be said in words. This place is a Paradise for people who love winters and love to ski, as all options are very close to the hotel This place is a must visit in winters. Would Highly recommend to friends and guests.

reviews.author: FlyByKnight
reviews.title: Fantastic property!
reviews.text:
We stayed here for 3 nights, and loved it completely. What strikes you first, and leaves a lasting impression is the warmth and hospitality extended by EACH and EVERY member of the staff. I think it's a Kashmiri thing.

The rooms were well appointed and luxurious. Not the forgot the excellent central heating in the hotel was such a welcome relief to the -5 degrees outside. 

The food, be it at the restaurant or room service was probably the best I've had anywhere in a very long time. 

The best part...they don't serve alcohol, but permit you to get your own alcohol to the public cigar lounge and consume it. (Mixers have to be ordered though, very minimal cost) 

The Loccitane Spa, was the highlight of our stay. It really was the best spa we have ever been to, and was such a treat after a long day of skiing. 

Flip side, the heated pool wasn't operational and we weren't informed by the management. This was quite a disappointment, but everything else at the hotel made up for it.

reviews.author: VagabondOnTheMove
reviews.title: Overwhelmed!
reviews.text:
It's been three days since we left Gulmarg, but the holiday hangover/blues persist. Firstly, the place is beyond gorgeous. The thick blanket of soft, white snow makes it picture-postcard perfect. And there's no better hotel to experience it all from than the Khyber Resort & Spa.
Central heating itself (in a small town like Gulmarg) is a big luxury; and while the heating here is fab, it's no match for the warmth exuded by the people. We were completely overwhelmed by the hospitality and service. 
We loved the fact that we could take our own alcohol to the hookah and cigar bar. I don't know if that's just a function of the hotel not having its liquor licence yet, but nobody's complaining. The rooms were nice and toasty considering it was -7 outside. The view too was simply breathtaking. We had a small glitch with our bathroom drain but it was sorted out almost immediately.
The spa too was exceptional. The only bummer was that the indoor heated pool was under maintenance. Wish we had been informed before we got there, because we had actually carried our swimwear!
Although there's only one restaurant at the property, it's pretty damn good. And the bolognese definitely deserves a special mention.

To conclude, it was a fantastic holiday and there's absolutely NO doubt that we'll be going back next year, if not earlier.

reviews.author: Jay
reviews.title: Perfect Rooms | Incredible Views | Great Hotel Design
reviews.text:
This is truly and surprisingly a five star resort in Gulmarg. The resort is well designed with attention to details and touch of Kashmiri architectural styles. 
The rooms (including heating) are very comfortable and do not let the extreme climate affect your stay. They are fairly sized with lavish bathroom.
Food including buffet was quite good - four star. Staff service was excellent.
The heated pool is really heated and we saw people using it and having fun!
Next time we will go to Gulmarg only if we get rooms in Khyber! Cheers!

reviews.author: Raj B
reviews.title: Top Class
reviews.text: We stayed here in jan 2015. This is an amazing property very well located near gondola  in Gulmarg. The rooms are spacious and very well furnished. Premium rooms had balconies, which had beautiful views of the himalayan snow mountains. The interiors of rooms are very tastefully done, the bathrooms too are very spacious with bath tub and best fittings. and there is a changing room cum wardrobe too. The linen is top class, and the house keeping service again top class. The restaurant serves tasteful kashmiri, continental, chinese and italian cuisine. Their service is again top class. The breakfast too is pretty elaborate. The staff at the hotel is very courteous. All throughout our stay, all the staff would greet us on our way through the hotel with great respect. The hotel has a wonderful indoor heated swimming pool and an excellent well equipped gym. The spa too is run by L'occitane (I hope I get the spelling correct) which is one of the best spas in Europe. All the top corporates and who is who of the country come to stay in this wonderful resort. There are lots of other facilities in the resort which we did not explore. Overall its one of our life's best experiences of a holiday in this resort. Special thanks to Mr. Fahim & Mr. Sujith Herbert for giving us a very good deal and taking special care of us during our stay.

reviews.author: KunalSinha81
reviews.title: Luxury on paradise
reviews.text:
Excellent place and must visit...right from arrival to your departure you will feel at home and hospitality is at its best.staffs are very courteous and well trained and there is always smile on their faces.rooms are very spacious and luxurious equipped with all modern amenities.
Special thanks to Mr. Sujith ,who is the general manager for his excellent management.however a small area of improvement I can see is they can start drop in and pick up from the gondola point to their gate which is a very steep climb by foot and local hawkers will charge like anything for a 2 minutes drop.
Highly recommended by me and looking forward to come back soon.

reviews.author: Firas1973
reviews.title: Pleasant Surprise
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed at Khyber for a week early January of 2015, and it has been nothing short of spectacular. Right from the airport pick-up with the friendly driver Hamid, to Zaffar at check-In and across all the different departments at the hotel, we were greeted with warmth, great hospitality and exceptional service. The hotel is clean and modern, with a local retro feel to it. Our room was spacious, comfortable with all the modern amenities you would expect from a 5 star hotel, and we had a big balcony looking over the breathtaking white Himalayan mountains. Wow!

It is also worth mentioning that the people of Kashmir are an extremely welcoming people that are social and friendly. Gulmarg and the surrounding villages are no exception. 

Thank you Gulmarg.

reviews.author: VibhavAgrahari
reviews.title: Gulmarg, Kashmir, India
reviews.text: Beautiful property, best location, tempting food, nice & courteous staff. A bar-b-que dinner was organised for us which was simply superb. Spa by Loccatane was also very good. Our overall stay was good. Would love to go there again & again !!

reviews.author: Achal Manglik
reviews.title: The Khyber E Khas Effect 10on10
reviews.text: So it all started with one small mention by one of my friend. I stayed in this property with my group for 4 nights to do some filming of our show The Dewarist Mtv. This place has given us something special which cant de describe , it has some special vibe with breathtaking views which are unforgettable. Everything is smooth starting from airport pick up , lovely 2 hours drive to hotel and then the true heave , "You have arrived" . Best part is Mr Sujith Herbert's GM of this unique property will be there in lobby always to make sure you are having a great time. Just stop anytime and hot kawa will be there for you. F&B staff is the sweetest of all , just initiate your request , One tip , Find Aman and ask for khyber special ice cream. One of the best spa and swimming pool i have ever visited and everyone welcome you with smile that you forget that you away from home. Whole Property is centrally Heated one of its kind and give an advantage to be best in all seasons. Just go and spend some quality time with your loved ones. At the end a big thanks to Mr.Omar for creating this gem on earth and Mr.Faheem for the super deal. Thank you all !

reviews.author: kumsachu
reviews.title: Fantabulous
reviews.text:
What more can we have asked for a beautiful resort with mind blowing scenery all around taking care of each and every guest like their own family members.

RESORT AMBIANCE:
The Ambiance is perfect and beautiful. They have paid attention to even the smallest of the details. All wall decorations and antiques are sourced locally displaying Kashmiri's culture and history.

ROOMS : 
We stayed in Premier room. It was spacious and well designed. Nicely done corridors leading to the room and well planned bathroom and bed. The view out of the window is amazing. Centrally heated and attentive room service.

RESTAURANT :
Food was awesome. We tried both the buffet and ala carte bith were outstanding. In fact the local dishes like mutton roganjosh etc were mouth watering. Very tender meat. Some guests have written that menu was too small. But I think it is a fair enough menu given the remote location of the resort and the variety it offers I was pretty impressed. 

STAFF:
Reserved the best for the last :). Where ever you go, how well you enjoy your vacation depends on the people around you. We felt like we were at home when we stayed in Khyber. Right from the manager, waiters, secutriy every one was very friendly and welcoming. Infact  most of them shared there contacts with us and some of them even messaged and checked whether we reached Bangalore safely as our flight was cancelled at the last moment.
SUJIT
SHAKIB
AZAAD
AIJAZ  are just few names of a endless list.

When our flight was cancelled they helped us in booking an earlier flight and arranged the transport to airport with ease. 

Even during our reservation Imran and Quershi were very helpful in answering all of our queries with respect to the resort.

All of them are efficient in their work and also very friendly.

Truly a five star resort and worth all the money which you pay for.

reviews.author: GurgaonShaishav
reviews.title: The best resort in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Stayed at Khyber, in the first week of January 2015. The big attraction of Gulmarg - the Gandola, is very close to the resort.

Experience - very good, to start with. They welcome you with a hot Kahwa - which was very good. Checked in well, The pickup at the Srinagar hotel was also well organised (costs additional). Staff is well trained, ready to help you in which ever way they can. From giving advice, to giving contact numbers for shopping etc, they will also help you in every possible side. Room service was prompt, always delivered the tea / snacks in time. Spa - is a luxury. Steam room / Sauna / Jacoozi / Gym are well maintained. The restaurant (only one operational) had good cooked food. And the B/fast spread was also nice.
Some let downs though : The Bathrooms - will not give a five star resort look. Tiles (at least in our room - 2003) were not well set. Could see the strains, easily. The Shower point would leak, makign the external wooden area wet. To operate the shower, one had to go in and get some cold water, before you get the hot water experience. Somethign wrong with the shower.
There was no choice of the restaurants (although, as I said, the one restaurant did serve good food),
Some names, worth mentioning. Sujith H, GM, was very courteous to give us cash and add the same to our final bill. ATMs somehow are very difficult to find in Gulmarg. Atir in the F&B was always there to greet us in the restaurant and help us get everything fresh. Muzaffar in the hookah bar - his service / approach - should be appreciated.

reviews.author: amritadelhi
reviews.title: Khyber only if you a foreigner
reviews.text: We stayed in hotel Khyber resorts Gulmarg and during our stay we experienced that you are not treated equitant to what foreigners are. While we were in dinning there were 2 foreign groups, one from Europe and another far eastern, & all focus was on them and consequently our service was delayed and staff was not attentive to us. We want to remind the management that we probably paid as much as those foreign groups pay so why the discrimination. Be aware specially if you are going in winters when foreign groups come for skiing.

reviews.author: tinadelhi2014
reviews.title: Not good without snow
reviews.text: We booked Khyber Gulamrg based on tripadvisor reviews. The hotel is newly built but it is already showing signs of some wear and tear. The rooms are nicely done up but expensive, we almost paid 20k for a balcony room with 1 child. The food is very rich and heavy and in spite of requesting they added lods of cream and dry fruits. The service is ok but room service is slow. Basically Gulmarg is boring as there is hardly anything one can do without snow and paying so much without snow does not make sense.

reviews.author: Suren0005
reviews.title: Khyber Resort - Breathtaking !!!
reviews.text:
Hi Guys, I just returned from Gulmarg after staying 4 nights in Khyber, Gulmarg to celebrate my anniversary... We had planned to celebrate our day in a foreign location - but I'm so happy that we stayed in Khyber Gulmarg...
I travel the world and have stayed in some of the best resorts across the countries but Khyber is by far the best Mountain Resort......
Awesome property, well maintained, very courteous staff and breathtaking location....
I must also add here about the owner, Mr. Umar - I have yet to come across a courteous man who owns such a resort and still be so humble.....
If any of you wants to enjoy the best resort on the foot-hills of Himalaya's... look no where else  But - Khyber Resort, Gulmarg, Kashmir.....
I  want to thank you Mr.Umar and his entire staff for making our stay a life time experience and I and my wife have come back with so many beautiful memories.....
Cant wait to come back to Khyber !!!!

reviews.author: sandy42900
reviews.title: Excellent property...
reviews.text:
If you reach this hotel in flat 3 hrs from from Delhi , why would you go to Switzerland/ Austria etc, yet to see a property made with so much love and maintained so well, spa is lovely fantastic pool, lovely cigar lounge , I could go on and on but thing worth mentioning is the view from the balcony rooms ( mountain side) and the service  and attitude of all staff...
   No negative....

reviews.author: NBD06
reviews.title: In the snow lap of luxury
reviews.text:
A late night arrival into the gloom of the dark and the white of snow can be very intimidating. The Khyber Gulmarg instantly warmed us up to Kashmir with it's perfectly fermented cup of kahwa and an upgrade to it's luxury balcony rooms! 

The property is beautiful and the rooms luxurious but what really made us feel most pleased was the hospitality of the staff the bearers the guards and everyone else that belonged to the Khyber. 

Strongly recommend this space for a taste of luxury, snow and spa!

reviews.author: djlovestravel
reviews.title: Need train reservations staff better
reviews.text:
On the onset I must say that Khyber has been one of the places I have been desperately waiting to go to from the time it opened. Having found a 3 day window to do the same, I called the reservations no. that is mentioned on their website. A person called Masood spoke to me. I asked him for a 3 night package from the coming Monday onwards. He said its Rs 45,000. I asked if there has been any snow fall, he said not yet. So I asked (only once) if this is the best rate they can offer as its during weekdays & its not snowed yet (so skiing enthusiasts would be coming a bit later I presume) - his reply was a rudely stated line - "we are selling a property, not snow".
This was an extremely rude remark to hear from the representative of a SLH hotel. Asking for the best offer is a customers call; the hotel can provide the best rates they can. But in this process, basic decorum of speech & conduct should be maintained by the guest as well as the hotel's management. I would have even made a booking at the rate he had already quoted, had his reply been anything but what he said. You can just say that these are the best rates we have. 
And I must also state, that in properties like the Khyber - the natural surroundings is what people come for. You charge for the luxury & comfort you offer - which is fine - but I can get that in Wildflower Hall, Ananda or numerous other luxury hotels around India. I am not saying that your rate should be lower if it hasn't snowed - but the people selling it should remember that the guest who is coming is there as much for the nature as for the hotel. So in that regard - yes, you are selling the snow, the meadows, the fresh air - all of it! To my mind, this made his statement even more inappropriate.
I urge you to look into this as a management & training issue - please train him better is all I have to say. Don't reprimand his on basis of this, make him do better.
However, for right now - I will just stick to the Wildflower Hall or Ananda.

reviews.author: Atul44
reviews.title: One of the best
reviews.text:
First thing first- The terrible flood has no effect on Khyber or Gulmarg. I traveled last week of November 2014. Took a taxi from Srinagar airport to Khyber with absolutely no trouble. Smooth ride. 
Khyber is definitely one of the best stays I have experienced not just because of its location but it's sheer class and comfort provided by a wonderful efficient management. Very welcoming staff, they know how to make you feel home. Preet welcomed us and made our check in process fast and smooth even though cleartrip had not completed their formalities from their side. Preet just mentioned it and asked me to contact cleartrip once and it will be taken care, which was. Since there was not many guests, Khyber upgraded me to a luxury room. How amazing that was. The room was cozy and spacious with no major issues with a beautiful view. I have many great things to say about Khyber but I see those have already been mentioned in previous reviews. 
Things which you may not like about Khyber might be non-availaibility of free Wi-Fi even after paying lots of money for room rent.  The hotel restaurants are expensive and there is not much around apart from small eating joints. I wish Khyber had given me cheaper option for airport pickup and drop. Rs. 5k per side is quite expensive. Addition of Kashmiri food in breakfast buffet would have been nice. 

I would definitely love to visit Khyber again in future. Thanks for making my stay a memorable one.

reviews.author: Suman G
reviews.title: Hyped
reviews.text: wonderful sprawling property. rooms were a little smelly. Food wasn't all that good. Spa was good. swimming pool wasn't functional. Room Service is extremely slow. Staff is courteous and warm. But by far the best property in Gulmarg so far

reviews.author: kabiir k
reviews.title: Fabulous Experience
reviews.text:
1. Khyber is a beautiful property and very well maintained.
2. Very courteous staff. very Helpful. 
3. Good food. Good variety
4. Lot of recreational facilities available.

Thanks Rachna, Zafar and Manuj.

reviews.author: anil d
reviews.title: beautiful hotel with best view in gulmarg
reviews.text: we all (6 couples) stayed in this beautiful property for two nts 18th ,19th aug2014.In few words i would rate it as one of the best hotels in kashmir.Management staff is v curtious  n helpful. mr manujFront manager) and kamal rawat(f and b manager)were exceptionaly nice and helpful.Altogether ,we all had such a memorable and comfortable stay in gulmarg.

reviews.author: cpsahni
reviews.title: Khyber Gulmarg
reviews.text: Best and Beautiful property in Gulmarg.  It's value for money. Spacious modern rooms with Balconies overlooking the pine trees and snow clapped mountains. Food and Service was excellent. The Managers and General Manager we're always there at the lobby for any assistance.  We would love to come back to Khyber soon.

reviews.author: parag s
reviews.title: Good, luxurious stay!
reviews.text:
Stayed at the Khyber on 14th August with my wife. 

Beautifully done up hotel. It is just 2 years old but has already gathered enough kudos for itself including empanelment with the Small Luxury Hotels (slh.com).

On arrival, we were given a complementary kashmiri kehwa which was the best kehwa we had during the trip. 

The rooms were very well done up in standard 5-star way with a great view of the mountain peaks. The hotel has quite a few facilities for families - a heated swimming pool, a gymnasium and a kids play area called the igloo. No wonder that most of the other occupants of the hotel were families with kids. 

The hotel is very close (5 mins walking distance although it is a steep slope) to the gulmarg gondola starting point which is the chief tourist attraction in gulmarg. 

We felt that the food was extremely expensive. They have a buffet dinner priced at INR 1600 which we thought was a lot. 

Nonetheless, its a great property and ideal if one was looking to simply relax for a couple of days.

reviews.author: anishkila
reviews.title: The Crown of Gulmarg!
reviews.text:
If you've been to Gulmarg, you'd know there isnt much to do other than the Gondola ride, which I would suggest continue to Level 2, else dont do it. Also level 2 isnt what they advertise it to be, there is a patch of snow for your cool 'FB' pics, and a rocky trek of 20 min to satisfy that pseudo adventure holidaying spirit in you.

Coming back to the point, Khyber then to me is the next best thing, not just because no other property comes close to the grandeur but because it is such a vast upgrade over the rest that when you see the difference in the rack rates, you also know the reason why!

Beautifully built over the hill top, its got one hell of a steep entrance, so walking it is quite a pain, the ongoing dispute between the donkey guys and taxi guys means, you need to fork out a fat bunch everytime you wish not to slug it on your feet.

We personally didnt have the best of rooms and it took a while for them to figure out which ones were undergoing maintenance and which werent, but then there is no looking back ( other than the fact the neighbouring maintenance went on till 11 and was a little disturbing nonetheless).

I would always choose the valley view over the mountain view, cuz i dont care much for the barbed fences on the mountain side, the view however is still really beautiful on both sides.

For food, there are limited options, but quite good. The spa had tied up with L'occitane, so company loyalists would happily fork out the money.

The biggest blemish! they dont have a liquor license, so no drinks. Also few of the added features like quad-bikes, guided treks, private cinema etc are all unreasonably expensive.

Wouldnt dream of staying elsewhere if ever in Gulmarg again, although not much to revisit.

reviews.author: RajaKalra
reviews.title: Too notch Service and Rooms!!!
reviews.text:
As soon as we arrived at the main door the view and hotel were good,but as we entered the hotel and saw there hospitality right from the relaxed check in process with endless cup of their traditional KAWA to showing us the entire property which is huge!!! It was top notch.
Mr. Zafar really deserves a very special thanks from our side as he made our honeymoon trip so memorable that we remember him till now whenever we remember about the trip to Khyber he was very generous to arrange a room decoration and a cake which we cut outside with the snowfall and he was with us courteous enough to capture that moment. From the time we entered I just loved this hotel and the staff was very courteous and hospitable.I really enjoyed my stay!!! As I am hotelier my self. I will visit this hotel again.

reviews.author: AmanDayal
reviews.title: Good Property, Poor Managment
reviews.text:
The property is nice but suffers in service and extremely poor management. The staff and management lack the drive to make your stay comfortable. For the room tariff, the experience is a couple of notches lower. The stay is as good as a budget hotel, but for the location and infrastructure. The property has central heating only in rooms and becomes stuffy and suffocating to dwell in the summer months.

The reception staff is no better than of a travel lodge and the senior management is pretty impotent in getting anything done or at the least have decency to respond to a resident guest for any discomfort. Any requests/complaints go down a rabbit hole.

The Restaurant staff is amateur too. They are disorganized and all over the place. The buffet will cost a good $25-$30 (Rs. 1600) but the food selection is worth $2 (Rs. 100-120). If only anyone cared to review any suggestions/feedback.

The Chaikaksh (Coffee shop) is a decent place to hang around for a cup of tea/coffee and enjoy the Himalayan view. The server/manager there may be the cordial staff at the Khyber Gulmarg property.

This property enjoys the monopoly advantage in Gulmarg, since there are no other hotels in vicinity that offer so many amenities. But it is a real disappointment if you are looking for luxury and fun. The staff and service is just too unpleasant an experience. A real let down by the renowned Khyber Group.

Go stay there since you don't really have a choice of place in Gulmarg but the experience is no better than that of a clean Budget Hotel.

reviews.author: KHManager1
reviews.title: The best property in Kashmir
reviews.text: We stayed in No. 1 hotels during our Kashmir trip. Khyber in Gulmarg, Pahalgam Hotel in Pahalgam and Taj Vivanta in Srinagar. Khyber was undoubtedly the best among these best. The Balcony view rooms were very large, tastefully decorated and lavish in utilities. Very good housekeeping and so was room service. The food was also amazing complimenting the service. The location of this hotel is within walking distance to the gondola, from where you go to snow clad mountains; particularly important point as you are not allowed to use your vehicles inside the Gulmarg and you cannot walk much because of ups and downs in road. The only bad experience I had was that while checking out my luggage was not tagged and it was loaded in a Tempo Traveler belonging to others guest and the management had no clue about it. Thanks to my car driver who knew the driver of that Tempo and he phoned him and then we could get our luggage after chasing him for 20 kms. The worst part was that the management did not even bother to apologize. Had this been not happened I would have rated them seven stars.

reviews.author: aditya_mehta85
reviews.title: A must visit place!!
reviews.text: Me and my wife were always fascinated by the thought of visiting Srinagar also Kashmir on a whole!! Finally we made it happen last month that is June. Our choice to stay in Kashmir was by default Srinagar. So we narrowed on Vivanta by Taj, Srinagar. Was real hot n kinda humid in srinagar. Moreover there wasn't much scenic beauty to appreciate sitting in middle of Dal Lake. We decided to hire a cab and spend a day in Gulmarg. And this proved to b the wisest decision of ours on this trip. Such a mesmerizing beauty this place is! Our driver suggested us of having a meal at Khyber Resort. He was all praises of this place. And we went by his suggestion.This resort is so beautifully placed/located all surrounded by gorgeous peaks. Wonder how they would look covered with snow. It was really warm n cozy in the resort. Were greeted with a warm welcome as well. Though we were not staying with them but even then the warmth they showed in welcoming us was overwhelming. We chose the all day dining CLOVES for a lunch. Again the same welcome it was. The staff was real competitive to guide us through the menu. The menu was a complete guide to local flavors as well as International ones for any international traveler. We were lucky to have their manager Kamal Rawat on the floor that time. And this guy made us regret our stay at Vivanta Taj by his Courtesy and stylish service. He almost read our mind as to what we are looking for in terms of local flavors! And he was Bang on.. The food was equally amazing, far far better than we had whatever and wherever in Srinagar. Thank you so much for such a pleasant afternoon at Khyber. Looking forward to stay with you guys next time with all the snow around!

reviews.author: Sumit S
reviews.title: Awfully poor service, rude staff........
reviews.text: All is well until it starts speaking, I mean materialistic things are all too good......but human angle is simply missing. Poor manners, some sort of high headedness amongst the staff. The cashier had the audacity to fight for Rs 4.00 on a five figure bill........sad I stayed at such a hotel.

reviews.author: Hankuna_Matata
reviews.title: Oasis in Heaven
reviews.text:
Just a few things you should know before we talk about the hotel. Gulmarg is an incredibly beautiful place especially in the months of Dec-Feb given fresh powder snow, cleanliness, not very crowded, and incredible natural beauty. We would definitely recommend this period. 
it is also the best time to enjoy Khyber - a rare high end and full service option available in the hilly regions in India.

Khyber was less than a 2 hour drive away from Srinagar airport. The roads were good and coupled with the beautiful surroundings - we had a good start to our journey.
The hotel greets you with a hot cup of traditional Kashmiri Kahwa which is a must have. I would rank the hotel ambiance in line with the top premium 5 stars in India.

The hotel is indeed located in the middle of a field which was covered by heavy snow and the beauty was amplified with several pine trees. For once the hotel looked much more spectacular than even the pictures on the website both from outside and inside.
