The rooms are tastefully decorated and provide equally outstanding views with no stones unturned for the good experience.

The hotel has centralized temperature control and all rooms are fitted with modern amenities. You can go outside, play in the snow for however long you want and the warm hotel awaits you the moment you start freezing. They have lots of designated areas to enjoy the snow, for outside views etc. in case you just with to relax in the hotel.
Just one complaint, walls are thin. We unfortunately shared a wall with a noisy group in the other room which was not very helpful in the night.

The Gondola is walking distance away from the hotel which gives easy access to the higher points in case you want to ski. We did not try the spa, but spa, heated swimming pool, jaccuzi etc were available.

The hospitality is at par with the Oberoi service which I rate at the highest level in this country. We had a small accident while skiing and the hotel staff took great care of us during the rest of our stay. 

The food quality was good, but the options are a but limited. The hotel has a buffet and a multicuisine ala carte menu. However, you can run out of options during a longer stay. The hotel staff can however help with some off the menu options as well in case you are craving for something else. The hotel has only one restaurant (all day) and one cafe. the restaurant options to me was a limitation. Alcohol is not served in the hotel.

The only other shortcoming was our departure from the hotel. The hotel had run out of cars and hence had provided us with a local taxi. We had paid double the money for a hotel car which could directly take us to the airport, instead we had to travel in local ones and change car in between (one for snow and one for road).

Overall, we were well taken care of, and without exaggerating, I can safely say that this was a superior experience than some of our other trips to Europe and New Zealand, both in terms of scenic beauty and hospitality (that too at a fraction of the cost).

reviews.author: loveindia46
reviews.title: Stunning Hotel
reviews.text:
This hotel came to our assistance following checking into another one nearby only to experience one of the worst hotels ever. Within one hour of arriving in Gulmarg we had checked into and out of our original disastrous choice from the travel agent and into a luxurious room at The Khyber Resort. Goodness me this is a beautiful hotel, the best one (easily the most expensive one) we stayed at during our week in Kashmir.  The young man at reception was extremely helpful on arrival, thank you Zaffir Malik, you were very kind.
The room was beautifully detailed, finished and appointed, the bathroom was exceptional too.  Our dining experience here was also 1st class, dinner and breakfast were both delightful.
Our only reservation about the whole experience, without the wish to sound snobbish was the dress code and behaviour during dinner. I don't really expect children running around the dining room and track suits in a five star restaurant!  That does sound snobbish doesn't it, it doesn't mean to. I just think there should be a dress code of some sorts at the evening service and also some control from the dining area manager over groups of children.
Having said that, if you go to Gulmarg stay at this Hotel, it was wonderful.  Thank you Khyber Resort.

reviews.author: Mav1109
reviews.title: Maybe the Best Resort in the world,,, with very average service
reviews.text:
We stayed at khyber in Dec 2013 for three nights... the location, rooms etc are fascinating but when it comes to customer service( don't think that they understand it).. in the three days they managed to confuse our pick up, managed to loose our confirmed booking, charged for Xmas eve dinner( which was already paid for),,,, and above all, there is no resolution ,, it seems that the reservations guy holds all the decisions but he is never found in the hotel..... 

But cant help but praise the place ,, location and hotel is AWESOME... just go there for the place.....

reviews.author: monica j
reviews.title: Luxury without deliverance!
reviews.text:
I came back last month from an enthralling & rejuvenating holiday with my husband, in Kashmir. It was on our list for quite sometime, so we booked everything including accommodation, transport, tickets & some sightseeing, in advance. Though it was just the beginning of the tourist season, we were witness to traffic jams, queues, stampedes & cacophony all around us! God save those who plan on visiting in the high tourist season(may to july)! 

Lets talk about the great Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa, Gulmarg, which claims itself to be the only 5 star property in the whole of Jammu & Kashmir state! 

Nestled in the Himalayan mountain ranges with striking views of the Affarwat Peaks in Gulmarg, India, it is no doubt a luxury property. It lies 65 kilometres away from Srinagar Airport ( 3 hour drive ) on top of a hill with views to die for(specially in winters)! The resort has eighty rooms, four luxury cottages and a Presidential Suite each with breath-taking views of the Affarwat Peaks and of the valley. Out of the 3 categories of rooms, the premier, premier mountain view & the luxury balcony rooms, we stayed in the luxury room with a grand balcony. There are several dining options like their restaurant called Cloves with splendid views, Nouf a covered deck to enjoy cosy meals besieged by breath-taking sights of the snow covered mountains, Chaikash a tea lounge with myriad flavours of teas to choose from & Calabash the cigar & Sheesha lounge. The Khyber Spa by L’Occitane is one of India’s most luxurious and holistic well-being spas, again with magnificent view. One cannot spend a dull moment in this imposing environment as a whole lot of recreational activities awaits you such as a fully dedicated area for children called the Igloo, a stupendous heated indoor swimming pool, gymnasium, game area for adults so on so forth. But for me everything ceases to importance if one fails to deliver!

They might have been recognised for their outstanding service delivery by the World Luxury Hotels, but I doubt it was the opinion of the guest or the staff itself! On this wise, in all humility & complete fairness, I express my analysis of the Khyber Himalayan Resort as follows: 

1. There were security screening machines installed at the entrance without people to operate them. My husband & I were not greeted upon arrival nor was there an inspection for security of persons, only for the baggage. I saw used overcoats just lying on the ground at the entry steps without being taken care off or noticed! I asked one of the guards if mine will be treated similarly! When we entered the resort, we were asked to identify the luggage, which my husband did. Then while we were waiting for the room, another person came & asked to identify the luggage, so I went & did so. It was the height of patience when another of the staff asked us a third time to identify the baggage! It shows the lack of communication among the staff! They seriously need training!!

2. The check-in time was 2:00 pm but we arrived an hour prior. Understanding the scenario we calmly waited, had buffet lunch & approached at the reception after an hour. While I was clicking pictures of the entrance I noticed that they are a part of the SLH group so I asked the reservations guy to upgrade my room. This took another 45-50mins & we were escorted by Ms.Shivangi to our room. This waiting for 2 hours killed us & wasted more than half of our day! Nevertheless, we checked in our luxurious room with a balcony & found it super comfortable & welcoming with respect to the freezing cold outside!

3. We took wi-fi for 24 hrs by paying INR.750, which we later realised didn't work for most of the time. Also, the sliding door between the dressing area & bathroom was completely broken! 

4. When we went to the restaurant to eat lunch where I met a family from Mumbai who were guests there as well. We immediately struck a conversation & they told me about the menu being repeated everyday. Like the manchow soup was served a day before & was repeated the day after. There was less choice for vegetarians for the outrageous price. Also, I did not find the food to the standard of a luxury class hotel. I went & informed this to Mr.Manzoor, who was at the front office & asked to be spoken to someone responsible. He said he will send someone to speak to me regarding the same, but in vain. I asked twice, but no one bothered to attend to me. In my opinion, he is seriously in need of proper training from a branded corporate organisation. This is absolutely not expected of this kind of a property. If it was Taj or Oberoi....immediate action would have been taken with the staff personally taking responsibility. 

5. I usually work on my machine in the night where I require to use the internet. I tried to connect several times but it was futile. Hence I called the reception, who transferred me to the IT department. After explaining the problem, he informed me that he cannot help me as everything seems to be alright at his end! I wonder why they charge for something they cannot deliver!

6. In the morning we looked forward to the breakfast, only to experience a bolt from the blue! It was pathetic! I ordered a masala dosa( a south Indian pancake made from rice batter), which was not even close to be called a dosa....very chewy with bland chutney! Then I tried my hands on parantha( an Indian shallow fried bread), it was hard as a rock! The food was cold, tasteless & disgusting! I again called the staff to make them aware of the situation....but no one was suited to handle the situation. 

7. We wanted to enjoy a swim in the inviting pool but as we didn't carry our costumes we couldn't. But I observed a couple of children & adults swimming in the pool without costumes. I asked for explanation but they just cleared the air saying we cannot do anything, as they do not listen to us! That was very convincing!!!

8. I am a traveller & a photographer who want to bring back places, people, destinations, cultures & a profusion of elements to the less travelled, confined at home. So I approached Mr.Manzoor again to let me have a person escort me, show around the property & photograph it. Apparently that didn't happen either. 

9. A warning for those taking for granted that this property being a 5 star luxurious one would serve alcohol....let me speak loud & clear, " this property does not have a bar or a liquor license ", so be prepared! 

10. Another letdown which came as shock to us later was the situation of transportation once we reached the hotel in Gulmarg. We were not informed of the fact that one cannot move in & around Gulmarg in an vehicle which is registered outside of Gulmarg. Even the hotel people cannot let their vehicle for travel within Gulmarg. So we either need to walk, take an ATV(all terrain vehicle, super expensive!) or hire a local car. 

11. This, what I am about to tell is rather unusual. Everytime a member of the staff went pass us in the hotel grounds, they acknowledged the presence of my husband only greeting him, hello sir, good morning sir...blah, blah & NOT ME! I don't understand why? I have noticed this for the first time in my life! 

Overall, it is a great option to stay in Gulmarg during winters for the location, view, snow, heating & indoor recreational activities, ONLY IF THEY IMPROVE UPON THEIR SERVICE, COMPETENCY, ATTITUDE & STAFF!

reviews.author: Priyavrat Jhunjhunwala
reviews.title: Great Luxury Hotel
reviews.text:
The location of this hotel is great, since its just a 10 mins walk to the gondola that takes you up to phase 1 and phase 2. Walking down to the gondola is easy, but keep in mind, the walk back to the hotel is a steep up hill climb. The rooms themselves were large and spacious. The views of the mountain are spectacular. We visited when there was still plenty of snow around, as a result of which, the views were great. In terms of luxury it is definitely one of the best properties I have stayed at in india.
The food at the hotel is good, however, it is a bit on the expensive side (typical 5 star rates).
I used the spa for a foot massage. The spa attendants were well versed with the techniques and I found it very relaxing.
We were there for two nights and enjoyed every bit of it.
DO NOTE: To get your car up to the resort, you need  a printed confirmation from the hotel. The hotel may deny it, but the security at the main entrance to the gulmarg area will not allow you to get your car/taxi inside if you do not have this confirmation.

reviews.author: Sathyam R
reviews.title: Oasis in snow
reviews.text:
Khyber with its green roofs and timber walls contrasts well against the backdrop of white snow.
The rooms are spacious with touches of local linen and woodwork. The views from some of the rooms are breath taking. Most guests stay here for couple of nights during summer using it as easy access to the gondola ride, apart from that there is little to do here. There are no restaurants within walking distance so you dine in most of the time. The food is Ok but special mention must be made of Samir and Muzafir at the Cloves restaurant who went beyond the norm in taking care of us

reviews.author: 160EXPERIENCE
reviews.title: Our stay at Kyber last month
reviews.text:
Dear General Manager,

Would like to share our good experience at your Khyber hotel Gulmarg booking dates 24/04/2014 2 nights the booking name was Mr. & Mrs Parikh.
Please note:
1.	It is the best property in Kashmir
2.	Few staff where the breakfast was served were very good.
3.	Your staff at the main counter while checking in and checking out Mr. Zaffar Malik was extremely courteous, helpful, gave correct guidance for everything around, explained about the hotel property and always had a smile on the face which is what customers look at when you enter a property like yours or anywhere else. What a customer needs is a good care at the hotel and attend them with their questions / queries which Mr. Zaffar Malik did all in the best way he could! If your hotel has such staff then definitely customers like us will flow in without fail!

It would be really nice of your organization if such staff is appreciated and promoted for their best work!      

Thanking you and look forward to staying at your hotel next!

reviews.author: Jeevan G
reviews.title: bliss at 8000 ft
reviews.text: I was very much excited about the stay in khyber since i thought of gulmarg trip and the hotel was more than everything i expected.Right from check in the staff were very great. The room is spacious and the view from my room was breath taking. The food is just awesome the restaurant staff were very good and helpful especially Muzzafar in cloves resaturant was very friendly overall iam looking forward for my next trip there

reviews.author: Chaitanya A
reviews.title: Highlight of Kashmir with breathtaking views and decor
reviews.text:
The Khyber is a beautiful landscaped property, with a prime location. The Gondola ride is very nearby from the hotel.

We were particularly impressed by the decor of the hotel which is done in a traditional Kashmiri style. We enjoyed great views from our room as well as from the lobby. The lobby was well done up. Our rooms also were extremely well done up.
This is a must visit in Gulmarg. Would recommend to visit the hotel and have a meal even if you are not staying the night.

However there were few issues where the management must rectify things-
We found overall professionalism lacking. The service overall was average.
The jacuzzi for the women was not working. The pool was not heated and the staff had no clue how to increase the temperature.
We also found maintenance lacking with high amounts of seepage on the walls and non-functional lifts! We hope that Khyber is able to rectify these problems or else, this property might soon deteriorate.

reviews.author: Keya1976
reviews.title: Paradise  on Earth
reviews.text: Gulmarg itself is the paradise on Earth,and Khyber is the paradise's garden from where you can enjoy the beauty of paradise.The helpful nature of the staffs,the cleanliness of the hotel is the additional fragrance of the garden.My right hand got fractured by slipping on the snow and its a common phenomena in any such places but the prompt fast aided by the house physician of the hotel is something which I will remember for ever.The house physician was too sincere that he made it a point to check my hand every 12hrs .I stayed at number of 05star hotels in different places of World but the warmth of careness I received from this hotel is unmatchable  .I hope they maintain this standard of them .

reviews.author: Viineet K
reviews.title: Fantastic Hotel with breath taking views
reviews.text:
Nice and spacious rooms with breath taking view from the room, as soon as you open your eyes in the morning you see lots n lots of snow in winters and lush green gardens in summers and rainy seasons.. In winters if you are lucky enough to be there to witness the snowfall, it's a total bliss!! 

For Skiers GULMARG, Kashmir is paradise and specially for Americans, Europeans, Japanese, Australians and other first world countrymen it is not only a fantastic experience but ''dirt cheap''. Khyber is just next to the Gondola point from where you can go on the top of the snow peaks and for Skiers a 'IDEAL LOCATION'!!

Food is not that great, but good, I would rate it as 6 out of 10.. Service is quite good and the Staff is very friendly & caring..!! Though, the property is just a year old and hope they can maintain the standards for years to come..!! 

All the best to The Khyber team!!

reviews.author: armeetsingh
reviews.title: Amazing hotel with excellent service
reviews.text:
We arrived at the khyber at a time when the entire state of J&K was severely impacted by heavy snowfall. However there is was no let down in the services of the hotel, the staff, the food, every thing was upto the mark. 

The staff of the hotel really goes the extra mile interms of giving you the best of services, i would specially like to thank "Shivangi" for making our stay so memorable.

reviews.author: Vaibhav K
reviews.title: The Best
reviews.text:
As we booked this hotel based the reviews posted here, we had many expectations and its very true that it stands to THE BEST. We were more than delighted when we were received at hotel.
The overall treatment with welcome was very personalized. The food was the best.
The view from our room was most beautiful and tranquil. It's the most luxurious. Enjoyed the snowfall. As we say " Kashmir is paradise on the Earth", this hotel provides the best way to enjoy this PARADISE. We take this opportunity to thanks the management of this hotel for providing such a best, comfortable property to us, the travelers. We will definitely visit again.

reviews.author: Nilesh...
reviews.title: A lifetime experience
reviews.text:
I went there to celebrate the honeymoon. Got a lovely surprise by Hotel management, they upgraded my Rooms to Presidential Suit. 
What a response and service.... Enjoyed the snowfall, stay, service and off course the lovely weather/environment...

reviews.author: Ajay_b04
reviews.title: Awesome property!!!
reviews.text:
This is the best stay i ever had!!! Location is fantastic and hospitality is beyond expectations. 

They even have Gym, temperature controlled swimming pool (for Adults as well as kids), Jacuzzi, Sauna, Steam bath ...... and these all services are inclusive in your room tariff....

reviews.author: venilal
reviews.title: A beautiful property in hands of a horrible management
reviews.text:
This is a beautiful property but is in the hands of horrible management. 
To start with the front desk staff bis the most Un cooperative and irresponsible. 
In spite of the written confirmation voucher for balcony room we were forced to take the premium room. On firm demand they gave us the balcony rooms. 
Out of 6 members that checked in only 3 guests photo ids were taken.
On the second day when we were to change the room to balcony room, all our contents were moved to other room without our consent. In the process our valuables which were lying in the room safe were left as is and the room was given to new guest.
Hight of it was that when we came back to hotel the front desk guy made a key and told us to go and collect it from the room saying HIS SYSTEM SHOWS THE ROOM IS STILL UNOCCUPIED.  
When I opened the door a couple was in the room!!!!!!
The only restaurant can accommodate only 75 guests where as the hotel has about 90 rooms so capacity of about 180 guests. It is a big chaos at breakfast and dinner. 
Like a road side eatery you have wait on top of the just finishing guest to get a table.  Need less to say the staff just can't manage the rush at all. You ask for something nothing comes.  
The temperature controlled pool has some pump issue and the water is almost cold!!!
The jacuzzi for men 3 out 6 seats the jets don't work.
The jacuzzi for women is manned by man no female staff and the  water is cold.
I wish this beautiful property comes in some experienced hospitality group who understands in guest relation.

reviews.author: Ankit16tour
reviews.title: Awesome stay @ Gulmerg
reviews.text: We stayed in March. An enjoyable stay ,Nice spa, good food,good location .overall a nice resort to stay in Gulmerg and a friendly staff . Vegetarian food option is less it's not a complaint but they should have more options for vegetarian .overall a Awesome place and hotel for holidays

reviews.author: Dino1512
reviews.title: "Gulmarg - Heaven on Earth"
reviews.text:
This was our second trip to Gulmarg. We had been to Gulmarg during summer in June. It was lush green with only the mountain peaks covered in snow. Coming to Gulmarg in March was a completely a different experience. My wife being a travel agent, i knew she would do a thorough research on the places to stay. We eventually chose Khyber as we heard a lot of good reviews about the hotel and its courteous staff. 

It took us some time to reach the hotel as our car had trouble wading through the thick snow on the road, however once we entered the hotel it was just fabulous. The property is the best among the options available. What really stands out is the staff, they don't leave any opportunity to make your stay comfortable. Mr. Aditya Mata and his entire team made our stay memorable. So a big thank you to the entire team at Khyber.

While the location and courteous staff makes it a splendid property to stay, here are few pointers to note:-
1. The property is very close to the Gondola ride. Which is a big advantage
2. It is also very close to the Ski grounds. If you choose some good guides like we had, your experience will be truly awesome
3. Khyber food although not fancy is simple but very good. They have a decent spread of Kashmiri Wazwan for the 3 nights when we were there. However we felt they could do with some lavish spread considering the cost of the stay. Options for Veggies can be little limited.
4. The property does not sell alcohol, but they serve you if you make your own arrangements. Can be little turn off especially in that weather.
5. The bed is hard and the pillows were not comfortable for me, while my wife had no issues. 
6. The view from the rooms are mind blowing. every photo was a post card.
7. The heated pool and the works - steam, sauna & spa is a big plus. 

Overall we had an excellent stay at Khyber and we left Gulmarg with a very heavy heart, only to promise ourselves to come back to "Heaven on earth" some time soon!! Cheers

reviews.author: rashmipradeep
reviews.title: The Khyber was everything one could dream of-simply fantastic
reviews.text:
The views from the room with the balcony are simply breathtaking.It was a fairy tale picture post card..
The aesthetics of the room were local with beautifully embroidered Kashmiri linen and furniture. The staff at the hotel make Khyber extra special.The GM Mr Aditya Mata-was there looking after each guest personally to see how he could make each guest more comfortable .A special note for the banquets ..Mr Roshan was worth applauding! he took such special care.  Mr Abid another great asset! who helped us tremendously.The Khyber hotel- is the best you can get in Gulmarg. The "kehwa "at the hotel too was fabulous.Pls try some for sure

reviews.author: Jo D
reviews.title: Beautiful Property
reviews.text:
The Khyber truly is one of those hotels where you would wan to stay indoors. The interiors are beautifully done in an exotic blend of Kashmiri and Moroccan art, which make the place even more cozy and inviting. 
The Lobby offers you an amazing view of the valley with its snow covered peaks. We were lucky to be welcomed by snowfall. The experience was beautiful. 
A special mention to the staff who are courteous and go out of their way to make you comfortable. Kudos guys. 
While there were some problems on our first day - our rooms sadly was on the back side and didn't have not much of a view, plumbing problems and temperature control. However I must add that the management was kind enough to change our room the next day, and one with a view :) 
All in all, if you are looking for a quiet time away from the bustle of the crowds, this is a place you need to visit. The Kashmiri cuisine too is sumptuous. You must try the Dum Biryani.

reviews.author: Abhishek B
reviews.title: heaven on earth
reviews.text:
Gorgeous!!! only way to describe the location and hotel. The views from the room are breathtaking. The hotel is beautiful with a great indoor heated pool. Gulmarg in winters is simply amazing and there is no better place than the Khyber to stay and enjoy the beauty.
The buffet spread for dinner could do with a little improvement.

reviews.author: RomalSuri
reviews.title: Mesmerising Experience at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Words fall short to describe our 3 nights stay at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa ,Gulmarg .. The whole experience was truly a memorable one and the memories shall be cherished forever !

The moment you step into the hotel ,you feel like you've stepped back in time when living life meant enjoying a cocktail and the lively art of conversation. This hotel has the most friendly staff  and were extremely prompt & courteous.Its truly a luxury experience and a must visit for every avid traveller ..True, the rooms are "extremely cozy & comfy " and each room opens to a breathtaking view .I'm yet to see a more picturesque place in India ..Had a lovely experience at their spa by l'occitane and their other facilities like the gym & swimming pool were top class ..  Don't miss out staying at the Khyber  if you want to truly enhance your Kashmir experience. 

I have been promoting this property to all my near & dear ones , needless to say ,that  speaks volumes about the place ..

"I cannot rave enough & would definitely return again"

Romal Suri 
CEO A.R PLACEMENTS

reviews.author: amitlodha23
reviews.title: Amazing property in snowy peaks of Gulmarg
reviews.text: Khyber is a property which signifies quality in the hills of Kashmir. The property signifies luxury and sophistication in all respects. The rooms are large and are luxurious, we stayed in luxury room with balcony. Food was just ok and could be better. In all I would say though over priced hotel signifies luxury and comfort

reviews.author: Sue
reviews.title: Wonderful place to relax :-)
reviews.text: The Khyber is one of the more expensive hotels in Gulmarg but is worth every penny. The rooms are spacious and the showers are always wonderfully hot:-) The hotel staff are attentive, polite and always willing to help. There is a range of food to cater for different tastes at the delicious evening buffet (which was included as part of our package) as well as a range of Indian and European style dishes for the breakfast buffet.The swimming pool and sauna are great for a visit after a days skiing. We really enjoyed our stay and are already planning a return visit next year:-)

reviews.author: Vinit M
reviews.title: The Signature Of Indian Hospitality With Mesmerising View
reviews.text: Always Dreamed Of Seeing Snowflakes Falling From The Sky....And That Historic Moment Happened During My Stay At The Khyber ..The Best Hospitality With Respect To Food , Service , Spa & Pool Maintenance & Guest Relations ... Apart Of The Spa , Jacuzzi & Indoor Heated Pool  The Things Not To Be Missed In The Property Is The Kashmiri Kheer , Kahwa , Sheesha & The Pastry Shopè...

reviews.author: heb999
reviews.title: Excellent hotel with superb service.
reviews.text:
We recently spent seven nights at the 'Khyber' as we were visiting Gulmarg for a heli-skiing holiday.
The hotel is new, spacious and luxurious. It is situated just a short walk to the gondola and is surrounded with beautiful views of the Himalayas.  The shuttle service to the gondola was efficient and very much appreciated at the end of the day as it is a steep climb back uphill carrying ski equipment.
Our room was well appointed, cosy and very clean. The bathroom has a good walk-in shower and a bathtub which was wonderful for relieving sore muscles after skiing. The room is also provided with a good-sized fridge and a tv with channels from all over the world. It was serviced twice a day and on some days fruit and cookies were left for us. The only observation is that the room did not have much storage space for clothes.
We only ate at the Cloves restaurant which was excellent. We are not normally a fan of buffets but the food was so good that we made an exception. There was always something freshly cooked on offer besides the comprehensive a la carte menu. Breakfasts were also good with plenty of both Indian and Continental offerings. What was particularly impressive was the service, something the hotel should be very proud of.
Unfortunately, we did not have time to try the spa but we did take a quick look at the swimming pool which was very large and inviting.
We would like to thank the Managers for their warm and friendly service. They were always on hand and very approachable and nothing was too much trouble for them or any other staff member.
The only area of the hotel that needs a little attention is the ski room in the basement. The boot rack was sometimes used as a coat rack, skis were all over the floor and there was no way of securing skis. My skis were taken by someone else one morning (by mistake most probably) but it caused me considerable inconvenience. Other ski hotels have lockers or secure storage.
We would certainly recommend the Khyber and return next time we visit Gulmarg. We would also recommend taking advantage of the heli-skiing opportunities available in the area.

reviews.author: Vikrant Singh
reviews.title: Gar Firdaus Bar Rue Zamin Ast, Hami Asto, Hami Asto, Hami Asto.
reviews.text:
It was my first trip to Kashmir and I do not have words to justify this wonderful experience. We stayed in a house boat in Dal Lake for 2 nights and encountered a curfew on 9th, 10th and 11th Feb. I called up Mr. Aditya Mata (General Manager, The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa, Gulmarg) and he showed the epitome of hospitality. He helped arranging an accommodation as well as evacuating us from Srinagar safely to reach this paradise on earth. Every moment of our trip was turned into a memorable holiday by the team at this resort. Starting from Mr. Mata (GM), Mr. Manuj Bahl (EAM), Mr. Bilal (Duty Manager), entire operations team consisting Hilal, front office staff, security staff from G4S and the entire culinary team are highly professionals and make you feel safe and at home. A major credit goes to Mr. Umar Tramboo (MD) who had a vision to create such master piece in Gulmarg.

Our stay of 2 nights was full of happiness. Everything was Our Way and Right Away – a luxurious room, balcony with a unique view, buffet breakfast, culinary master pieces like Haaq or Nadru Yakhni, temperature controlled pool, a nice spa, bon fire arranged by staff in evening, immaculate housekeeping, courteous concierge staff, humble chauffeurs, indoor games and view of snow covered Gulmarg.

We will surely return to this heaven and recommend to our friends, family and business partners.

Also, it is a great location for residential conferences as the resort offers state of the art meeting facilities.

Keep up the good work and you really deserve to be No. 1 which you undisputedly are.

reviews.author: jaidelhicantt
reviews.title: Best hotel in Gulmarg but with average views
reviews.text: Khyber gulmarg is probably the best hotel in gulmarg but the biggest drawback is that it offers very limited views as compared to highlands or nedous.hotel. We stayed in standard room and we payed 12k per night and the room offered view of trees and hotel compound and no view of gulmarg bowl. The hotel however has good heating facility and decent food but the food rates are on the higher side. There is no bar in the hotel which is not mentioned on their website.

reviews.author: Geogeneric
reviews.title: "True Paradise on Earth"
reviews.text:
I am not sure if The Khyber will get anything less than a 5 Star Rating! The property and the people who run it exude such warmth, you'll hate yourself for leaving!
My wife and I stayed for 5 nights. The property, every inch of it is exquisite, very tastefully done up.The service quality is simply outstanding. Aditya, their VP at 9 starts at in the morning and ends his day at maybe 12 midnight. He is just everywhere ensuring things are in order. And the staff, every single one of them, serves with a smile. We're going back there to experience the summer!
If you're thinking Gulmarg, think Khyber! Bilal, Mansoor, Zafar, Shakeel, Puneet and Bilal from the restaurant will make sure you have an unforgettable experience!

reviews.author: Elaine P
reviews.title: Excellent stay at Khyber Resort
reviews.text:
Traveled with my hubby on 14 Jan 2014, had a lovely stay for a night...we were provided a complimentary upgrade to the premier room with Balcony. It was very romantic, The staff and the service by each individual to be well appreciated. I suppose this Resort is the best in Kashmir as we stayed in Vivanta Taj also but were felt Khyber was the best :) ... Hope you get 5 star grade soon. We will plan to visit this place again soon
Mr and Mrs Cota

reviews.author: drtajik
reviews.title: OUR ANNIVERSARY DINNER
reviews.text:
we went for our anniversary dinner on november 4th 2013 at the kbyber  himayalan resorts.i wanted to take my wife for a special dinner and it really turned out to be good.the property is awesome, i had a visits to their rooms its all so good.well furnished rooms with good breath taking views.the food was good..especially the biriyani. the staffs are all really courteous.
OUR NEXT VISIT TO GULMARG ADD US ON YOUR LIST....

reviews.author: mendapara
reviews.title: HEAVEN OF KASHMIR
reviews.text: this is the best property and hotel of gulmarf. one of the besthotel of the world. super duper food available along with the super view., only khyber is the hotel which is 5 star in gulmarg. gandola is also very near the hotel

reviews.author: sayantani s
reviews.title: Ummmm!!
reviews.text: I dunno what to say about this hotel. Its brilliantly amazingly located with v caring staff but honestly they aren't prepared for the winter or the amount of guests visiting.  Water gets freezed for obvious reasons but they shud be prepared for a backup instead there is no water in the loo. Heaters stop working then cars get stuck.. u name an issue n we have faced it but yet we loved the hotel. Special mention for Rafi and Bilal who is the manager for their empathy. Nevertheless we travelled from 6th floor to the third floor lol n in the end with all the unwanted drama we had a good time.

reviews.author: Manan B
reviews.title: Gulmarg is incolmplete without the Khyber
reviews.text:
Its said it took 8 years for this hotel to get built which you will very well understand from the time you step into this hotel.
Its a bit steep on pricing but once you experiance the service / rooms you can very well say that it was money well spent.
We stayed there one night only but regretted the short stay, we were upgraded to the rooms with balconies. Honestly there are very few hotels I have seen with that big rooms and one of the biggest bath tubs which easily accomodates 2.
Fully recomended !

reviews.author: Noelcwt
reviews.title: Excellent 5 star hotel
reviews.text:
One of the best 5 star hotels that I've ever stayed in. The whole experience is superb and the room have a fantastic view of the mountains. We had a luxury room with a sit out balcony as a couple and I must highly recommend for couples who is looking to travel to Gulmarg. Spend a night or most two nights as there are nothing much in Gulmarg itself. I must say I enjoyed the hotel's experience more than I enjoyed Gulmarg as a whole. 

The hotel is very close to the main attraction of Gulmarg, the gondola ride. It is just 5 to 10 minutes walk away from the hotel. They have proper central heating in the hotel itself and the room. In winter the temperature could drop to minus 10 degree Celsius so proper heating is very essential. They only have one dining restaurant and the food was better than average albeit a little pricey. Room service is fast and staff are very courteous and helpful. I did not experienced its spa nor swimming pool but I think they are not operational everyday or at least that's what I found out. 

We had spaghetti as dinner and my girlfriend found it to be tasteless and the staff saw us keep adding spices and salt to the spaghetti, so he came and asked for our opinion and my girlfriend complained that the spaghetti was tasteless. To my surprise, they waived the spaghetti charges and made it complimentary for us. I must say that's very kind of them and it shows they really take customers' feedback seriously.

I would definitely recommend this hotel to others and my friends. They are not cheap, but certainly worth it.

reviews.author: Samrat
reviews.title: Good Resort
reviews.text:
We visited Gulmarg from 19th Dec for 3 nights and stayed at Khyber. The staff is cordial and the food is good... The interiors have been done well only considering the fact that it opened on 21st Dec 2012.. but the wear and tear have started... e,g the room numbers have started falling off and they have darkened them with ball point pen.. it is a good property but definately not 5* as the lifts dont work. Elderly and people with special needs will have major challenges with 4-5 levels of the hotel...e,g, IGLOO - the place where kids can play xbox360 and indoor games is 2 levels below common area..  the spa was not functional till 21st Dec and they denied taking any booking till 21st Morning.. The Spa was smelling on 21st as work was still going on.. No Sauna facility, the passage to the spa did not have centralised heating. The Swimming pool was also not functional.. 
Their website name says it is a hotel www.khyberhotels.com and they say that it is himalayan resort...Generally good resorts are theme based and there is no activites/attractions to call it a resort... So what is it still needs to be dtermined.. They have to work hard for ranking in SLH..Like any other hotel it has a snooker table, playing area for kids and igloo for indoor games.....
No iron and ironing board.. Available on request but not as they write..
They have a open area on the first floor called the NOUF where you can sit and admire natures beauty but the barbeque was not functional as there were not enough guests.... Closed as per their convenience
Also they cancelled dinner buffet as there were not enough guests.. does not happen in 5*.

An eighty room property in which is 80% occupied canceling buffet without prior notice is astonishing.

Gondola is about 5 mins walk and you get pick up & drop from/to the market but they have a challenge in answering phone calls everytime..

Overall average experience... have good views from premier mountain and balcony rooms which is an advantage.. The property is new, and the staff is cordial but is overhyped. We went to see Highland Park which has better scenic views and they have renovated this year..

reviews.author: Shabnamgupta
reviews.title: Expensive for what it offers
reviews.text: We had heard great things about this new so called resort in gulmarg but we were disappointed for several reasons. Firstly they call themselves a mountain resort & spa but neither they are a resort nor they have a spa, there's not even a heated swimming pool. The hotel offers very average views of gulmarg bowl. The rooms though are nice and food is decent but overall they are too expensive for what they have to offer.

reviews.author: Navjot K
reviews.title: A honeymoon to remember :)
reviews.text:
Me and my husband started a brand new journey of our lives with the breathtaking view of the Apharwat snow capped mountains at the Khyber..the hotel is majestic and spacious, its grandeur spellbounds you the minute you enter the premises. 

The location is breathtaking esp the room in which we stayed..the infrastructure..amazing..royal..plush..we could actually see phase 2 of Apharwat mountains from the bathroom..jus sink into the giant tub and you dunt feel like letting go off your eyes from the window. The balcony was comfy. with a nice sitout arrangement, we used to love spending our mornings there.

At Khyber, the Service and hospitality depicts the pure Kashmiriyat in all the staff. They are warm, gentle, affectionate and very caring people. And of course very well and professionally trained as well. Mr. Mudasir who welcomed us into the hotel Mr. Mansoor who made sure we were treated and served best..and the General Manager. Mr. Waseem Raja..thanks to him for the VIP treatment we got at the Khyber. ..the food is great especially the breakfast buffet, it's the best breakfast i've had!  Wish there was a dinner buffet as they have an amazing variety to choose from. The room service is quick, responsible and very courteous. The first aid and medical staff is very humble and caring, the doctor personally came to check on me as I was unwell, he made sure he followed up on me from time to time.

The Gondola ride is just five minutes away..which makes your travel very easy. The upcoming pool , gym and spa are going to be a great hit! In the end, we were surprised with the sweetest souveneir (wooden carved Khyber photoframe with our pic) from the staff that really made our day and made us feel very special. Our best wishes are with the Khyber and we will surely be looking forward to visiting them again soon!

reviews.author: manishchokhani
reviews.title: A great reason to stay in Gulmarg
reviews.text: The Khyber is a world class resort in Gulmarg. We were overwhelmed with the level of service that we experienced. The hotel itself is built lavishly with great attention to detail and has a lovely alpine lodge feel with a distinct Kashmiri décor. We stayed for two nights- ordinarily we would have just done a day trip up from Srinagar, experienced the gondola and returned. The Khyber is THE reason to stay in Gulmarg. Enjoy the walks...the locals are unionized and don't allow you to drive around! You must use their horses or sleds...and even our caring hotel staff cannot help here! So best is stay and enjoy the views, the hotel, the walks... and the excellent food the hotel chefs serve. Take the balcony + mountain view rooms for sure.

reviews.author: jaikaransinghoberoi
reviews.title: Best option in Gulmarg
reviews.text: Hotel khyber in gulmarg is the best option to stay in gulmarg. Hotel is new & rooms are good, we stayed in the room with balcony, rooms service takes long time to deliver an order & surprisingly there is a rate difference between the rates in their all day coffee shop & room service menu but the food is very good & everything on the menu is available. Negative is that the Spa & pool are not operational & they do not have a bar :( We would love to stay in peak winters to experience the snow in gulmarg. Overall recommended.

reviews.author: Amit T
reviews.title: Surprised beyond expectation!
reviews.text:
We selected the hotel after having read the reviews on tripadvisor. Being our first trip to Kashmir, we were skeptical of our decision before reaching the hotel. 

But, all our doubts took a dive just as we reached the hotel entrance. The magnificence of the property spread across the beautiful landscape, surrounded by pine trees and snow capped mountains was awe-inspiring. 

As soon as we entered the reception, we were greeted by Mr. Maroof. I must mention he is a very fine gentlemen. After welcoming us, he insisted that I let him carry my laptop and then he escorted us to Chaikash (tea lounge). He offered us Kava (very rejuvinating) after which we did the check-in formalities. He made sure that we got comfortable, even before we checked-in to the hotel. 

After check-in he explained to us in detail the various facilities available at the hotel, escorted us to our room and further explained all available features in the room. The icing on the cake was we were upgraded from a premium to a luxury room, that too with one of the best views of the landscape (at the center of the property).

One very rare quality that Mr. Maroof displayed was his communication skills. Whenever interrupted by us he would stop talking immediately and listen very patiently to us. And only continue once we stopped.

We stayed there for 3 nights 2 days. The hotel is just 5 minutes walk to the Gondola, which is great, no need to hire a taxi or ponies to reach the gondola. The room was very comfortable with king size beds and very comfortable pillows, mattresses etc. Nothing less than a 5-star property.

I am surprised at many reviews with negative comments for their food. I must mention we had at least 4 meals (vegetarian) at the hotel (apart from breakfast) and the food was definitely very good. And I am surprised to read about the negative comments. They have a varied selection of cuisine on their menu, including Chinese, Italian and North Indian. Although the options for vegetarians was limited to few items, the food was very good. A must try is thier Mezze Platter (falafel with pita, tatzaki, hummous etc). I was absolutely delighted with the flavours of Arabia in midst of Kashmir!!

Even the vegetarian wrap is worth a try. One wrap is quite filling for 2 people, after you have had soup. The servings portions are decent size; one portion is good for 3-4 people.

The chaikash (tea lounge) has over 25 varieties of tea, while the Kava is complimentary. 

Another gesture by the hotel was a complimentary car, on one of the nights when we wanted to go out at eat. Just for a change, we had dinner at a nearby Bakshi restaurant. The food was decent. Although it was 75% cheaper than Khyber, it would be injustice to compare it to Khyber. If anything negative about the food at khyber, then its the price. Although expensive, it is definitely worth the price. You get what you pay for.

Another gesture worth mentioning is that, we got a call from the manager at Cloves (the restaurant at Khyber), on the morning we were checking out. We were late for breakfast so he called us to ensure that we would not miss the breakfast. I don't think you would get such personal care at a 5 or 7-star property.

I did not want to leave and had to force myself to leave the care & comfort of the hotel located at one of the best landscapes in the world. I will definitely be back at Khyber.

reviews.author: Sanchita
reviews.title: Breathtakingly Beautiful !!!
reviews.text:
We went there for our Anniversary .. and it was one of the best anniversary vacations that we have had. We were upgraded to the Luxury Balcony Room and we couldn't have asked for more. The bathroom had a sunken bath tub with a large picture window offering a brilliant view of the snow clad mountains. 
The staff was very helpful and courteous. Mr Bilal at the front desk was extremely helpful and guided us throughout our trip. A big thanks to him. 
The resort is walking distance from the gondola ticket booth and hence you can avoid the ponies and the guide. We were there for a night , which according to us was not enough and we will be back soon hopefully during the snowfall sometime.

reviews.author: Darpan m
reviews.title: Fantastic !!
reviews.text:
One of the most awesome resorts / hotels I have ever been to. The hotel is just pure luxury right from the moment you enter the carved gate made of wood. The lobby is grand and takes you back to the Mughal Era, and then the rooms. We had booked a room and were upgraded to the balcony room and the view from the room is just fabulous. The staff is very helpful and knowledgeable. 

Just a fab property which makes you fall in love with Gulmarg all over again !

reviews.author: creatice_circles
reviews.title: Khyber Gulmarg
reviews.text: We stayed in Khyber for two nights in November & found our experience as average. Thought the hotel is newly built & good but there is nothing much to do either in the hotel or the place so ideally one night stay is more than enough as besides the gondola ride there nothing to do. The hotel was having low occupancy but the food & service were ok. The pool, spa & bar are not operational. Khyber gulmarg is recommended for a one night stay.

reviews.author: awais s
reviews.title: Unmatchably serene...
reviews.text:
Situated midst the enchanting and majestic environs of Gulmarg, the ambiance of the hotel truly symbolizes the Kashmiri traditions and the marvelous uniqueness of the region.
 To create a resort like khyber at a place like gulmarg itself is a big feat
Superb view, excellent service & awesome view! 
Food is excellent.

reviews.author: Alok762
reviews.title: Unmatchably serene...
reviews.text: Had a wonderful stay with my wife at Khyber hotel. Situated amidst the enchanting and majestic environs of Gulmarg, the ambience of the hotel truly symbolizes the Kashmiri traditions and the marvelous uniqueness of the region. The staff, especially Mr. Zaffar Malik was very courteous in making our stay very comfortable and enjoyable. I would highly recommend this hotel for all the tourists who wish to visit Gulmarg.

reviews.author: sayadil
reviews.title: Khyber is a world class property
reviews.text:
Before I write this review I want to mention that we were guests of the owner hence receiving prompt friendly courteous service was never the issue. 
To create a resort like khyber at a place like gulmarg itself is a big feat. There's no mountain ski reaort such as khyber in the whole India and it competes with best in the world. Rooms are nicely done and the mountain view from our balcony suite was just amazing. I've traveled throughout the world from alps to smoky mountains of North America and this place is right up there. There were only two issues that I experienced at the property 1. Internet is slow considering guests are paying for it 2. Food quality specially in buffet be in breakfast or lunch needs to improve whole lot. Food needs to be warm specially meats n bakery too needs to be fresh n warm. I can also see that the pricing of the hotel is steep even by 5star standards if management improves these key points I don't see why they won't receive a 5star from me and everyone else. Come fall in love with Kashmir guys

reviews.author: Sudha V
reviews.title: Outsanding property!
reviews.text: Stayed in Khyber from nov 14th to 16th. Superb view, excellent service & awesome view! Manzoor at the front desk, upgraded our room to luxury balcony room with no additional cost. Really helpful staff & the also help with great warmth! Food is excellent. Just wish that breakfast would be hot. Its room temperature & given the climate, hot food is appreciated. Tx manzoor for the warmth & hospitality shown to us & also for arranging a guide to take us to the gondola ride which is very close to the hotel. Could never get enough of the view from the rooms or the hotel itself! Hope the spa & swimming pool get functional soon! missed that! We will be back soon for a longer stay!

reviews.author: rahulsaraf18
reviews.title: A jewel in heaven
reviews.text: We had booked this hotel to celebrate our anniversary in November. The property is excellent and the best part is the top class hospitality shown by the staff here. The hotel is located at walking distance from the Gondola. On arrival, we were pleasantly surprised to know that they had upgraded our stay to the luxury room with balcony for our occasion. The rooms are spacious with all modern amenities. The balcony offers a stunning view of the snow clad himalayas and the pine trees. Special thanks to Mr Zaffer at the front desk who made sure we had a great stay at the hotel. A stay at the Khyber is much recommended for everyone visiting Gulmarg.

reviews.author: T2Traveller
reviews.title: Brilliant Property!
reviews.text: Amazing property, five star amenities, top quality service and excellent rooms! Very friendly staff and Mr Bilal really helped us get the best rooms at best prices! could do well if they could add a bar to their serene setting!

reviews.author: Uzair M
reviews.title: Memorable Stay
reviews.text: I with my wife stayed in the resort for a couple of nights and the whole experience was wonderful. Helpful and decent staff, amazing location and view, cozy rooms and delightful service are a few things that made our stay worth the while. I highly recommend the resort especially for newlyweds. The view from the balcony rooms is simply breathtaking. The check-in and check-out was completely effortless. Restaurant is great catering to most of the tastes. Room service is up to the mark. The whole team is well managed and trained. I got more than what I had expected from this experience and I will return for sure.

reviews.author: Suchita
reviews.title: Wonderful Stay
reviews.text:
This is my second Tour of  Kashmir & First time We stayed at The Khyber Resort , Gulmarg.From 5th November to 7th November (Two Night) stayed in this resort. We three couple stayed in this resort with unforgettable moments. The most important thing which i would like to share that the hospitality by all staff of this resort provided us, was excellent. Thanks is a very small world for the services provided by staff. As soon as we reached we received warm welcome by reception. We served Kahwa (Kashmir Tea) as welcome drink. 
Mr. Zafar Malik escort us to our room & asked us if we need any thing. I would like to Thank Mr. Zafar & Mr. Ballal for the special treatment provided by them. I can never forget this trip as this was one of fantastic trip. Hotel Location is excellent. One can see the real Gulmarg from this Hotel. Food was excellent even i feel cost was little high, but we enjoyed a lot. I highly recommend this hotel. One should definitely visit Kashmir its really heaven, very peaceful place with wonderfully  hospitality not only by hotel staff even from the local people. People of kashmir are always ready to help especially Tourist. We have never seen such atmosphere. I feel every one should visit Kashmir at least once in life.

reviews.author: 78avidtraveller
reviews.title: New good hotel but disappointed
reviews.text: We were told that this is a super deluxe 5 star new hotel in gulmarg but we had a mixed opinion. Hotel is good & has local architecture and rooms are also nice but inspite of the hotel being a resort & a spa it neither offers a spa/ swimming spool or a bar, they do not have a mini bar in the rooms. Food overall is good but some of the items are exorbitantly priced. We went to see highlands park & the views from there are much better. Overall good  for a a overnight stay only.

reviews.author: Varun S
reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: Brand new hotel, with brilliant decor and amazing rooms. Staff was courteous and professional. The location is excellent, with spectacular mountain views. A meal in the BBQ area on the first floor is highly recommended. Amongst the best hotels I have stayed in!

reviews.author: Deepak
reviews.title: The best in Gulmarg, Kashmir and a 5 Star Hotel
reviews.text:
This is the best property in gulmarg, Kashmir and the only 5 star property.
We were amaze by the hotel the moment we step in. We took the deluxe with balcony which had a Breathtaking view. The rooms are very very nice with huge washroom and bath tub. Dinner was awesome. Breakfast was amazingly good.

Would recommend this hotel if you want to avoid the horse touts, cos this hotel is 3 mins walk from the cable car / gondola ride :)

We had our dinner in CLOVES had chicken burger which was very good ( They have varieties of food from Prawn to lobster and vegetarian meals and tea at CHAIKASH there have more then 40 types of tea cakes and pastry

I enjoyed my stay here very much, Only negative point was you had to pay for the WiFi which is 750 rupees  for 24 hours. Maybe the hotel can consider giving free WiFi at the lobby.

Overall a very good hotel, will surely return to this 5 star hotel.

reviews.author: Shameemnahvi
reviews.title: Simply WOW !!
reviews.text:
First of all I ll like to say THANKS A TON AAMIR ANWAR,who suggested me to visit HOTEL KHYBER.It has been an awesome experience of mine to visit the hotel.
AMBIENCE AND LOCATION::The ambience and location of the resort is unparalleled.Its has the most beautiful location matching to that of world class resorts,and trust me guys u ll skip a beat when u ll get a sight of the landscape.
FOOD AND SERVICES :: The quality and class of food is simply superb.Apart from that the MENU is very diverse.We get all types ,all varieties of INDIAN,CHINESE,ITALIAN AND CONTINENTAL cuisines that too very relishing.The staff is very much trained and hospitable.
VALUE TO MONEY :: Just one word...guys u ll get more than 100% in return..

reviews.author: Ron and Jeanne B
reviews.title: Lives up to its billing as a luxury Himalayan resort, but no alcohol.
reviews.text: Truly upscale public and private areas, with a nice “mountain” feel.  Excellent dinner and breakfast buffet.  Good service from all staff.  Spacious and very well appointed rooms with good views from all of them (as best we could tell). Very clean.  However, several areas and facilities (e.g. spa and swimming pool) under construction/reconstruction in October 2013, no elevators (although it’s only three stories) and, temporarily, no view from dining room. Furthermore, views of the mountains were almost total obscured by air pollution on our visit (we didn’t even bother taking the gondola ride)—but we were assured this is not a problem in the winter and earlier in the summer. (Of course,we have had many assurances in India of things which didn’t turn out to be true!)

reviews.author: chinnupaulose
reviews.title: Great service,Great Stay...
reviews.text:
A beautiful property with breathtaking view, the Khyber Himalayan Resort would add on to your Kashmir experience without any doubt!!!
The rooms were excellent with great interiors and detail. The view from the balcony of your room is one which I promise, you will never get tired of !!!
Have to put a special mention for the GM, Mr. Alex Koshy and the staff for the hospitality extended during our entire stay there. Great Service, Great Stay...
Our only disappointment was, that we could not see the place all covered with snow and take in the same view from the balcony of our rooms.Could not imagine how beautiful that would be too.

An experience that we would love to relive again !!! this time when it snows!!! 

The Khyber is a excellent choice for couples as well as family or with friends.Totally recommend it...

reviews.author: manu_manmadhan
reviews.title: Heaven on Hills !
reviews.text:
Had an excellent experience during our stay at Khyber !
Every aspect of Hospitality right from the time we entered the Property premises till we checked out left a memorable experience in us. A special mention goes out to the GM & all the staff who made us feel at home with their warmth. The rooms too were well anointed with a breathtaking view of the hills ! Would recommend Khyber as a must stay when you visit Kashmir.

reviews.author: KnottedBraid
reviews.title: Awestruck!
reviews.text: The resort is nestled in the foothills of the Himalayas. Oh...what a beautiful place this is. The hotel is luxurious with spectacular views. One can just sit in the balcony and keep watching the mountains and feel the weather changing from sunny to cloudy to sunny again. The restaurants and classy and the service is impeccable. Full marks to the staff on the hospitality front. They are extremely charming and courteous. I will be back at this wonderful place during the winters.....

reviews.author: huddysue57
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel
reviews.text:
The Khyber hotel is undoubtedly a beautiful place to stay. The balcony room we stayed in was very clean , the bed was extremely comfortable and  the view was stupendous. The staff were all very friendly and very helpful. The food was excellent , my husband had the lamb which was to die for :)
We had two issues with the hotel , one was the checking in procedure , although our booking was for a balcony room with a mountain view they though it would be ok to give us a room on the other side of the hotel until I insisted on a mountain view room. Also a member of staff knocked on our bedroom door to tell us I must go to the front desk and pay immediately , we had paid in advance through our travel agent so this was very upsetting but the issue was quickly sorted and we received an apology for the mistake . I am sure the check in procedure problems will be sorted as the staff gain more experience. We would certainly stay here again.

reviews.author: SunandhaV
reviews.title: Khyber - The heaven is here... here... here...
reviews.text: Khyber is one of the best places for tourism destinations in India. Coming from South India, North India was a mystery all these places. We had mixed feedbacks about our holiday destinations - Srinagar and Gulmarg. But stay in Khyber is the best of all. The multicuisine restaurants, luxurious rooms, housekeeping and room service waiting for you hand and foot, amazing views from the room, spot-less bathrooms will make you feel royal. My bday fell on our honeymoon trip and surprisingly, the roof top restaurant (Nouf) in the resort, waived our bill as a token of appreciation. It was a really nice thing to do. It was memorable and pleasant stay at Khyber and we will renew our vows next year in the same place, possibly an extended stay.

reviews.author: 719vijayk
reviews.title: Finest Hotel in India
reviews.text: One of the best hotel in India which makes ur stay special and memorable. The staff is so frndly and helpful. Delicious food with lot of cuisines to choose. Room services are so prompt. Khyber is the second attraction in gulmarg.

reviews.author: dedacain
reviews.title: Improve check out procedure
reviews.text:
We had an excellent and a comfortable stay. But they need to improve check out procedure professionally. After paying my restaurant dues and filling their review form, when I was proceeding to my taxi suddenly one person appeared and asked if I had paid the room rent. We felt really offended and did not expect such an attitude from such a famous resort. I stayed near my taxi told them that we had paid in advance through Make my trip portal and had given the vouchers at the time of check in. Another person came out after some time and said no problem and that we could leave. I had a sudden feeling that is Khyber resort only needed international tourist with big credit card in their purse? 
Anyhow as a senior contributor, it is my duty to point out the mistake by staff so that they can improve the services. Please take the American plan otherwise your food bill will be very high. I really love the attitude of restaurant manager; Deepak …Property has an excellent view and always take room with balcony. I really loved the kava served at lobby tea stall and I can never forget its aroma. Dr Jain

reviews.author: PreethiNat
reviews.title: Pricey!
reviews.text: We stayed for a night at the Khyber. The interiors are beautifully done but the wooden flooring is quite slippery. The staff were extremely cordial and very courteous. The welcome tea was very refreshing and the servicing staff took extra care to satisfy us.  However, the food did not agree especially the fresh fruit juices that were offered during dinner. The stay was overall good but the bad experience was after checking out. We had missed our cellphone and tried to trace it back but the numbers were not reachable. The staff were also very curt to us over phone. The after service could definitely be improved. Overall good stay, but not worth the hefty amount we paid for it.

reviews.author: ajay35
reviews.title: Wasted effort
reviews.text:
We just returned back from Kashmir. We stayed at Khyber - Gulmarg for 1 night. The hotel has very tastefully done interiors my compliments to the interior designers. However other than this nothing is right with the place. The central heating in my room was not working. On complaining the service dept worked on it and was able to rectify the fault only after repeated attempts which meant service people moving into & out of my room repeatedly also showing that they don't have any SOP of regular maintenance. The room heater provided in lieu of central heating was of blower type and was noisy instead of noiseless oil filled radiator type.
Restaurant serves food of very ordinary grade compared to exorbitant prices
In spite of having informed that I was there for celebrating my Anniversary they made no attempt to make the day special for me instead I was given a room with lousy view instead of mountain view.
Mr Deepak who is in charge is a sweet man however seems to be bogged down with operational issues hence cannot devote time to take care of extras like doing something extra for a guest if he is there on a special occasion.
Would not like to stay there again until & unless they really improve.

reviews.author: sunil d
reviews.title: Stay only for Rooms
reviews.text: When we visited this hotel in June it has no spa, no swimming pool, no bar so basically you are paying so much only for the rooms. It is a brand new property & rooms are decent so is the food but the name is very deceptive as it is neither a resort nor a spa. Maximum 01 night stay in more than enough in this hotel & gulmarg only for the cable car ride.

reviews.author: gargi2013
reviews.title: great place to be.
reviews.text: breath taking view, delicious kashmiri food, great cigar/ shisha bar. rooms are well equipped. bathrooms are very good. great place to be.take breakfast on outside varandah. spa is starting from october. ask hotel to arrange your gondola tickets to avoid queue.

reviews.author: Prashant65
reviews.title: enriching experience
reviews.text: khyber has a great view from the balcony. very helpful staff who looked after us very well. arranged for our outdoor activity. guide provided was good--took us to the gondola and then a mountain trek to drung which was amazing. the surroundings left us amazed at the beauty around us. we preferred the trek instead of the routine drive around gulmarg and didn't repent the decision!

reviews.author: Rahul Lalit
reviews.title: Simply Superb!
reviews.text:
We stayed at this fabulous property in the second week of August and this was the best stay of our entire Kashmir holiday. The property is grand and tastefully done up having a very woody-very Kashmiri sort of feel to it.  Rooms and bathrooms are very nice, beds extremely comfortable and the view is spectacular. We had the best food at this hotel whether it was Chinese, Continental or local Kashmiri cuisine. The chef gave special attention to specific needs of the guest (which I have only seen at Oberoi properties in India) and other hotel staff was extremely courteous too. 
I would highly recommend this hotel and would love to go back for another vacation!!!

reviews.author: siddhantVerma
reviews.title: Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa
reviews.text:
Me and My Fiancée were super excited for our first trip to Kashmir. We decided to stay at Kyber Resort and Spa, this is a perfect place to spend your time with love ones. Hotel is beautiful and strategically situated just 5 min walk from the Asia's longest Cable car "Gondola". As, soon as u enter resort one get the feel of Kashmir's local culture. Whole hotel is beautifully carved with Walnut wood, Lobby is beautifully designed as a traditional Kashmiri house with front desk and concierge assistance. Resort boast high level of service with their fully trained and courteous staff starting from the airport pick up chauffeur " Mr.Bashir" who was very courteous to Food and Beverage Executive " Mr.Robin" to Housekeeping "Evening turn down service staff". Resort provide delicious food and beverage option with their local and international selection of dishes at Cloves, Nouf and Chaikash "Tea lounge" at lobby level offer varieties of teas to enjoy at alfresco sitting or inside with mountain view, eating breakfast buffet at cloves sitting at Alfresco is just so heavenly.Our room with Balcony " with Best View of all " was just so perfect at par to any 5***** deluxe resort, One can enjoy a twin bath tub and best in class features. We were so impressed with the the warm and courteous service we got by Khyber Resort that even our trip was over we have decided to come and stay here during winters. 
I would like to Thanks Front Office, Food & Beverage " Mr.Robin " , Housekeeping, Airport pick up Chauffeur, Security " Mr.Deeepak & Mr.Rahul " for making our stay at Khyber a memorable stay.

reviews.author: anshu1212
reviews.title: Truely a PARADISE on earth !!
reviews.text: It was our 2 nights stay there..& the most memorable one..If you want yourself to get pampered amidst the nature,please visit this resort..The staff here are so well groomed & make you feel really special..We totally fell in love with this place from the moment we stepped in..i would recommend that its a must stay resort if you are in Kashmir..They have great facilities,but only if you want to booze then you can get your own stuff to the hotel..We are looking forward for another visit soon :) :)

reviews.author: Sh0nal1980
reviews.title: Beautiful surprise amidst gulmarg
reviews.text: I have to suggest this spectacular hotel and its staff to everyone who wants to visit the beautiful town of gulmarg. Me and my husband Karan absolutely fell in love with this hotel and its warm hospitality . We were there for 3 nights and cringed at the fact when the stay came to an end. The facilities are awesome, right from the gym, snooker table and hike excursions, we were looked after in every bit. They had especially organised a private BBQ dinner on the lawns with a big bonfire on one night where we were left astounded. The food in the coffee shop to the specialty restaurant nouf was specatcular(not cheap though!) then there was their chai shop where we would enjoy every concoctions of tea n coffee brews. (For guests who want to drink otherwise, pls carry your own alcohol) We missed out on our picnic(picnic basket included) due to rains, but we enjoyed every minute of our stay. We are so looking forward to spend a ski vacation there. I believe it's even more spectacular. Thank you Mr Alex for being a gracious host. Your staff was equally commendable.

reviews.author: Vaishali Havaldar
reviews.title: The khyber
reviews.text: Excellent stay. It is located very close to gondola rides. They provide vehicle to go to gondola. Beautifully decorated, food we tried in the grill section. Steak was out of this world. Wish we had more days to enjoy the hotel. The view from the rooms was breath taking. If we ever come back to Gulmarg we would want to stay here.

reviews.author: Alokmili77
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: We were upgraded in deluxe rooms,hotel was not fully operational.we had a nice view from our bathrooms showing snow across the tub glass so near you.It was snowing and seen life time best view from the hotel.food was exceptionally good.Shooting team for film Bang Bang were scheduled to stay there but there trip was cancelled,because of disturbance.

reviews.author: kawalnain
reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: Thsi newly built property in Gulmarg certainly didn't live upto the hype it has created as it lacked in overall open views of Gulmarg bowl, service & food specially for our vegetarians frndz & their guest apprach which sems to be quite unfriendly. The spa was not operational & to top it all even after paying 20k a room they did not have a bar which a great let down for a so called 5 star resort hotel!

reviews.author: Tender0
reviews.title: Ask and get
reviews.text:
A beautiful property with the best of services. I was very disappointed by the initial allotment of the room (in the basement, near a noisy laundry room?) and lacklustre reception.  I did not hesitate in being vocal about my disappointment and things changed. We were relocated...to a room with breathtaking view of the snow-capped mountains and a valley of trees from the window and its balcony..! Prompt, flawless and obliging service. Very cordial staff. Impressive spread for dinner as well as breakfast..Upon my request the live egg station chef cooked a very fluffy omelette in a very innovative style. Head chef dropped by to check all is well. 
Only caveat - the facilities at the hotel were not yet operational. They need to introduce more in house activities. The kahwa reception was good.

reviews.author: imrandp
reviews.title: Excellent Location, Limited options but a greedy management !
reviews.text:
this property being a member of the SLH group boasts of excellent infrastructure, like other SLH properties. however there are some major flaws too ! we stayed for 3 days in end of may 2013 in balcony room no. 2019 - first floor. the property is located slightly above the Gondola boarding station gate which is past the taxi stand with horses blocking the main road leading to the property. Secondly the most annoying factor is that the management has installed mobile phone jammers high up on a pine tree which works by blocking all mobile phones & wifi above the lobby level; in spite of full signal one cannot make or receive calls. This has been done so that the guests staying in the property use the room telephone & pay the inflated long distance charges. The mobile phone operators whose fake full signal one will receive when within the hotel are Aircel, Airtel & Cellone (BSNL POSTPAID).

The staff are also over worked & work beyond their normal shift hours & with no lift in the property, it is really physically challenging for them too especially in peak season ! The spa & swimming pool are not yet ready but noise levels for the on-going construction activity during day time is low, hence that's tolerable.

the f&b options for veg & non-veg are limited & highly priced, however the food is tasty. waffle counter missing in the breakfast hall & buffet lunch & dinner are prices @ 1600/- per person but with a limited spread. the kava served in the lobby is excellent but not the original Kashmiri kava as its without tea leaves ! the room temperature cannot be increased beyond 24 deg C and that's a problem for kids who would like to sleep at 27 deg C, the most comfortable temperature. in-room digital temperature controller though is of high quality and at par with other SLH properties like Wild Flower Hall of Oberoi above Shimla !

Presently the best in Gulmarg, hence full occupancy.. and since its a new property the minor issues should hopefully be sorted out soon ! Getting your own vehicle & keeping it with you will help as car hire options are limited too !

reviews.author: ms14_delhi
reviews.title: Avoid
reviews.text: When I entered the hotel, I was greeted by a lousy guard who was not willing to pull out the luggage from the boot of my car. This just set the tone of the entire experience at this hotel. The front desk staff conveniently told me that I should have given them a call from the toll point for them to arrange for someone to pull out the luggage. I had a taken the basic room that costed 20k. No airport transfers or breakfast is included in the room fares. The room was small, I would say congested for the price I was paying. The bathroom was cluttered as well with a really small bath tub. The only positive about the hotel was the interiors. The carpets, woodwork, blanket seemed to be authentic kashmiri stuff. The view from the hotel is pretty average. All you can see from the room is a few pine trees. All in all, a below average room size and outside room view for a luxury 5* tourist hotel. The service is even worse. The phone in my room was not working, so was the DTH connection, the mini-bar was empty and the safe locked. I asked for a toothbrush in the morning that arrived after 45minutes. A DVD player which is available in the hotel never arrived in my 3 days of stay even after I asked for it repeatedly. The service was really poor with the staff taking 40minutes to make up the room when they came 30 minutes after being called. In short, the service is disappointing to the say the least. The hotel is absolutely not worth the pice. Avoid if you dont want to spoil your holiday.

reviews.author: Gauri407
reviews.title: Unforgettable location, forgettable service
reviews.text:
The Khyber at Gulmarg is a beautifully designed hotel located most ideally facing the snow capped mountains on one side and the valley the other. The hotel itself is well designed in harmony with its surroundings. The rooms with a balcony over unparalleled views and should not be missed. Alas, if only the service was a match for the building.
We booked a room online through the hotel website for a two day stay. There are no options on the site for inclusion of meals or breakfast in the package so we thought we would get the details on arrival. Upon arrival, we were asked to pay for our first day of stay before we entered the room. 
So the plus points were the amazing location ( magnificent views) and the breakfast spread is both wide and scrumptious. 
On the desperately seeking improvement areas are the service and the infrastructure. 
Most importantly, on learning that there is a package which includes breakfast we went to the reception to request for it. Then we learned that the only people who knew about the packages were the ‘reservation people’ who were unavailable on phone but were on their way to speak to us. We waited for 10-15 mins after which we were told to go out and that they would call us. Upon our return in the evening, the same discussion took place. In the evening again we requested and again we were told that they were busy and that they had come to meet us when we had left. (This is the same person who told us to go and that the reservation person would call us). The details of the packages are available only to these people and the conditions on which you can switch from one to another depends on a ‘variety of reasons including mode of booking, time of booking, etc’. No apology was ever given for this behaviour. 
Also, while bathing, the water can move from warm to cool even without the power cuts. In a place like Gulmarg, this can be a bit problematic. The heating in the room on the first day took a good 3 hours to kick in. The turn down service which included water replenishments, etc. was offered only on the second day.
