The bathtub though beautifully designed was not cleaned during our two day stay. The food during lunch is okay and not a patch on breakfast. Even the traditional Kashmiri drink served on arrival is better at the market downstairs.
Given that the Khyber has positioned itself as a luxury hotel such quality of service was mildly shocking and even more so since it was running on 20-25% occupany during our stay.
Try and negotiate good rates for yourself if you plan to go sine the hotel is new and occupany is quite low.

reviews.author: friend777
reviews.title: The Hotel is just WOW..but........
reviews.text:
Good Luxury room, guess its the one of the best hotels i have stayed in my life  
View was good
Food was very bad and extremely expensive ( avoid eating there as it not worth at all )
we were charged Rupees 1600 for a buffet dinner with only veg food which was tasteless and with very few choice of starters and main course 
Fitness center and spa not started yet 
Its very close to the gandola ride
Service was very good
Staff were pleasant and helpful
Mobile phones dont work in this hotel as there is no network, Hotel Internet is usually not working

reviews.author: khan22
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text:
It's a review that comes with a red warning light...
The hotel is amazingly located and beautifully made. It is a place I would strongly recommend to anyone who wants to have a great time. Majorly wood,  some Glass, metal and papier mache interiors make you want to live there for a while before you move on.
RED ALERT: The food is horrible and EX..P..EnSiii...VE. If you are staying here try to either eat out or order basic meal. The taste is not worth half the price.
The staff is extremely pleasant. Tariq  from the hukkah bar is a knowledgeable young man who is also very kind to give you the right advice when asked for.
Deepak from the restaurant is pleasant and kind enough to make you comfortable and does his bit to make things easier for you.

reviews.author: asifwani21
reviews.title: just for lunch
reviews.text:
Slow service ...confused staff ...Restaurant is absolutely hopeless. Food is slow ... doesn't taste good. cold!Takes hours for everything. 
I was pissed off by their Food & Beverage service...and hell you are on top of a mountain so where else can u eat!
The staff is pretty new and the concept of service is not at par with other five stars in the state or elsewhere. 
Mobiles do not work in the hotel due to lack of network. 
Though the hotel has an excellent location and provides a great view of the afarwat mountain, 
the service was not good. The staff had to be reminded many times before they could serve us. 
The restaurant staff were not knowledgeable about the menu. 
Sadly, they did not provide us with the service and courtesy.
EXCELLENT VIEW!! Certainly the best in the gulmarg for the view.

reviews.author: Sharat K
reviews.title: Best in the country
reviews.text:
The best things about this Hotel are it's location on a walking distance from the gondola and great view from the room. 
I couldn't try the food here because I had an upset stomach but the hotel staff was very helpful to make home style food for me. They really took good care of us. The place costs a bomb but it's totally worth it. 
I did see other hotels also in Gulmarg but this is the best and in my opinion, it is the best five-star resort on a mountain. The owners have done a commendable job to make this hotel at such a great height.

reviews.author: Rakhisyaman
reviews.title: Snuggle into the cold..
reviews.text:
This was my second visit to Gulmarg and my first stay at Khyber Himalayan resort & spa and I can vouch that this is the first of its kind in Gulmarg. We were blown away by the warm welcome we received at the resort.

The interiors of this property are another matter altogether. There is no hint of rural within - luxurious, well-appointed rooms, wooden flooring that keeps you warm, a large bathroom and a huge tub to die for! Proximity to gondola makes it all the more perfect for a amazing ski holiday. Our favorite bit was the large traditional diwans/chairs that have been set up in the lobby, perfect for soothing your tired feet after a strenuous day up the mountain or just curling up with a book. 

Hotel staff members were very kind in helping out with local transport, medicines etc. We were quite impressed by their tea bar and hookah lounge. Buffet lunch/breakfast was very good. Do not miss the hara-bhara kebabs which were absolutely mind blowing.

I cant wait to plan another holiday to Khyber Himalayan to experience yet another day in the life of a king!
